searchable.brief_info: OTOMED EAR DROPS is a combination formula trusted for the effective treatment of acute and chronic ear infections and inflammation, providing relief from pain, swelling, and microbial growth.
searchable.description: OTOMED EAR DROPS is a strong, multi-action otic preparation, typically combining ingredients from three or four different pharmacological classes: antibiotics, an antifungal, a corticosteroid, and often a local anaesthetic. This formulation is necessary for treating complex ear infections (otitis externa and acute otitis media) which are often complicated by a mixture of bacterial and fungal pathogens, and accompanied by significant pain and inflammation. The drops are designed for direct instillation into the external ear canal, ensuring localized and rapid relief from severe symptoms like pain, itching, and swelling. Due to its potent ingredients, OTOMED EAR DROPS is exclusively available by prescription.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of OTOMED EAR DROPS

OTOMED EAR DROPS is a Prescription Only Medicine (POM).

Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician.

The typical dosage is 4-5 drops, 2-4 times daily, depending on the severity of the infection and the specific variant prescribed.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical (instillation into the ear canal).
  • How to Use:
    1. Wash your hands thoroughly.
    2. Warm the bottle slightly by holding it in your hand for a minute (do not heat).
    3. Lie on your side or tilt your head so the affected ear is facing upward.
    4. Instill the prescribed number of drops directly into the external ear canal.
    5. For adults, pull the earlobe up and back. For children, pull the earlobe down and back.
    6. Keep the head tilted for at least 2 minutes to allow the drops to penetrate. A soft cotton plug may be inserted if directed by your doctor.
  • Timing: Apply 2 to 4 times daily, ensuring consistent spacing between doses.

Missed Dose Guidance

  • If you miss a dose, apply it as soon as you remember.
  • If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not apply a double dose.
searchable.specification: The drops are a multi-component formulation, typically containing a steroid (e.g., Fludrocortisone), two antibiotics (e.g., Neomycin, Polymyxin B) and a local anaesthetic (Lidocaine) OR an antibiotic (Ofloxacin), steroid (Beclometasone), and antifungal (Clotrimazole). It is supplied as an otic solution in a small dropper bottle (e.g., 5 mL or 8 mL). It is a Prescription Only Medicine (POM).
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of OTOMED EAR DROPS

Do NOT use OTOMED EAR DROPS if the patient:

  • Has a known allergy or hypersensitivity to any of the specific antibiotics (like Neomycin/Ofloxacin), steroid, or local anaesthetic/antifungal components.
  • Has a perforated eardrum, as this increases the risk of the drug passing into the middle ear and causing irreversible ototoxicity (hearing damage), especially from aminoglycosides (like Neomycin).
  • Has viral infections of the external ear canal (e.g., Herpes Simplex), as steroids can worsen viral infections.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor. Use of this multi-component drug (especially those containing aminoglycosides like Neomycin, or systemic Ofloxacin) is generally not recommended in pregnancy due to the theoretical risk of foetal toxicity (e.g., irreversible hearing damage). Use only if clearly needed and directed by a physician.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. The active ingredients may pass into breast milk. Use only when advised by a healthcare professional.

Side Effects of OTOMED EAR DROPS

Side effects are generally localized but can be serious if the eardrum is perforated.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild and temporary irritation, itching, or a tingling sensation in the ear immediately after administration.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Ototoxicity (Hearing Damage): The main risk with Neomycin/Polymyxin B, especially with prolonged use or perforated eardrums, leading to irreversible partial or total deafness.
    • Allergic Reactions: Severe rash, swelling of the face, or difficulty breathing.
    • Local Superinfection: Overgrowth of non-susceptible organisms.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If hearing loss, ringing in the ears (tinnitus), severe dizziness, or any sign of an allergic reaction occurs, stop the medication immediately and seek emergency medical attention.
  • If irritation persists, consult your doctor.

Precautions and Warnings of OTOMED EAR DROPS

  • Eardrum Status: CRUCIAL WARNING: This medicine should only be used after a doctor has confirmed the eardrum is intact (not perforated). If perforation is known or suspected, the risk of ototoxicity is very high.
  • Duration of Use: Do not use for prolonged periods (e.g., longer than 7-10 days) to minimize the risk of antibiotic resistance and ototoxicity, unless specifically directed by a doctor.
  • External Use Only: Use only in the ear; not suitable for use in the eye.
  • Contamination: Do not touch the dropper tip to any surface, the ear, or your hands, to avoid contamination of the solution.
  • Renal Impairment: Use with caution in patients with impaired renal (kidney) function, as neomycin clearance may be reduced.

searchable.name: ZENTEL SUSPENSION 20ML
searchable.brief_info: Zentel Suspension is a potent, broad-spectrum anthelmintic medication containing Albendazole. Designed as a convenient oral liquid, it is highly effective against a wide range of intestinal parasites and worms. Zentel works by interfering with the parasites' ability to absorb glucose, effectively depleting their energy and leading to their elimination from the body. This 20ml bottle is an ideal choice for both adults and children who prefer a liquid format for easy swallowing.
searchable.description: Zentel is a trusted name in family deworming. It is specifically formulated to treat single or mixed intestinal infections. Because worms often go undetected, regular deworming with a high-quality treatment like Zentel helps maintain optimal nutritional health, especially in children where parasites can interfere with growth and energy levels.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage and Administration

  • Adults & Children (Over 2 years): Typically the full 20ml bottle (400mg) as a single dose.
  • Children (12 to 24 months): Usually 10ml (200mg) as a single dose.
  • Method: Shake the bottle well before use. The suspension can be taken directly or mixed with a small amount of juice or water.
  • Note: For certain infections like Strongyloides or Tapeworm, your doctor may advise taking a dose once daily for three consecutive days.

Proper Usage Tips

  • Shake Well: IMPORTANT: Always shake the bottle vigorously before pouring to ensure the medicine is evenly distributed.
  • Fatty Meals: While not strictly required for intestinal worms, taking Zentel with a meal containing some fat (like milk or butter) can improve absorption if treating systemic infections.
  • Family Treatment: It is often recommended that the entire household be treated at the same time to prevent re-infection, especially with pinworms.

How to Store and Dispose of Zentel

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from direct sunlight.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return any unused or expired suspension to your pharmacist.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Pregnancy: DO NOT USE if you are pregnant or think you might be pregnant. Albendazole is known to be harmful to the developing fetus.
  • Conception: Women of childbearing age should take the dose within the first 7 days of their menstrual cycle or after a negative pregnancy test.
  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to Albendazole or other benzimidazole medicines (like Mebendazole).

Side Effects of Zentel

  • Common: Occasional headache, dizziness, or mild stomach pain/nausea.
  • Rare: Temporary thinning of the hair or a mild skin rash.
  • Action: If you experience high fever or severe abdominal pain, consult your doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Hygiene: To prevent re-infection, wash hands thoroughly after using the bathroom and before meals. Keep fingernails short and change bed linens frequently after treatment.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor before use if you are nursing.

searchable.name: Hyponidd Herbal Tablets
searchable.brief_info: Hyponidd Herbal Tablet is a scientifically tested, multi-herbal formulation trusted for its natural insulin-sensitizing properties, supporting the management of both Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS).
searchable.description: Hyponidd Herbal Tablet is a proprietary Ayurvedic formulation that utilizes a powerful synergy of authentic herbal extracts and purified minerals. It is designed to offer a holistic approach to chronic metabolic and hormonal imbalances. The core action of this tablet is to function as a natural insulin sensitizer, thereby improving the body's response to insulin and helping to normalize blood sugar levels. For women with PCOS, this insulin-sensitizing action is crucial for correcting related metabolic disorders and promoting hormonal balance. Hyponidd Herbal Tablet helps reduce associated symptoms like obesity, fatigue, and helps protect tissues from the degenerative complications of diabetes.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Hyponidd Herbal Tablet

Hyponidd Herbal Tablet is a supplementary therapy.

Take one to two tablets twice daily, or as directed by the pharmacist or physician.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral tablet.
  • How to Take: Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the tablet.
  • Timing: Typically taken twice daily, approximately half an hour before meals for optimal insulin-sensitizing effect, or as directed by your physician.
  • Duration: Treatment for PCOS may range from 4 to 12 months depending on the severity; follow medical guidance.

Missed Dose Guidance

  • If you forget to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
  • If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not take a double dose.
searchable.specification: The active ingredients are a complex blend of herbal extracts and purified minerals, including Vijaysaar (Pterocarpus marsupium), Haridra (Curcuma longa), Karela (Momordica charantia), Guduchi, and Amalaki. It is supplied as an oral herbal tablet (typically in packs of 30 or 50). It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Ayurvedic Medicine/Herbal Supplement.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Hyponidd Herbal Tablet

Do NOT take Hyponidd Herbal Tablet if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to any of the herbal extracts (e.g., Momordica charantia, Curcuma longa, Vijaysaar) or purified minerals (e.g., Shilajit, Yashad Bhasma) in the tablet.
  • Have been diagnosed with severe kidney failure or diabetic ketoacidosis (it is not a primary treatment for these conditions).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor. Due to limited safety data on the full herbal composition, use during pregnancy is advised only under the strict guidance of a healthcare professional.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. Use only under medical supervision.

Side Effects of Hyponidd Herbal Tablet

As a herbal formulation, it is generally well-tolerated, but individual responses can vary.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild gastrointestinal discomfort, nausea, or diarrhoea, especially during the initial phase of treatment.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Severe Allergic Reactions: Rash, swelling, or difficulty breathing.
    • Hypoglycemia: While rare when used alone, it may occur when combined with high doses of conventional Oral Hypoglycemic Agents (OHAs) or Insulin, requiring close monitoring.
    • Liver/Kidney Issues: Rare reports of elevated liver enzymes or kidney issues have been associated with herbal usage; monitor for unusual fatigue or jaundice.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you experience symptoms of hypoglycemia (dizziness, fainting, profuse sweating), take a sweet drink or lollipop immediately, and consult your physician to adjust the dosage of your other diabetic medication.
  • For any severe or persistent side effects, discontinue use and consult a physician immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Hyponidd Herbal Tablet

  • Diabetic Monitoring: Regular monitoring of blood sugar levels is absolutely vital while taking Hyponidd Herbal Tablet, especially when used concurrently with OHAs or insulin. The dosage of OHAs/Insulin must be adjusted slowly by a physician as blood sugar control improves.
  • Not a Substitute: This herbal tablet is not a substitute for insulin or other prescribed antidiabetic medications. Do not alter the dose of prescribed drugs without medical consultation.
  • PCOS Diagnosis: Ensure a qualified physician has confirmed the PCOS diagnosis and determined the appropriate duration of management.
  • Lifestyle: This medication works best when combined with necessary lifestyle modifications, including a balanced diet and regular exercise.

searchable.name: Omefast 20mg
searchable.brief_info: Omefast 20mg is a potent gastrointestinal medication containing Omeprazole. It belongs to a class of drugs known as Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPIs). By targeting the source of acid production in the stomach, Omefast provides long-lasting relief from heartburn, indigestion, and the painful symptoms of acid reflux, while creating the ideal environment for stomach ulcers to heal.
searchable.description: Omefast 20mg is designed to provide 24-hour relief from excess stomach acid. Unlike antacids, which only neutralize existing acid, Omefast works by "turning off" the tiny pumps in the stomach lining that produce acid in the first place. This makes it highly effective for chronic conditions like GERD (Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease), where persistent acid backflow irritates the esophagus.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Omefast 20mgTake as directed by your physician or pharmacist.

  • For Heartburn/GERD: Typically one 20mg capsule once daily for 4 to 8 weeks.
  • For Ulcer Prevention: One 20mg capsule daily, or as prescribed.
  • For H. pylori: Usually 20mg twice daily when combined with antibiotics.

Proper Administration

  • Timing: For best results, take Omefast in the morning, at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast. The pumps are most active after a period of fasting, making this the most effective time to block them.
  • Swallow Whole: Do not crush, chew, or open the capsules. They are specially coated (enteric-coated) to pass through the stomach acid and dissolve in the intestine for proper absorption.
  • Missed Dose: Take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed one. Do not double the dose.

How to Store and Dispose of Omefast 20mg

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Keep the container tightly closed to protect the capsules from moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired medication to your local pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Omefast 20mg

  • Patience is Key: While some people feel relief within a few hours, it may take 1 to 4 days of consistent use to reach the full acid-blocking effect.
  • Lifestyle Shifts: Avoid "trigger foods" (spicy, fatty, or acidic foods) and avoid lying down immediately after eating to maximize the benefits of the medication.
  • Short-Term Use: If you are self-treating for frequent heartburn, do not use it for more than 14 days without consulting a doctor.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 14 or 28 Capsules.
  • Form: Delayed-Release (Enteric-coated) Capsules.
  • Active Ingredient: Omeprazole 20mg.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Omefast 20mg

  • Known Allergy: Do NOT use if you are allergic to Omeprazole or other PPIs (e.g., Esomeprazole, Lansoprazole).
  • Nelfinavir: Do NOT take Omefast if you are taking Nelfinavir (used for HIV infection).

Side Effects of Omefast 20mg

  • Common: Headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, nausea, or flatulence (gas).
  • Serious but Rare: Severe allergic reactions, persistent diarrhea (risk of C. diff infection), or signs of low magnesium (tremors/dizziness) with long-term use.
  • Action: If you experience an unexplained skin rash, joint pain, or severe watery diarrhea, stop use and contact your doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Masking Symptoms: PPIs can mask the symptoms of more serious gastric conditions. If you experience unintended weight loss, persistent vomiting, or difficulty swallowing, see a doctor immediately.
  • Bone Health: Long-term use (over a year) may slightly increase the risk of bone fractures. Ensure adequate Calcium and Vitamin D intake.
  • Vitamin B12: Long-term acid suppression can reduce the absorption of Vitamin B12.

searchable.name: EMAL INJECTION 150MG
searchable.brief_info: E MAL INJECTION 2MLS X3 is an antimalarial medicine used in the treatment of malaria in both adults and children.
searchable.description: Emal Injection 150mg is a rapid-acting antimalarial treatment containing Arteether, a semi-synthetic derivative of artemisinin. This injectable medication is specifically designed for the treatment of severe malaria, including cerebral malaria, where oral administration is not feasible or rapid intervention is critical. Emal is a trusted choice in clinical settings for its ability to quickly reduce the parasite load in the blood, providing a lifeline in life-threatening situations.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Emal Injection 150mg

This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM). Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician.

  • Administration: Administered via Deep Intramuscular (IM) Injection only. It should never be given intravenously.
  • Typical Regimen: Usually administered once daily for 3 consecutive days, though the doctor will determine the exact duration based on clinical response.
  • Food/Drink: Administration is not affected by food, as it bypasses the digestive system.

How to Store and Dispose

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect the ampoule from light.
  • Disposal: Used needles and empty glass ampoules must be disposed of in a puncture-proof "sharps container" to prevent injury and environmental contamination.

Quick Tips for Emal Injection 150mg

  • Site Rotation: If multiple injections are needed, rotate the injection site (e.g., different sides of the gluteal muscle) to reduce soreness.
  • Rest: The patient should remain lying down for at least 30 minutes after the injection to manage potential dizziness.
  • Oral Follow-up: Always ensure the patient completes the follow-up oral antimalarial course as prescribed by the doctor.
  • Hydration: Ensure the patient receives adequate intravenous or oral fluids during the recovery period.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Single 2ml ampoule (or as specified on the pack).
  • Strength: 150mg per 2ml.
  • Form: Oily Liquid for Injection.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Emal Injection 150mg

  • Hypersensitivity: Do not use if the patient has a known allergy to artemisinin derivatives.
  • First Trimester: Should be used during the first trimester of pregnancy only if the life-saving benefit outweighs the potential risk to the fetus.
  • Children: Use with extreme caution and precise weight-based dosing in infants and young children.

Side Effects of Emal Injection 150mg

  • Common: Nausea, dizziness, headache, and pain/redness at the injection site.
  • Serious but Rare: Heart rhythm changes (QT prolongation), transient reduction in white blood cell count, or elevated liver enzymes.
  • Action: Monitoring by a healthcare professional is mandatory during administration to manage any adverse reactions immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Inpatient Care: This medication must only be administered in a hospital or clinic setting by a trained professional.
  • Complete Treatment: Once the patient is able to swallow, the physician may switch to a full course of oral ACT (Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy) to ensure the infection does not return.
  • Neurological Check: Patients with cerebral malaria should be monitored closely for neurological recovery.

searchable.description: Product Description: Amatem Softgel is an Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy (ACT), Amatem Softgel provides a powerful, dual-action approach to rapidly clear the malaria parasite from the bloodstream, helping to resolve fever and symptoms quickly. searchable.how_to_use:

  • Administration: Swallow the softgel capsules whole.
  • Best Time to Take It: Always take Amatem Softgel with food or a milky drink. This improves absorption.

searchable.specification: Pack Size: Amatem Softgel x 24 is supplied in blister packs of 24 softgel capsules.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Amatem Softgel: Do NOT take Amatem Softgel if you:

  • Are allergic to artemether, lumefantrine, or any components of the softgel.
  • Are in the first trimester of pregnancy.
  • Have a known severe heart condition (e.g., QTc prolongation or arrhythmia).
  • Have severe liver or kidney impairment.

Side Effects of Amatem Softgel:

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, and joint/muscle aches.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Palpitations (fast or pounding heartbeats). Seek medical attention immediately if you experience dizziness, fainting, or signs of a severe skin rash.

Precautions and Warnings of Amatem Softgel:

  • Before Starting: Inform your doctor if you are taking any other medications, especially those that affect the heart rhythm (CYP2D6 metabolism, e.g., certain antidepressants).

searchable.name: Piriton Expectorant for children Evans Baroque 100ml
searchable.brief_info: Piriton Expectorant is a specially formulated linctus designed to relieve chesty (productive) coughs and the distressing symptoms of the common cold or upper respiratory allergies in children. By combining an antihistamine with an expectorant, it helps to loosen stubborn phlegm while calming the sneezing and runny nose that often accompany a cough.
searchable.description: Piriton Expectorant is a palatable liquid medication that targets the discomfort of a "wet" cough. Unlike simple cough suppressants, this expectorant formula works to make coughing more productive by thinning bronchial secretions, making it easier for the child to clear mucus from their airways. Simultaneously, the antihistamine component provides relief from allergic triggers and catarrh, helping your child breathe more comfortably and rest better.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Piriton Expectorant Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician.

  • Children 6 to 12 years: 5ml (one teaspoonful) up to 3 or 4 times daily.
  • Children 2 to 6 years: 2.5ml (half a teaspoonful) up to 3 or 4 times daily.
  • Children under 2 years: Not recommended except under strict medical advice.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Use a calibrated medicine spoon or syringe to ensure an accurate dose.
  • Consistency: Space doses evenly throughout the day.
  • Food Interaction: Can be taken with or without food. Taking it with water can further help thin the mucus.
  • Missed Dose: Give the dose as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for the next dose, skip the missed one. Never double the dose.

How to Store and Dispose of Piriton Expectorant

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from direct sunlight. Keep the bottle tightly closed.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return any unused or expired syrup to a local pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Piriton Expectorant

  • Hydration is Key: Encourage your child to drink plenty of water while taking this medicine; fluids help the expectorant work better at thinning phlegm.
  • Bedtime Use: Be aware that the antihistamine may cause mild drowsiness, which can help a child rest if a cough is keeping them awake at night.
  • Not for Dry Coughs: This is for "wet" coughs. If your child has a dry, hacking cough without mucus, a different formula may be needed.
  • Duration: If the cough persists for more than 5 days or is accompanied by a high fever, consult a pediatrician.

Side Effects of Piriton Expectorant

Precautions and Warnings

  • Drowsiness: Warn older children to be careful if riding bicycles or engaging in activities requiring balance, as the medicine can cause "sleepiness."
  • Liver/Kidney Health: Use with caution if the child has pre-existing liver or kidney issues.

searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Nurofen Suspension for Children 100mL

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) medicine. Dosage depends on the child's weight/age. Always follow the instructions on the package insert (PIL) exactly.

  • Infants (3 to 6 months - typically 5-7 kg): Usually 2.5 mL (50 mg) up to 3 times in 24 hours.
  • Children (6 to 12 months - typically 7-10 kg): Usually 2.5 mL (50 mg) up to 3 to 4 times in 24 hours.
  • Children (1 to 3 years - typically 10-15 kg): Usually 5 mL (100 mg) up to 3 times in 24 hours.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Shake the bottle thoroughly. Use the provided oral syringe or measuring spoon to measure the exact dose. Administer orally.
  • Best Time to Take: The suspension can be taken on an empty stomach for faster effect, but taking it with or after food is recommended to minimize the chance of stomach upset.
  • Missed Dose Guidance: If a dose is missed, administer the dose as soon as you remember. Ensure there is the minimum required time gap (usually 6-8 hours) before the next dose. Do not give a double dose.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Nurofen Suspension for Children 100mL

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT administer if the child has a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Ibuprofen, aspirin, or any other Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs), or any of the inactive ingredients.
  • Asthma: Do not give to children who have experienced asthma, hives (urticaria), or a severe runny nose after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs (NSAID-exacerbated respiratory disease).
  • Gastrointestinal Issues: Children with a history of stomach ulcers, bleeding, or perforation related to previous NSAID use should not take this product.
  • Heart/Kidney/Liver Disease: Use with caution and only under a doctor's supervision if the child has severe heart, kidney, or liver failure.
  • Age/Weight Restriction: Check the packaging for the minimum age and weight threshold for use (usually suitable from 3 to 6 months of age and above).

Side Effects of Nurofen Suspension for Children 100mL

Side effects are uncommon when used as directed, but parents should be aware of potential reactions:

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild stomach upset, nausea, vomiting, or indigestion.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): Signs of stomach bleeding (black, tarry stools, or vomiting blood), severe allergic reaction (rash, difficulty breathing, swelling of the face/tongue), or signs of kidney problems (decreased urination). If any serious symptoms occur, stop use immediately and seek emergency medical attention.

Precautions and Warnings of Nurofen Suspension for Children 100mL

  • Dosage Accuracy (Crucial): Always measure the dose accurately using the syringe or measuring spoon provided. Dosage is based strictly on the child's weight and/or age.
  • Consult Doctor: Consult a doctor if the child is taking other medications, especially other NSAIDs, anticoagulants (blood thinners), or diuretics. Do not combine with other Ibuprofen or Aspirin products.
  • Duration: Do not use for more than 3 days for fever or pain without consulting a doctor. Prolonged use or high doses can increase the risk of side effects.
  • Dehydration: Be cautious if the child is severely dehydrated, as Ibuprofen may temporarily affect kidney function. Ensure adequate fluid intake.

Shaking: Always shake the bottle well before drawing up the dose.

searchable.famasi_advice:
How Levofem Works

Levofem works by preventing ovulation, thickening cervical mucus to block sperm entry, and thinning the uterine lining to prevent implantation. These mechanisms together ensure effective contraception.

Mode of Action of Levofem

Levofem’s active ingredients, levonorgestrel and ethinylestradiol, mimic natural hormones to regulate reproductive functions. Levonorgestrel suppresses luteinizing hormone (LH) to prevent ovulation, while ethinylestradiol maintains hormonal balance to prevent breakthrough bleeding and irregular cycles.

Interactions of Levofem

Drug Interactions:

  • Antibiotics (e.g., rifampin, tetracyclines) – May reduce effectiveness.
  • Anticonvulsants (e.g., carbamazepine, phenytoin) – May interfere with hormone metabolism.
  • HIV/AIDS Medications (e.g., ritonavir, efavirenz) – May reduce contraceptive efficacy.

Food Interactions:

  • Grapefruit juice may affect hormone levels.

Alcohol and Smoking:

  • Smoking increases the risk of cardiovascular side effects.
  • Excessive alcohol consumption may increase the likelihood of nausea and vomiting.

Additional Information about Levofem

  • Good to Know: Levofem also helps in reducing acne and menstrual pain.
  • Allergy Information: Contains synthetic hormones; avoid if allergic to levonorgestrel or ethinylestradiol.
  • Recommended Frequency of Use: Once daily for 21 days, with a 7-day break before starting a new pack.

Frequently Asked Questions about Levofem

  1. How long does Levofem take to work?
    • It takes 7 days for full contraceptive protection if starting mid-cycle.
  2. Can I take Levofem with my current medication?
    • Consult your doctor for possible drug interactions.
  3. Is Levofem safe for long-term use?
    • Yes, but periodic health check-ups are recommended.
  4. Can pregnant or breastfeeding women use Levofem?
    • No, Levofem is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
  5. What should I do if I miss a dose?
    • Take the missed pill immediately and follow instructions for multiple missed doses.
  6. Are there any natural alternatives to Levofem?
    • Natural family planning and barrier methods are alternatives, but they are less effective.

Active Ingredient in Regaine for Women

The active ingredient is Minoxidil (2%).

  • Mechanism of Action: Minoxidil acts as a vasodilator, enhancing blood flow to the hair follicles.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • How long until I see results? It usually takes between 12 and 24 weeks of twice-daily application.

searchable.how_to_use:
• Consult with your doctor.
  • Before you start the treatment, read the manufacturer's printed information leaflet from the pack. It will give you more information about minoxidil, and will also provide you with a full list of the side-effects which you could experience from using it.
  • Make sure your hair and scalp are dry before you apply minoxidil. It is recommended that you leave about an hour between washing your hair and applying the preparation.
  • If you are using minoxidil solution (brand name Regaine® for Women Regular Strength), there will be a spray pump applicator and an extended spray-tip applicator inside the pack. The spray pump applicator is suitable for applying the solution to large areas, whereas the additional extended spray tip is needed for applying the solution to small areas. Six sprays of the pump release a 1 ml dose. After each spray, gently rub in the solution by massaging your scalp with your fingers. Apply 1 ml (six pumps of spray) twice a day, preferably morning and evening. Remember to wash your hands after using the solution so it doesn't get on to other areas of your skin, or on to other people.
  • If you are using minoxidil foam (brand name Regaine® for Women Once a Day), apply 1 g of foam (half a capful) to the affected area of your scalp once a day. To do this, turn the can upside down and direct the nozzle in to your hand. Press the nozzle until you have the equivalent of half a capful of foam in your hand. Use your fingertips to gently massage the foam into the affected area of scalp. Remember to wash your hands after using the foam so it doesn't get on to other areas of your skin, or on to other people.
  • If you forget to use your minoxidil preparation at the usual time, do not worry, just apply it as normal when it is next due. Only use the correct amount - do not double up to make up for missing an application.

  • Storage and Disposal

    Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep the bottle tightly closed and away from children. Dispose of the container safely according to local waste regulations.

    Quick Tips
    • Consistency: Results typically appear after 4 months of continuous use.
    • Gentle Massage: Use your fingertips to massage the solution gently into the scalp.
    • Wash Hands: Always wash your hands thoroughly after application.
    • Styling: You can use hair spray or styling products after the solution has completely dried.
searchable.famasi_advice:

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding.
  • Have hair loss that is sudden, patchy, or unexplained.

  • Are under 18 or over 65 years of age.
  • Are allergic to Minoxidil or any other ingredients in the solution.

Side Effects

  • Common: Scalp irritation, itching, or temporary "shedding" during the first few weeks of use as new hair replaces old strands.
  • Serious (Rare): Unwanted facial hair growth, rapid heartbeat, or dizziness. If these occur, stop use immediately and consult a healthcare professional.

Precautions and Warnings

  • During Use: Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs.

searchable.description: Acneaway Cream is a powerful dermatological cream that features a unique three-way combination of active ingredients: an anti-inflammatory corticosteroid, an antifungal agent, and an antibiotic. Although the name suggests a focus on acne, this cream is primarily formulated to tackle inflammatory skin conditions where there is a concurrent risk or presence of bacterial and fungal infection. The synergy of these ingredients provides targeted relief from redness, itching, and swelling, while simultaneously clearing the underlying infections. searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Acneaway Cream

Acneaway Cream is a Prescription Only Medicine (POM).

Apply to the affected area once to several times daily as directed by the Physician.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical (External Use Only).
  • How to Use:
    1. Cleanse and gently dry the affected skin area thoroughly before application.
    2. Apply a thin layer of Acneaway Cream to the entire affected area.
    3. Gently rub the cream in until it is fully absorbed.
  • Timing: Typically applied once or twice daily, as advised by your doctor, depending on the severity of the infection and inflammation.
searchable.specification: The active ingredients are Triamcinolone Acetonide (corticosteroid), Econazole Nitrate (antifungal), and Gentamicin Sulphate (antibiotic). It is supplied as a topical cream in a tube (typically 20g). It is a Prescription Only Medicine (POM).
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Acneaway Cream

Do NOT use Acneaway Cream if you:

  • Have a known hypersensitivity or allergy to Triamcinolone, Econazole, Gentamicin, or any other aminoglycoside antibiotic (like Neomycin) or any component of the formulation.
  • Have viral skin infections, such as Herpes Simplex, Chickenpox (Varicella), Shingles (Herpes Zoster), or Cowpox (Vaccinia).
  • Have Tuberculosis cutis or Syphilis skin manifestations.
  • Have severe burns or open ulcers.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor. The safety of the corticosteroid and antibiotic components during pregnancy has not been definitively established. Use should only occur if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus, particularly avoiding large areas or prolonged use.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. It is unknown if topical ingredients are absorbed in sufficient amounts to pass into breast milk. Use only under medical supervision, avoiding application to the breast area.

Side Effects of Acneaway Cream

Side effects can occur, particularly with prolonged use or use under occlusive dressings.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild to moderate local irritation (e.g., erythema and pruritus/itching) at the application site.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Steroid-related Symptoms (Long-term therapy): Skin atrophy (thinning), striae (stretch marks), purpura (bruising), telangiectasis (spider veins), and steroidal acne.
    • Systemic Corticosteroid Effects: Long-term, extensive use may lead to systemic absorption, causing suppressed reactions to skin tests, increased sweating, or hirsutism (excess hair growth).
    • Bacterial/Fungal Superinfection: Overgrowth of non-susceptible organisms.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • For mild, temporary irritation, continue use as directed. If it persists or worsens, consult your doctor.
  • If you notice signs of skin thinning, persistent rash, or any systemic symptoms, discontinue use and contact your doctor immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Acneaway Cream

  • Prescription Only: This cream should be used only under the direction of a physician.
  • Duration of Use: Due to the steroid component, Acneaway Cream should typically be used for short periods only (e.g., usually not more than 7-14 days), unless otherwise directed by your doctor.
  • Occlusion: Do not use occlusive dressings (bandages, tight clothing) over the treated area unless specifically instructed by your physician, as this significantly increases the absorption of the corticosteroid and the risk of side effects.
  • Facial Use: Use with extreme caution on the face, as the skin is thinner and more prone to steroid side effects (like atrophy and acne).
  • Avoid Eyes: For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes.
  • Discontinue Use: If superinfection or signs of systemic absorption occur, the cream should be stopped immediately.

searchable.name: Aeroline Salbutamol Inhaler
searchable.brief_info: Aeroline is a rapid-onset bronchodilator inhaler used for the immediate relief of breathing difficulties. Containing Salbutamol (100mcg per puff), it is commonly referred to as a "reliever" inhaler. Aeroline works by quickly opening up the airways in the lungs, making it an essential treatment for individuals managing asthma, bronchitis, or other conditions that cause wheezing and shortness of breath.
searchable.description: Aeroline is a pressurized metered-dose inhaler (pMDI) that delivers medication directly to the lungs. It acts within minutes to relax the muscles in the walls of the small air passages in the lungs. This helps to keep the bronchial tubes open, easing chest tightness and allowing for easier airflow during a sudden flare-up or "asthma attack."
searchable.how_to_use:
Application Instructions

  1. Prepare: Remove the mouthpiece cover and shake the inhaler well.
  2. Exhale: Breathe out as much as is comfortable, away from the inhaler.
  3. Position: Place the mouthpiece in your mouth between your teeth and close your lips around it.
  4. Inhale & Press: Start to breathe in slowly and deeply. Just after starting to breathe in, press the top of the canister to release one puff.
  5. Hold: Remove the inhaler and hold your breath for 10 seconds (or as long as comfortable) to allow the medicine to settle in the lungs.
  6. Wait: If you need a second puff, wait about 30–60 seconds before repeating the steps.

Proper Usage Tips

  • Cleaning: Clean your inhaler once a week. Remove the metal canister and wash the plastic actuator in warm soapy water, rinse, and air dry.
  • Prime Your Inhaler: If the inhaler is new or hasn't been used for 5 days or more, "prime" it by spraying two puffs into the air away from your face.
  • Spacers: If you find it difficult to coordinate breathing and pressing the inhaler, ask your pharmacist about using a spacer device.

How to Store and Dispose of Aeroline

  • Storage: Store in a cool place (below 30°C) away from direct sunlight. Do not freeze.
  • Safety: The canister is pressurized; do not puncture or burn it even when empty.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return finished inhalers to your local pharmacy for safe disposal.
searchable.specification:
• Dose Count: Usually 200 metered doses per canister.
  • Strength: 100mcg per puff.
  • Type: Short-acting Bronchodilator.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to Salbutamol.
  • Heart Conditions: Consult your doctor if you have a history of high blood pressure, irregular heartbeats (arrhythmia), or heart disease.

Side Effects of Aeroline

  • Common: A slight tremor (shaky hands), headache, or a fast/pounding heartbeat (palpitations). These usually pass quickly.
  • Action: If you feel a sudden increase in wheezing immediately after use (paradoxical bronchospasm), stop use and seek emergency medical help.

Precautions and Warnings

  • "Reliever" vs. "Preventer": Aeroline only provides temporary relief. If you need to use your reliever inhaler more than three times a week, your asthma may not be well-controlled, and you should see your doctor to discuss a "preventer" (steroid) inhaler.
  • Diabetes/Thyroid: Use with caution if you have an overactive thyroid or diabetes.
  • Pregnancy: Generally considered safe for use during pregnancy when needed, but always keep your doctor informed.

Do NOT take Ulgicid Suspension if you have:

searchable.how_to_use:
Usage Instructions

General Use:

  • Wear Time: Use for up to 4-8 hours of continuous use or until visibly soiled or damp.
  • Handling: Wash or sanitize hands before putting on the mask and immediately after taking it off.
  • Proper Administration (Putting On): Hold the mask by the ear loops. Place a loop around each ear. Mold the stiff edge (nose clip) to the shape of your nose. Pull the bottom edge over your chin.
  • Best Time: Wear whenever in close proximity to others in shared or indoor spaces.
  • Missed Use Guidance: If you forget your mask, find a new, clean disposable one before entering an area where social distancing is difficult.

searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Disposable Face Mask Pack

Do NOT use a disposable mask if:

  • Breathing Difficulty: The wearer has trouble breathing or is unable to remove the mask without assistance.
  • Age Restrictions: Do not use on children under the age of 2 years.
  • Oxygen Therapy: The mask interferes with the prescribed use of oxygen delivery devices.

Side Effects of Disposable Face Mask Pack

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Minor facial irritation, fogging of eyeglasses, and mild heat buildup under the mask.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Allergic reaction to the mask material (e.g., fabric dyes), causing localized rash or swelling.
  • What to do: If skin irritation persists, try another type of mask. If you experience difficulty breathing, remove the mask immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Disposable Face Mask Pack

  • Single Use Only: NEVER reuse a disposable mask. Dispose of it after a single use (or if it becomes dirty or wet).
  • Proper Fit: The mask must cover the mouth, nose, and chin fully, and the nose clip should be pinched firmly over the bridge of the nose.

Handling: Always handle the mask by the ear loops or ties. Avoid touching the front of the mask, as it is considered contaminated.

How Baobab Glow-C Serum Works

Baobab Glow-C Serum combines stable vitamin C with baobab and niacinamide to combat dullness and uneven tone. Vitamin C blocks melanin formation and promotes collagen, while baobab calms inflammation and hydrates the skin, resulting in brighter and smoother skin over time.


Mode of Action of Baobab Glow-C Serum

Vitamin C (sodium ascorbyl phosphate) inhibits tyrosinase, an enzyme involved in melanin synthesis. Niacinamide strengthens the skin barrier and reduces inflammation. Baobab extract delivers essential fatty acids and antioxidants, neutralizing free radicals and protecting skin cells. The serum penetrates the upper dermis, stimulating collagen and elastin synthesis while improving moisture retention.




Interactions of Baobab Glow-C Serum

6. What should I do if I miss a day of use?
 Just continue with your regular routine the next day. No need to double the dose.

7. Will this make my skin photosensitive?
 Vitamin C can increase sensitivity slightly, so always wear SPF during the day.

8. Can I use it under makeup?
 Yes. It creates a smooth base and adds a natural glow to the skin.

Dosage of SHALTOUX CHESTY COUGH SYRUP

Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician. The dosage is based on age and should be measured accurately (1 teaspoonful approxmatiely 5 mL; 1 tablespoon 15 mL.

  • Adults and pediatric patients over 12 years of age: The usual starting dose is 1 tablespoonful (15 mL) three times a day.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow the syrup orally.

searchable.famasi_advice:
Side Effects of SHALTOUX CHESTY COUGH SYRUP

Side effects are generally related to the bronchodilator component (Salbutamol).

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Nervousness, shakiness, fine muscle tremor (especially in the hands), headache, dizziness, nausea, and vomiting. These are usually mild and subside with continued use.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (Requires Medical Attention): Palpitations (fast, pounding, or irregular heartbeat), sudden chest pain, severe skin rash, or signs of a serious allergic reaction (swelling, difficulty breathing).
  • What to do if side effects occur: If you experience severe chest pain, severe palpitations, or any sign of an allergic reaction, stop taking the syrup and seek immediate medical attention.

Precautions and Warnings of SHALTOUX CHESTY COUGH SYRUP

  • Before Starting SHALTOUX: Inform your doctor if you have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid), diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular problems (including angina or high blood pressure), or if you are taking monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) or tricyclic antidepressants.
  • During Use: Avoid combining this product with other medications containing similar ingredients (bronchodilators, cough suppressants, or expectorants) to prevent accidental overdose.
  • Driving/Operating Machinery: Side effects like dizziness, nervousness, or tremor may impair the ability to drive or operate machinery. Exercise caution.

searchable.brief_info: Ulgicid suspension is used for gastric reflux, toxicity, stomach acid, Gastric problems, stomach upset, heart burn and acid related indigestion.
searchable.description: Ulgicid Suspension is a high-performance formula that offers three layers of defense against common stomach and digestive complaints. It doesn't just treat the symptoms; it works in multiple ways to restore comfort. The blend of Aluminium and Magnesium salts provides quick and balanced acid neutralization, while Alginic Acid physically blocks acid reflux. This combined approach makes Ulgicid a comprehensive solution for managing stomach acidity and related discomfort.
searchable.how_to_use:
Proper Usage and Dosing

Ulgicid Suspension is an over-the-counter (OTC) medicine, but it is important to follow dosage instructions.

  • Proper Administration: Shake the bottle thoroughly before pouring the dose. Measure the exact amount using a measuring spoon or cup. Ulgicid is taken orally.
  • Dosage: The recommended dosage for adults is typically 10–20 mL (two to four teaspoonfuls) three or four times daily, or as required.
  • Frequency: Best taken after meals and at bedtime, or whenever symptoms occur. Do not exceed four doses daily unless specifically directed by a doctor.
  • Missed Dose Guidance: Since Ulgicid is an on-demand medication for symptoms, there is no risk in missing a dose. Simply take the next dose when symptoms return.
searchable.specification:
What’s in the Box:

  • 1 × Ulgicid Suspension Bottle (Commonly 200 mL)
  • 1 × Measuring Device (for accurate dosing)
  • 1 × Patient Information Leaflet (PIL)
  • Active Ingredients (per specified volume, e.g., 10 mL):
    • Activated Dimethicone: 125 mg
    • Alginic Acid: 200 mg
    • Dried Aluminium Hydroxide: 25 mg
    • Magnesium Hydroxide: 250 mg
    • Magnesium Trisilicate: 250 mg

Product Category: Over-The-Counter (OTC) / Pharmacy Medicine
searchable.famasi_advice:
Pharmacist Advice (Contraindications and Warnings)

Contraindications (Usage Restrictions)

Do NOT take Ulgicid Suspension if you have:

  • Allergy: Hypersensitivity or allergy to any of the active or inactive ingredients (e.g., Alginic Acid, Aluminium/Magnesium salts, Dimethicone).
  • Kidney Failure: Severe kidney failure, as the body may struggle to excrete the Magnesium and Aluminium components, leading to potential toxicity.
  • Severely Debilitated Patients: Use should be avoided or closely monitored.
  • Age Restriction: Antacids are generally not recommended for children under 6 years of age unless explicitly instructed by a physician.

Device Function and Maintenance (Side Effects and Precautions)

  • Side Effects:
    • Common Side Effects: Changes in bowel habits. Aluminium tends to cause constipation, while Magnesium tends to cause diarrhea. The balanced formula is designed to minimize these effects, but they can still occur.
    • Serious Side Effects: Rare allergic reactions (rash, swelling, difficulty breathing) or signs of high levels of Aluminium/Magnesium (muscle weakness, confusion). Stop use and consult a doctor immediately.
  • Precautions:
    • Long-Term Use: Do not use for prolonged periods (more than 14 days) or in excessively high doses without medical advice, as this can lead to electrolyte disturbances (e.g., low phosphate levels) or accumulation of Aluminium.
    • Drug Interactions: Always observe the timing rule: take other medicines at least 1 hour before or 4 hours after Ulgicid to prevent reduced absorption of the other drug.
    • Underlying Conditions: If symptoms persist for more than 7 days, if you experience weight loss, or have difficulty swallowing, consult a doctor immediately to rule out a more serious underlying condition.

searchable.description:
CeraVe Micellar Cleansing Water is an ultra-gentle, no-rinse formula developed with dermatologists to be a 3-in-1 solution: it effectively cleanses, hydrates, and removes makeup without compromising the skin's protective barrier. This unique micellar water goes beyond simple cleansing by containing three essential Ceramides and Niacinamide. Choosing CeraVe Micellar Cleansing Water is the simple, kindest way to remove dirt, excess oils, and even long-wear makeup, leaving your skin feeling refreshed, clean, and healthy.

The CeraVe Micellar Cleansing Water utilizes micelle technology —tiny cleansing oil molecules suspended in soft water—that gently attract and lift away impurities and makeup without harsh rubbing. Unlike many micellar waters, this formula is fortified with CeraVe’s signature three essential Ceramides to help restore and maintain the skin’s natural barrier. This ensures that the skin remains hydrated and calm, making it perfectly suited for all skin types, including sensitive skin and sensitive eyes.
searchable.how_to_use:
CeraVe Micellar Cleansing Water is a leave-on cosmetic product.

  • Dosage: Saturate one cotton pad per area (eyes/face) as needed for cleansing.
  • Proper Administration: Apply the liquid to a cotton or reusable pad. No need to rub or rinse.
  • Best Time to Use: Morning (as a light cleanse) and Evening (as a first cleanse to remove makeup).
  • Missed Dose Guidance: Use as required for cleansing; there is no missed dose.
searchable.specification:

Renzo's Probiotic vitamin for kids is plant-based, allergy-friendly, and pediatrician-recommended for hassle-free daily gut health.

Dosage of Renzo's Probiotic vitamin for kids

Take as directed by your healthcare professional.

  • Children 2 to 3 years old: One (1) tablet daily.
  • Children 4 years of age and older: Two (2) tablets daily.

Administration

Best Time to Take It

searchable.name: Czocain Lidocaine Gel 2%
searchable.brief_info: C-Zocain Gel 30g Tube is a sterile, topical gel containing the active ingredient Lidocaine Hydrochloride which is a potent local anesthetic.
searchable.description: Czocain Gel 30g Tube is designed to provide rapid and temporary numbness or loss of feeling to mucous membranes and internal surfaces (e.g., the urethra) before a medical procedure. The gel formulation maximizes contact with the area, providing lubrication while stabilizing the nerve membrane to block pain signals. Czocain Gel is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM) used in clinical settings to manage procedure-related pain.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Czocain Gel

Czocain Gel is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM). Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician. The dosage is highly dependent on the area of application, the patient's size, and the procedure being performed. The lowest effective dose should be used to avoid high plasma levels and serious adverse effects.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Topical application to mucous membranes or internal surfaces. It is ineffective when applied to intact skin.
  • Procedure-Related Use: For urethral application, the gel is instilled directly into the urethra via the nozzle. For intubation, it is applied thinly to the end of the tube.
  • Missed Dose Guidance: This medication is typically used on an "as needed" basis for procedures; thus, missed dose guidance does not usually apply.
searchable.specification: Pack Size: Czocain Gel is typically supplied as a 2% Lidocaine Hydrochloride Gel in a 30g collapsible tube.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Czocain Gel

Do NOT use Czocain Gel if the patient:

  • Drug Allergies: Has a known hypersensitivity or allergy to Lidocaine Hydrochloride or any other amide-type local anesthetic.
  • Pre-existing Conditions: Has pre-existing severe conditions that can increase the risk of systemic toxicity, such as severe heart block, severe shock, or severe trauma/sepsis near the application site.
  • Age Restrictions: Should be used with extreme caution in children, particularly infants under 3 years of age.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Use with caution. Consult a doctor before use, as lidocaine is excreted in breast milk. Use should only be considered if the expected benefit outweighs the potential risk.

Side Effects of Czocain Gel

Side effects are usually limited to the application site when used correctly. Serious side effects typically occur due to excessive systemic absorption.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Temporary local skin reactions at the application site, including mild irritation, redness, pallor (paleness), swelling, or a burning sensation.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (Requires Medical Attention):
    • Systemic Toxicity (CNS/Cardio): Dizziness, drowsiness, confusion, blurred or double vision, ringing in the ears (tinnitus), nervousness, tremors, seizures, slow or irregular heartbeat, or hypotension (low blood pressure).
    • Methemoglobinemia (Blood Disorder): Pale, gray, or blue-colored skin, lips, or nails; shortness of breath, headache, or unusual tiredness. This is rare but serious.
    • Allergic Reactions: Severe rash, hives, difficulty breathing, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat.
  • What to do if side effects occur: If any signs of serious systemic toxicity or an allergic reaction occur, stop application immediately and seek emergency medical attention.

Precautions and Warnings of Czocain Gel

  • Before Starting Czocain Gel: Inform your doctor if the patient has underlying health issues, including severe liver disease, heart problems, or a history of a blood disorder like methemoglobinemia or G6PD deficiency.
  • During Use: Avoid application to large, open wounds, broken skin, or burned areas unless specifically instructed by a physician, as this increases systemic absorption. Avoid applying heat to the area after use, as this can also increase absorption.
  • Drug Interactions: Inform your doctor of all other medications, especially those known to induce methemoglobinemia (e.g., certain nitrates, sulfonamides) or other local anesthetics, as concurrent use increases risk.
  • Cerebral Malaria: High doses of topical lidocaine have been associated with CNS excitation.

searchable.name: Shaltoux 4-Way Relief Cough Syrup 100ml
searchable.brief_info: SHALTOUX 4-WAY RELIEF COUGH SYRUP 100ML is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) syrup specifically formulated to target multiple symptoms associated with the common cold, flu, allergies, and mild respiratory irritation.

This four-way action works to relieve coughs, soothe the throat, manage allergic symptoms like sneezing and watery eyes, and help clear mucus from the chest and nasal passages, providing effective temporary relief for both dry and wet cough symptoms triggered by irritation.

Dosage of SHALTOUX 4-WAY RELIEF COUGH SYRUP

Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician. The dosage is based on age and should be measured accurately (1 teaspoonful approx 5mL).

  • Adults and children above 12 years: 15 mL (1 tablespoonful) three times daily.
  • Children 6 to 12 years: 5 mL (1 teaspoonful) three times daily.
  • Children 2 to 6 years: Only use as per your physician's recommendation.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow the syrup orally.
  • Best Time to Take It: Can be taken with or without food. Due to drowsiness, consider taking the evening dose close to bedtime.
  • Missed Dose Guidance: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for the next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not take a double dose.
searchable.specification: Pack Size: SHALTOUX 4-WAY RELIEF COUGH SYRUP is supplied in a 100 mL bottle.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of SHALTOUX 4-WAY RELIEF COUGH SYRUP

Do NOT take SHALTOUX 4-WAY RELIEF COUGH SYRUP if you:

  • Drug Allergies: Are allergic (hypersensitive) to Diphenhydramine, Ammonium Chloride, Sodium Citrate, Menthol, or any component of the syrup.
  • Other Conditions: Have severe liver disease, narrow-angle glaucoma, an enlarged prostate (prostatic hypertrophy), or have difficulty urinating, as the antihistamine can worsen these conditions.
  • Taking MAOIs: Are currently taking or have taken Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors (MAOIs) within the last 14 days (certain antidepressants).

Side Effects of SHALTOUX 4-WAY RELIEF COUGH SYRUP

Side effects are mainly due to the antihistamine component.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Drowsiness (somnolence), dizziness, headache, dry mouth or throat, blurred vision, and difficulty concentrating.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (Requires Medical Attention): Palpitations or a very fast heart rate, severe confusion, hallucinations, or signs of a severe allergic reaction (rash, swelling, severe dizziness, difficulty breathing).
  • What to do if side effects occur: If you experience severe drowsiness that is disruptive, or any of the serious side effects listed, stop taking the syrup and consult a doctor immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of SHALTOUX 4-WAY RELIEF COUGH SYRUP

  • Before Starting SHALTOUX: Inform your doctor if you have asthma, chronic bronchitis, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), heart disease, high blood pressure, or diabetes.
  • During Use: Exercise caution, as this syrup may cause thickening of bronchial secretions, which is problematic for patients with severe respiratory illnesses.
  • Pediatric Use: Avoid using in children under 2 years of age unless explicitly directed by a physician, due to the risk of serious side effects from cold and cough medications in this age group.

Precautions and Warnings of Eucerin 5% Urea Repair Plus Cream

searchable.description: Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL is sourced from the liver of fresh cod fish, this pure liquid formula is an easy and effective way to bridge nutritional gaps in your diet. searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) product.

  • Adults and Children over 5 years: Take 10mL (two 5mL spoonfuls) daily.
  • Children 1-5 years: Take 5mL (one 5mL spoonful) daily.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL is for oral administration only. Use a measuring spoon or cup to ensure the correct dosage.
  • Best Time to Take: It can be taken at any time of the day, but taking it with or immediately after a meal can help reduce the potential for a fishy aftertaste and aids the absorption of the fat-soluble vitamins.
  • Missed Dose Guidance: If you miss a dose, simply take the next dose at the usual time. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed one.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL

Do NOT take Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL if you:

  • Drug Allergies: Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to cod liver oil, fish products, or any of the inactive ingredients. Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL contains fish oil.
  • Pre-existing Conditions: Have hypercalcaemia (too much calcium in the blood), hypervitaminosis A or D (excessive levels of Vitamins A or D), or known blood clotting disorders.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings: While Omega-3s are beneficial, high doses of Vitamin A can be teratogenic (cause birth defects). Consult your doctor before using Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL during pregnancy or while breastfeeding to ensure safe dosage levels are maintained.

Side Effects of Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL

While generally well-tolerated at recommended doses, some individuals may experience side effects:

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): The most frequent side effects are a fishy aftertaste or "burps," mild nausea, acid reflux, or loose stools/diarrhea. Taking the oil with food, chilling it, or taking it right before bed can help minimize the fishy taste. These mild symptoms usually subside with continued use.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (Requires Medical Attention): These include signs of an allergic reaction (rash, hives, severe dizziness, swelling of the face/throat, trouble breathing), or signs of excessive Vitamin A or D (e.g., severe headache, joint pain, peeling skin). If any serious side effects occur, stop use immediately and seek emergency medical attention.

Precautions and Warnings of Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL

  • Before Starting Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL: Consult your doctor or pharmacist if you are taking blood thinners (anticoagulants), blood pressure medication, or other vitamin supplements containing high levels of Vitamin A or D, as Cod Liver Oil may interact with these.
  • During Use: Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Overconsumption, especially when combined with other supplements, can lead to Vitamin A or D toxicity over time.
  • Long-term Safety Considerations: For individuals on long-term daily supplementation with Ayrtons Pure Cod Liver Oil 150mL, periodic health checks with your physician are advisable to monitor blood levels of fat-soluble Vitamins A and D.

searchable.description: CeraVe Skin Resurfacing Retinol Serum is specifically designed to address the lasting reminders of breakouts: post-acne marks (hyperpigmentation) and enlarged pores. searchable.how_to_use:

Proper Administration

searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of CeraVe Skin Resurfacing Retinol Serum

  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings: Retinoids are generally contraindicated (must be avoided) during pregnancy and breastfeeding due to potential risks. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your physician before use.
  • Pre-existing Skin Conditions: Do not apply to open wounds, severely compromised skin barriers, or areas with active eczema or rosacea flare-ups, as the retinol may cause significant irritation.
  • Allergies: Do not use if you have a known allergy to any ingredients, including Vitamin A derivatives (retinoids).

Side Effects of CeraVe Skin Resurfacing Retinol Serum

Retinoids require an adjustment period, even in gentle formulas like this one.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected - Retinization): Dryness, mild flaking, slight redness, or a temporary tingling sensation upon initial application. This is a sign the product is working and your skin is adjusting.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): Severe, persistent redness, blistering, or swelling. If irritation is prolonged, painful, or does not subside after reducing frequency, stop use and consult a dermatologist.
  • Acne Flare-up (Purging): Some individuals may experience a temporary increase in breakouts during the first few weeks as retinol speeds up the cell turnover process, bringing underlying blemishes to the surface faster. This usually subsides.

Precautions and Warnings of CeraVe Skin Resurfacing Retinol Serum

  • Sun Sensitivity: Retinol increases photosensitivity. Daily use of a broad-spectrum sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher) is mandatory while using this serum and for a week afterward, regardless of the weather.
  • Gradual Introduction: Start slowly! Use the serum 1-2 times per week for the first few weeks. Only gradually increase application frequency as your skin tolerance builds. Do not rush to daily use.
  • Combination Warning: Avoid using this serum at the same time (i.e., on the same evening) as other harsh chemical exfoliants (like high-concentration Glycolic or Salicylic Acids, or physical scrubs) to prevent over-exfoliation and damaging the skin barrier.
  • Application: Apply to cleansed, completely dry skin. Applying to damp skin can increase absorption and irritation. Avoid contact with eyes and lips.

searchable.name: Dr. Greg's S. Typhoid Test Kit IgG/IgM
searchable.brief_info: Dr. Greg's S. Typhoid Test Kit (IgG/IgM) is a rapid, single-use, in vitro diagnostic device designed for the swift detection and differentiation of antibodies against Salmonella typhi (the bacteria that causes Typhoid fever).
searchable.description: Dr. Greg's S. Typhoid Test Kit (IgG/IgM) is an easy-to-use kit that employs a rapid chromatographic immunoassay (lateral flow) to detect two specific types of antibodies—IgG and IgM—in a small sample of human whole blood, serum, or plasma. By identifying both early-stage (IgM) and later-stage/past-exposure (IgG) antibodies, the kit provides timely information to aid healthcare professionals in screening and making an informed decision for the management and treatment of suspected Typhoid infection.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Dr. Greg's S. Typhoid Test Kit

This is a diagnostic test kit, not a medication.

  • Dosage: Requires a single drop (approx. $40\text{ \mu L}$) of the patient's blood (whole blood, serum, or plasma) and the specified number of drops of the provided buffer solution, as detailed in the enclosed instructions.

Proper Administration

  • Preparation: Allow the test device, specimen, and buffer to equilibrate to room temperature (15 degree C – 30 degree C) before use.
  • Sample Collection: Clean the finger (e.g., middle or ring finger) with the alcohol swab. Puncture the skin with the sterile lancet and wipe away the first drop of blood. Gently squeeze the finger to obtain a small, rounded drop of blood.
  • Testing: Transfer the precise amount of blood/serum/plasma into the specimen well (S) of the cassette using the provided dropper/pipette, and immediately follow with the instructed number of drops of the buffer solution.
  • Reading: Start the timer and wait for the colored lines to appear. Read the result exactly at 15 minutes.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 1s (Single Test Kit)
  • Form: Rapid Diagnostic Test Cassette (Lateral Flow Immunoassay)
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Dr. Greg's S. Typhoid Test Kit

  • Severe Symptoms: This test is an aid to diagnosis, not a confirmation of disease severity. Do not rely on a test kit alone if severe symptoms are present; always consult a doctor immediately.
  • Testing Window: The test may not be reliable in the very early stages of the infection (first 3-5 days of fever) if antibody levels are too low to detect. A negative result in this window does not rule out Typhoid.

Side Effects of Dr. Greg's S. Typhoid Test Kit

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Minor and temporary discomfort or slight bleeding at the fingerstick site if whole blood is used.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): None associated with the kit itself. However, a false result (either positive or negative) can lead to serious consequences if treatment is delayed or unnecessary antibiotics are prescribed. Always correlate results with clinical symptoms.

Precautions and Warnings of Dr. Greg's S. Typhoid Test Kit

  • For Professional Use Only (IVD): This kit is generally intended for in vitro diagnostic (IVD) use only and should be used by trained personnel or under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
  • Biohazard: All components that come into contact with blood (cassette, lancet, pipette) are potentially biohazardous. Dispose of them in accordance with local regulations for infectious waste.
  • Procedural Integrity: Read the instructions entirely before performing the test. Results must be read within the specified time (usually 15 minutes). Do not read results after 20 minutes, as this may lead to inaccurate interpretation.
  • Lancet Use: Use the provided sterile lancet and alcohol swab correctly to minimize the risk of infection or incorrect sample collection.
  • Confirmation Needed: Any reactive (positive) result must be confirmed with alternative testing methods (like blood culture or the Widal test) and a full clinical evaluation by a registered medical practitioner.

searchable.name: Dr. Greg's Malaria P.f Antigen Home Test Kit
searchable.brief_info: The Dr. Greg's Malaria P.f Antigen Home Test Kit is a crucial rapid diagnostic tool designed for the fast and reliable detection of the deadly Plasmodium falciparum (P.f) parasite antigen in human blood.
searchable.description: The Dr. Greg's Malaria P.f Antigen Home Test Kit utilizes a lateral flow immunoassay to specifically detect the Histidine-Rich Protein 2 (HRP-2) antigen, which is unique to P. falciparum—the species responsible for the majority of severe malaria cases in Africa. Offering results in just 15 minutes, this easy-to-use kit allows individuals experiencing malaria symptoms (like fever, chills, and headache) to quickly screen for the infection. Early diagnosis with Dr. Greg's Malaria P.f Antigen Home Test Kit is essential for prompt treatment with Artemisinin-based Combination Therapies (ACTs), helping to prevent an uncomplicated case from progressing to severe, life-threatening disease.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Dr. Greg's Malaria P.f Antigen Home Test Kit

This is a diagnostic test kit, not a medication.

  • Dosage: Requires a tiny, precise amount of blood (e.g. 5 microliters, usually collected with a capillary tube or dropper) and the specified number of drops of the buffer solution.

Proper Administration

  • Preparation: Ensure all components are at room temperature (15 degree C – 30 degree C).
  • Sample Collection: Clean the finger (e.g., middle or ring finger) with the alcohol swab. Puncture the skin with the sterile lancet. Wipe away the first drop of blood. Collect the second drop using the provided pipette or dropper up to the marked line.
  • Testing: Add the precise blood volume to the specimen well (S) of the cassette, and then immediately add the specified number of drops of the buffer solution to the appropriate well (A or D).
  • Reading: Start the timer immediately. Read the result exactly at 15-20 minutes. Do not interpret the result after 30 minutes.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 1s (Single Test Kit)
  • Form: Rapid Diagnostic Test Cassette (Lateral Flow Immunoassay)
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Dr. Greg's Malaria P.f Antigen Home Test Kit

  • Unspecified Species: This kit is specifically for P. falciparum and may not detect other, less virulent species (P. vivax, ovale, malariae). If the test is negative but symptoms persist, malaria of another species cannot be ruled out.
  • Self-Treatment: This kit provides diagnostic information only. It is contraindicated to self-diagnose and begin antibiotic/antimalarial treatment without consulting a healthcare professional.

Side Effects of Dr. Greg's Malaria P.f Antigen Home Test Kit

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Minor and temporary discomfort or slight bleeding at the fingerstick site.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): The test itself has no serious physical side effects. However, a false negative result (if parasite density is too low) can lead to a delay in treatment, which is dangerous for P. falciparum infection.

Precautions and Warnings of Dr. Greg's Malaria P.f Antigen Home Test Kit

  • Biohazard: The entire kit, especially the lancet and test cassette, must be treated as potentially infectious material. Wear gloves, and wash hands thoroughly after the test.
  • HRP-2 Persistence (False Positives): HRP-2 antigen can persist in the blood for several weeks after the infection has been successfully treated and cleared. Therefore, a positive result may indicate a recent, cleared infection rather than a current, active one. Always correlate with clinical history.
  • Procedural Integrity: The accuracy of the test is highly dependent on precise adherence to instructions, including the exact volume of blood and buffer used, and the reading time.
  • Seek Immediate Care: Due to the risk posed by P. falciparum, regardless of the result, if high fever or other severe symptoms persist, seek medical attention immediately.
