searchable.name: Normagut Capsules
searchable.brief_info: Normagut contains Saccharomyces boulardii 250mg, a clinically studied friendly yeast trusted for restoring the balance of the intestinal flora, effectively treating and preventing various forms of diarrhea.
searchable.description: Normagut Probiotic Capsules contain a high concentration of freeze-dried Saccharomyces boulardii (at least $2.5\text{ billion}$ viable cells per $250\text{ mg}$ capsule), a unique probiotic yeast that is structurally different from common bacteria-based probiotics. This distinction gives it several advantages: notably, it is naturally resistant to antibiotics and gastric acid, ensuring that the beneficial yeast cells reach the intestines alive and fully functional. Normagut works powerfully to fight pathogenic organisms and neutralize their toxins, helping to restore the normal functioning of the intestinal lining and significantly reducing the duration and severity of diarrhea.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Normagut Probiotic Capsules

Normagut Probiotic Capsules is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) supplement.

Adults and children over 12 years: Take 1 capsule, 1-2 times a day, or as directed by a physician.

Children aged 2 to 12 years: Take 1 capsule, 1-2 times a day, or as directed by a physician.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral capsule (or mixed powder for children).
  • How to Take (Adults/Older Children): Swallow the capsule whole with water. Do not chew or crush.
  • How to Take (Younger Children): If the child cannot swallow the capsule, open the capsule and pour the contents into a small amount of water, milk, or juice. Ensure the child drinks the entire mixture.
  • Timing: Can be taken before, during, or after meals. If taking with antibiotics, space the doses out (e.g., take Normagut 2 hours after the antibiotic).

Missed Dose Guidance

  • If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
  • Continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose.
searchable.specification: The active ingredient is Freeze-dried Saccharomyces boulardii (250 mg, min. 2.5 billion viable cells). It is supplied as an oral capsule (or the contents as powder). Common pack sizes are 10 or 30 capsules. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Probiotic/Antidiarrhoeal.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Normagut Probiotic Capsules

Do NOT use Normagut Probiotic Capsules if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Saccharomyces boulardii (yeast) or any other component of the product (including lactose, if present).
  • Have a central venous catheter or are a severely immunocompromised patient (e.g., undergoing chemotherapy or living with HIV/AIDS), due to a rare but serious risk of fungemia (yeast in the bloodstream).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor. There is insufficient reliable information to definitively confirm its safety during pregnancy. It is advised to consult a physician before use.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. Use only under medical supervision.

Side Effects of Normagut Probiotic Capsules

Side effects are generally mild and localized to the digestive system.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Increased stomach gas, flatulence, or mild bloating, especially upon initial use. Rarely, headache or dry mouth.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Fungemia: Very rare cases of yeast infection in the bloodstream (fungemia) reported mainly in critically ill or immunocompromised patients.
    • Allergic Reactions: Rash, hives, swelling, or difficulty breathing.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • For common gas or bloating, if it persists or is bothersome, notify your doctor.
  • If diarrhea does not improve after 2 days of treatment, consult your doctor.
  • For any signs of a severe allergic reaction, stop the medication immediately and seek emergency medical attention.

Precautions and Warnings of Normagut Probiotic Capsules

  • Antifungals Interaction: Do NOT take Normagut simultaneously with oral or systemic antifungal medications (e.g., Fluconazole, Ketoconazole), as the antifungal will kill the Saccharomyces boulardii yeast, reducing its effectiveness. Separate the timing by a few hours, or consult your doctor.
  • Hydration: Normagut is a complement to therapy. It must be taken alongside adequate oral rehydration solution (ORS) or other fluids to restore lost electrolytes and prevent dehydration, especially during severe diarrhea.
  • Temperature Sensitivity: DO NOT mix the capsule contents with liquids or foods hotter than 50 degree C or too cold (ice water), or with alcohol, as this will destroy the live yeast cells.
  • Infants: For children under 2 years old, use only as directed by a doctor.

searchable.name: Olfen 75mg SR
searchable.brief_info: Olfen 75mg SR is a trusted medication containing Diclofenac Sodium, formulated for sustained release to provide consistent, all-day or all-night relief from pain, swelling, and stiffness associated with chronic inflammatory and rheumatic conditions.
searchable.description: Olfen 75mg SR Prolonged-Release Tablets contain the active ingredient Diclofenac Sodium, a potent Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drug (NSAID). The SR (Sustained Release) formulation is the key feature: it is designed to release the Diclofenac slowly and steadily into the bloodstream over a 10 to 12-hour period. This ensures long-lasting pain relief and anti-inflammatory action, often allowing for once-daily dosing. This sustained action is particularly beneficial for managing chronic conditions like arthritis, reducing pain and stiffness throughout the night and improving morning mobility.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Olfen 75mg SR Prolonged-Release Tablets

Olfen 75mg SR Tablets is a Prescription Only Medicine (POM).

Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician.

The usual daily dosage is one 75 mg prolonged-release tablet once or twice daily. For long-term treatment and chronic pain, one tablet (75 mg) taken once a day (often in the evening to combat morning stiffness) is usually sufficient.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral tablet (Sustained Release - SR).
  • How to Take: Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of milk or water. Do NOT crush, break, or chew the prolonged-release tablet, as this destroys the sustained-release mechanism and can lead to a dangerous overdose.
  • Timing: Typically taken once daily (morning or evening). Taking it with food or milk helps minimize stomach irritation. Taking it in the evening helps with night pain and morning stiffness.

Missed Dose Guidance

  • If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
  • If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose (e.g., within 10-12 hours), skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not take a double dose.
searchable.specification: The active ingredient is Diclofenac Sodium (75 mg). It is supplied as a prolonged-release (SR) oral tablet (Depotabs), typically in blister packs. It is a Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drug (NSAID) and is a Prescription Only Medicine (POM).
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Olfen 75mg SR Prolonged-Release Tablets

Do NOT take Olfen 75mg SR Tablets if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Diclofenac or any other NSAID (e.g., Aspirin, Ibuprofen).
  • Have a history of experiencing asthma, hives, or acute rhinitis (allergic reactions) after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs.
  • Have active or recurrent peptic ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, or perforation of the stomach or intestines.
  • Have severe heart failure (NYHA III-IV), established ischaemic heart disease, peripheral arterial disease, or cerebrovascular disease.
  • Are taking it for pain immediately before or after Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) surgery.
  • Have severe kidney impairment (renal failure) or severe liver failure.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor. This medication is CONTRAINDICATED in the last three months of pregnancy as it can harm the unborn baby's heart and kidneys. Use during the first two trimesters should only be on strict medical advice.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. Diclofenac passes into breast milk in small amounts. Use is generally avoided or used only under caution and supervision.

Side Effects of Olfen 75mg SR Prolonged-Release Tablets

Side effects can be serious, particularly with long-term use.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Gastrointestinal upset, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, indigestion, headache, dizziness, and mild skin rash.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Cardiovascular Events: Increased risk of heart attack (Myocardial Infarction) or stroke, especially with high doses or long-term use. Symptoms include chest pain, sudden weakness, or slurred speech.
    • Gastrointestinal Bleeding: Black, tarry stools, vomiting blood (looks like coffee grounds), or severe, persistent stomach pain.
    • Severe Allergic/Skin Reactions: Severe rash, blistering, peeling (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), swelling of the face/mouth, or difficulty breathing.
    • Kidney/Liver Problems: Swelling (oedema), unusual tiredness, dark urine, or yellowing of the skin/eyes (jaundice).

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you notice signs of stomach bleeding, chest pain, difficulty breathing, or any severe rash, stop the medication immediately and seek emergency medical attention.
  • For mild stomach upset, take the tablet with food or milk.

Precautions and Warnings of Olfen 75mg SR Prolonged-Release Tablets

  • Cardiovascular Risk: Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest possible duration to minimize the risk of serious cardiovascular events. If treatment lasts longer than 4 weeks, do not exceed 100 mg per day.
  • Gastrointestinal Risk: This medication increases the risk of GI bleeding and ulcers. Your doctor may prescribe a stomach-protectant medicine (e.g., a PPI) if you have a history of stomach problems or require long-term treatment.
  • Drug Interactions: Do NOT take with other NSAIDs (e.g., Ibuprofen, Naproxen, Aspirin). Inform your doctor if you are taking blood thinners (Warfarin), certain antidepressants (SSRIs), or diuretics.
  • Fluid Retention: Use with caution if you have hypertension (high blood pressure) or fluid retention, as NSAIDs can worsen these conditions.
  • Driving: Very occasionally, this medicine may cause dizziness or visual disturbances. Do not drive or operate machinery if affected.

searchable.name: PIC Hot water Bag
searchable.brief_info: The PIC Hot Water Bag, ribbed on both sides, is a premium, durable solution trusted for applying therapeutic heat evenly, effectively relieving muscle pain, aches, and promoting deep relaxation.
searchable.description: The PIC Hot Water Bag is a high-quality, reusable bottle or pack specifically designed to hold heated water safely for local heat therapy. It is typically constructed from durable, heat-retaining material like natural rubber or PVC. The key distinguishing feature of this model is the ribbed texture on both sides of the bag. This double-ribbed design is engineered to provide two crucial benefits: enhanced safety by preventing direct contact burns, and prolonged, gradual heat release for ongoing relief. The reinforced, leak-proof screw cap ensures maximum safety. The double-ribbed construction allows for a comfortable, soothing heat transfer, making the PIC Hot Water Bag an essential traditional remedy for managing chronic aches and tension.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of PIC Hot Water Bag (Two-Sided Ribbed)

PIC Hot Water Bag is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) device.

Apply heat for 15-20 minutes, 2 to 3 times a day, as needed for pain relief.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical application.
  • How to Fill:
    1. Boil water, then let it cool slightly (to about 50 degree C to 60 degree C).
    2. Hold the bag by the neck and slowly pour hot water (do not fill more than two-thirds full).
    3. Gently squeeze the bag to expel any remaining air before securing the stopper.
    4. Ensure the stopper is tightly sealed and check for leaks.
  • How to Apply: Place the securely sealed bag, wrapped in its cover or a towel, directly onto the area of pain, stiffness, or cramps. You have the benefit of applying either of the two ribbed sides.
  • Timing: Apply for a maximum of 20 minutes per session.
searchable.specification: The product is a reusable container for heat therapy with a ribbed surface on both sides. It is made of Natural Rubber or PVC, supplied in various capacities, and includes a reinforced screw cap. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Medical Device.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of PIC Hot Water Bag (Two-Sided Ribbed)

Do NOT use the PIC Hot Water Bag if the patient:

  • Has an acutely inflamed area or a recently injured area (within 48 hours), as heat will increase swelling and pain (use cold therapy instead).
  • Has open wounds, dermatitis, or bleeding in the affected area.
  • Has impaired skin sensation (e.g., due to diabetes or paralysis) or compromised circulation, as this significantly increases the risk of severe burns.
  • Cannot reliably monitor the heat level (e.g., young children or the elderly, unless supervised).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • General: Use is generally safe, but avoid applying excessive heat to the abdomen during pregnancy and always ensure a low, safe temperature.

Side Effects of PIC Hot Water Bag (Two-Sided Ribbed)

Side effects occur only due to improper use or excessive heat/duration.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Temporary mild skin redness (hyperaemia) after the bag is removed.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Severe Burns (Thermal Injury): Prolonged direct contact with skin with water above 60 degrees C can lead to severe burns.
    • Increased Swelling: Using heat on an acute injury (within 48 hours) will worsen swelling.

What to do if severe symptoms occur:

  • If the skin turns a distinct, deep red, or if blistering occurs, remove the bag immediately and seek emergency medical treatment for burns.
  • If dizziness or fainting occurs, remove the heat and rest.

Precautions and Warnings of PIC Hot Water Bag (Two-Sided Ribbed)

  • NEVER USE BOILING WATER: Use hot, but not boiling water (recommended temperature is 40 degree C to 60 degree C). Boiling water can damage the bag and cause severe burns.
  • Use a Cover/Barrier: Although both sides are ribbed, it is CRITICAL to always wrap the hot water bag in the provided fabric cover or a towel before applying it directly to the skin for prolonged periods.
  • Check Seal: Before every use, check the stopper and the bag itself for any rips, cracks, or signs of wear, and replace immediately if damaged.
  • Filling: Fill the bag to a maximum of two-thirds of its capacity (expel air before sealing). Do not overfill.
  • Avoid Pressure: Do not sit or lie on the hot water bag, as this pressure can cause the bag to fail or burst.

searchable.name: PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm
searchable.brief_info: The PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm is a large, non-freezing gel pack trusted for delivering targeted, flexible, and comfortable cold and heat therapy to effectively manage pain, swelling, and muscle stiffness across large areas of the body.
searchable.description: The PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm is a practical, reusable gel pad (maxi size) designed for high-quality thermotherapy (heat) and cryotherapy (cold). Its unique gel formulation remains flexible even when frozen, allowing the cushion to easily adapt and mold to the contours of large body areas, such as the back, shoulders, thighs, and stomach, without slipping. This dual-action cushion provides relief without medication by utilizing the natural therapeutic power of temperature. The large 20x30 cm size ensures comprehensive coverage, and it typically comes with a protective cover and adjustable elastic straps to secure the cushion comfortably to the affected area.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm

PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) device.

Apply for 15-20 minutes per session, 2 to 3 times a day, as needed for symptom relief.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical application (Thermotherapy or Cryotherapy).
  • How to Prepare (Cold): Place the cushion in the freezer for at least 2 hours. Remove and insert it into the protective cover before application.
  • How to Prepare (Heat - Bain-Marie): Immerse the cushion in hot water (maximum 60 degree C for 5 to 10 minutes. Test temperature, then insert into the cover.
  • How to Prepare (Heat - Microwave): Place the cushion in a microwave-safe container, cover completely with water, and heat carefully (follow specific wattage instructions). Test temperature and insert into the cover.
  • How to Apply: Secure the cushion to the affected area (back, stomach, shoulder, thigh) using the adjustable elastic strap.
  • Timing: Apply for a maximum of 20 minutes per session.
searchable.specification: The product is a reusable gel cushion for hot/cold therapy. Dimensions are 20x30 cm (Large Maxi size). It includes a protective cover and elastic bands. The gel formulation does not freeze solid. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Medical Device.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm

Do NOT use the PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm if the patient:

  • Cold Therapy: Do not use on people with Raynaud's disease, severe circulation problems, or cold hypersensitivity.
  • Heat Therapy: Do not use on open wounds, acute inflammation, or bleeding areas. Do not use if you have severe nerve damage or impaired skin sensation (e.g., due to diabetes).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • General: Use is generally safe, but avoid applying excessive heat or cold directly to the abdomen during pregnancy without consulting a doctor.

Side Effects of PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm

Side effects occur only due to improper application or excessive heat/cold duration.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Temporary redness or a tingling/numbness sensation (due to cold).
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Thermal Burns: Applying heat that is too hot, or applying the frozen pack directly to the skin without the cover for too long, can cause localized severe burns or frostbite.
    • Aggravated Inflammation: Applying heat to a recent, acute injury (within 48 hours) will worsen inflammation and swelling.

What to do if severe symptoms occur:

  • If the skin turns deep red, blanches, or blistering occurs, remove the cushion immediately and seek emergency medical treatment.
  • If dizziness or fainting occurs, remove the heat and rest.

Precautions and Warnings of PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 20x30cm

  • NEVER APPLY DIRECTLY TO SKIN: Always insert the Thermogel cushion into the provided cover or wrap it in a thin towel before application to prevent thermal injury (burns/frostbite).
  • Temperature Check: Always test the temperature of the cushion with your hand before applying it to the treatment area.
  • Limit Duration: Each application should not exceed 20 minutes. Wait at least 20 minutes before repeating the application.
  • Microwave Safety: Follow microwave instructions precisely to prevent the gel pack from rupturing or overheating.
  • Do Not Ingest: The gel contents are non-toxic but should not be ingested. If the sachet breaks, dispose of the gel and sachet safely.

searchable.name: PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm
searchable.brief_info: The PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm is a medium-sized, non-freezing gel pack trusted for delivering targeted, flexible, and comfortable cold and heat therapy to effectively manage acute pain, swelling, and muscle stiffness on specific joints and localized areas.
searchable.description: The PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm is a practical, reusable gel pad (medium size) designed for high-quality thermotherapy (heat) and cryotherapy (cold). Its unique gel formulation remains flexible even when frozen, allowing the cushion to easily adapt and mold to the contours of areas like the knee, elbow, ankle, or neck, providing maximum contact. This dual-action cushion provides relief without medication by utilizing the natural therapeutic power of temperature. The 10x26 cm size ensures comprehensive coverage for medium-sized joints and muscles, and it typically comes with a protective cover and sometimes an adjustable elastic strap to secure the cushion comfortably to the affected area.
searchable.how_to_use:
Contraindications of PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm

Do NOT use the PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm if the patient:

  • Cold Therapy: Do not use on people with Raynaud's disease, severe circulation problems, or cold hypersensitivity.
  • Heat Therapy: Do not use on open wounds, acute inflammation, or bleeding areas. Do not use if you have impaired skin sensation (e.g., due to diabetes).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • General: Use is generally safe, but avoid applying excessive heat or cold directly to the abdomen during pregnancy without consulting a doctor.

Side Effects of PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm

Side effects occur only due to improper application or excessive heat/cold duration.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Temporary redness or a tingling/numbness sensation (due to cold).
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Thermal Burns/Frostbite: Applying heat that is too hot, or applying the frozen pack directly to the skin without the cover for too long, can cause localized severe burns or frostbite.
    • Aggravated Inflammation: Applying heat to a recent, acute injury (within 48 hours) will worsen inflammation and swelling.

What to do if severe symptoms occur:

  • If the skin turns deep red, blanches, or blistering occurs, remove the cushion immediately and seek emergency medical treatment.

Precautions and Warnings of PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm

  • NEVER APPLY DIRECTLY TO SKIN: Always insert the Thermogel cushion into the provided cover or wrap it in a thin towel before application to prevent thermal injury (burns/frostbite).
  • Temperature Check: Always test the temperature of the cushion with your hand before applying it to the treatment area, especially when microwaving.
  • Limit Duration: Each application should not exceed 20 minutes. Wait at least 20 minutes before repeating the application.
  • Microwave Safety: Follow microwave instructions precisely to prevent the gel pack from rupturing or overheating.
  • Do Not Ingest: The gel contents are non-toxic but should not be ingested. If the sachet breaks, dispose of the gel and sachet safely.
searchable.specification: The product is a reusable gel cushion for hot/cold therapy. Dimensions are 10x26cm (Medium size). It typically includes a protective cover and elastic bands (in some variants). The gel formulation does not freeze solid. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Medical Device.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Dosage of PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm

PIC Thermogel Reusable Cushion 10x26cm is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) device.

Apply for 15-20 minutes per session, 2 to 3 times a day, as needed for symptom relief.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical application (Thermotherapy or Cryotherapy).
  • How to Prepare (Cold): Place the cushion in the freezer for at least 2 hours. Remove and insert it into the protective cover before application.
  • How to Prepare (Heat - Boiling Water): Immerse the cushion in hot water (maximum 60 degree C) for 5 to 10 minutes. Test temperature, then insert into the cover.
  • How to Prepare (Heat - Microwave): Heat carefully (follow specific wattage instructions on the pack). Test temperature and insert into the cover.
  • How to Apply: Secure the cushion to the affected area (e.g., elbow, knee, ankle) using the adjustable elastic strap (if included) or manual placement.
  • Timing: Apply for a maximum of 20 minutes per session.

searchable.name: Diprosalic Ointment 100g
searchable.brief_info: Diprosalic Ointment 100g is a prescription-strength formulation trusted for the rapid and effective treatment of stubborn, scaly skin conditions like psoriasis and chronic eczema, working to remove scales and reduce underlying inflammation and itchiness.
searchable.description: Diprosalic Ointment 100g is a specialized, dual-action dermatological ointment supplied in a large, economical 100g tube. It combines Betamethasone Dipropionate (a potent corticosteroid) and Salicylic Acid (a strong keratolytic). This synergy is crucial for treating skin conditions where a thick layer of dead, scaly skin prevents the steroid from reaching the underlying disease. The Salicylic Acid first softens and loosens the hardened scales, allowing the potent Betamethasone to penetrate the diseased tissue more effectively. Diprosalic Ointment rapidly relieves redness, swelling, and intense itching, facilitating the skin's healing process.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Diprosalic Ointment 100g

Diprosalic Ointment 100g is a Prescription Only Medicine (POM).

Apply a thin layer gently rubbed into the affected area twice a day, or as directed by the physician.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical Ointment (External Use Only).
  • How to Use:
    1. Wash your hands thoroughly before and after application.
    2. Clean and gently dry the affected scaly area.
    3. Apply a very thin film of ointment to completely cover the affected area. Gently massage it into the skin until it disappears.
  • Timing: Typically applied twice daily (morning and evening) for the duration prescribed (maximum 14 days).

Missed Dose Guidance

  • If you forget to apply a dose, apply it as soon as you remember.
  • Then continue to use it at the usual time. Do not apply a double amount to compensate for a missed dose.
searchable.specification: The active ingredients are Betamethasone Dipropionate (potent corticosteroid) and Salicylic Acid (keratolytic). It is supplied as a smooth, off-white topical ointment in a 100g tube. It is a Prescription Only Medicine (POM).
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Diprosalic Ointment 100g

Do NOT use Diprosalic Ointment 100g if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Betamethasone, Salicylic Acid, or any other component.
  • Have viral skin infections, such as Herpes Simplex (cold sores), Chickenpox, or Shingles.
  • Have Acne, Rosacea, or Perioral Dermatitis (rash around the mouth).
  • Have untreated fungal or bacterial skin infections (the steroid can mask or worsen them).
  • Are treating nappy rash or genital itching.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor. This medication should not be used during pregnancy unless the benefits clearly outweigh the risks. Use should be limited, avoiding large areas or prolonged use.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. Use only under medical supervision. Avoid applying to the breast area to prevent accidental ingestion by the infant.

Side Effects of Diprosalic Ointment 100g

Side effects can occur, particularly with prolonged use, under occlusion, or on sensitive skin areas.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Local application site reactions, including burning, itching, mild dryness, or redness, often temporary.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Steroid-related Side Effects (Long-term/Extensive Use): Skin thinning (atrophy), stretch marks (striae), excessive hair growth, inflammation of hair follicles (folliculitis), or changes in skin colour.
    • Systemic Absorption: Prolonged use, especially on large areas or in children, can lead to systemic steroid effects (e.g., Cushing's syndrome, growth retardation) or Salicylism (ringing in ears, dizziness, nausea).
    • Visual Disturbances: Blurred vision or other visual problems.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you notice signs of skin thinning, red marks, persistent rash, or any systemic symptoms, stop the medication immediately and seek medical attention.

Precautions and Warnings of Diprosalic Ointment 100g

  • Prescription Only: This potent cream must be used only under the direction of a physician.
  • Duration of Use: Do NOT use for longer than 2 weeks unless specifically advised by your doctor, to minimize the risk of steroid side effects. Dosage in children should be limited to 5 days.
  • Facial Use: Use with extreme caution and for short periods only on the face, as the risk of steroid side effects (thinning, rosacea) is much higher.
  • Avoid Occlusion: Do not use under bandages, plasters, or tight clothing unless specifically directed by your doctor, as this drastically increases absorption.
  • Avoid Eyes: Avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes. Glaucoma may result if used near the eyes.
  • Diabetics: Use with caution, as topical salicylic acid may sometimes cause hypoglycemia (low blood sugar).

The formula utilizes a synergistic blend of powerful herbal extracts and amino acids known for their traditional use in boosting male health and energy. Ingredients like Tribulus, Horny Goat Weed, and Ginseng work naturally to support healthy hormone levels and circulatory function, which are essential for stamina, muscle endurance, and sexual vitality. Reload Performance Capsules provide a nutritional boost to help maintain optimal physical health, sharpen focus, and counteract the effects of daily stress and fatigue.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Reload Performance Capsules

Reload Performance Capsules is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Dietary Supplement.

Take 1 capsule twice daily, or as directed by a physician. (Check packaging for exact dosage).

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral capsule/tablet.
  • How to Take: Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water.
  • Timing: Take once or twice daily, preferably with or immediately after a meal (breakfast and lunch) to aid absorption and mitigate stomach upset.

Missed Dose Guidance

searchable.specification: The active ingredients typically include a blend of herbal extracts (Tribulus, Horny Goat Weed, Ginseng) and amino acids (Taurine, Arginine). It is supplied as an oral tablet or capsule (common pack size is 60 units). It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Dietary Supplement for male performance.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Reload Performance Capsules

Do NOT take Reload Performance Capsules if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients (e.g., Ginseng, Tribulus).
  • Have severe, uncontrolled high blood pressure (hypertension) or existing heart conditions, as stimulant and vasodilating ingredients may affect heart rate and blood pressure.
  • Are currently taking prescription medications for erectile dysfunction (PDE-5 inhibitors).
  • Are taking nitrate prescription drugs (e.g., nitroglycerin for chest pain), as the combination with hidden PDE-5 inhibitors can cause a life-threatening drop in blood pressure.
  • Are female.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • General: This product is not intended for use by women.

Side Effects of Reload Performance Capsules

Side effects are generally mild but may be related to the hormonal and stimulant ingredients.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Digestive upset (nausea, diarrhea), headache, slight nervousness, or insomnia (difficulty sleeping) if taken too late in the day.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Cardiovascular/Blood Pressure: Significant increase in blood pressure or heart palpitations.
    • Priapism: Erections lasting more than four hours (requires immediate emergency medical attention).
    • Hormonal Changes: Prolonged or high-dose use may potentially cause unwanted hormonal side effects.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • For mild digestive upset, take the capsule immediately after a meal.
  • If you experience high blood pressure symptoms, heart palpitations, or severe nervousness, discontinue use immediately and consult a physician.
  • For any severe side effect, especially chest pain or an erection lasting more than four hours, seek emergency medical treatment immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Reload Performance Capsules

  • Medical Clearance: Consult a physician before using this product, especially if you have chronic health conditions, including diabetes, heart issues, or hypertension.
  • Nitrates Interaction: The risk of interaction with nitrates is a critical warning. NEVER combine this product with nitrate drugs.
  • Timing: Avoid taking the capsule within 6-8 hours of bedtime due to the stimulating effects of Ginseng and Taurine, which may cause insomnia.
  • Drug Interactions: Consult your doctor or pharmacist if you are taking medications for blood pressure, heart rhythm, or blood thinning, as herbal components may interact.
  • Dosage Limit: Do not exceed the recommended daily dose.

Apply a small amount to the affected area and massage gently, 2 to 3 times a day, as needed.

  • How to Use (Pain): Apply a small, minimal amount of ointment to the affected muscle or joint area. Massage gently until the balm is absorbed.

searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of ROBB Extra Menthol Ointment

Do NOT use ROBB Extra Menthol Ointment if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Menthol, Camphor, Methyl Salicylate, Eucalyptus Oil, or any component of the balm (especially aspirin or other salicylates).
  • Are applying it to broken skin, open wounds, cuts, scrapes, or severely irritated skin.
  • Are treating children under 2 years of age (due to the risk of respiratory distress from high Menthol/Camphor vapours).
  • Are applying it near the eyes or inside the nose or mouth.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor. Due to the systemic absorption of Methyl Salicylate (an aspirin-like product), use is generally not recommended in the third trimester of pregnancy (after 20 weeks). Use only under the advice of a healthcare professional.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. Avoid applying the balm to the breast area to prevent accidental ingestion by the infant.

Side Effects of ROBB Extra Menthol Ointment

Side effects are generally localized but may be intensified due to the "Extra Menthol" formula.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Intense localized stinging, burning, or strong cooling sensation at the application site. Skin redness and mild irritation.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Severe Allergic Reactions: Blistering, severe swelling, rash, or difficulty breathing.
    • Reye's Syndrome Risk (Children): The ingredient Methyl Salicylate carries a risk of Reye's syndrome in children and teenagers (under 18) with viral illnesses like the flu or chickenpox. DO NOT use on children with a fever or signs of a viral illness unless directed by a doctor.
    • Systemic Toxicity: Severe symptoms like nausea, vomiting, or ringing in the ears (tinnitus) may occur if large amounts are ingested or absorbed.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If blistering, severe redness, or increased/unusual pain occurs, stop the medication immediately and consult a physician.
  • If swallowed: Seek emergency medical attention immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of ROBB Extra Menthol Ointment

  • External Use Only/Poisonous: This ointment is strictly for external topical use. It is poisonous if swallowed and must be kept safely out of the reach of children.
  • Heat Interaction: DO NOT apply the ointment immediately before, during, or after activities that increase skin temperature (e.g., hot bathing, saunas, heavy exercise) or apply a heating pad/hot water bottle to the treated area. Heat can dangerously increase absorption and the risk of burns or toxicity.
  • Children's Use: Not suitable for children under 2 years of age. Use with caution on children aged 2-12, starting with a very small amount.
  • Avoid Occlusion: Do not bandage or tightly wrap the treated area.
  • Intensity: Be prepared for a much stronger cooling sensation than the original balm.

searchable.name: Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste
searchable.brief_info: Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste is the dentist-recommended brand for sensitive teeth, formulated with Stannous Fluoride to deliver clinically proven relief from sensitivity pain in just 60 seconds and build lasting protection with daily use.
searchable.description: Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste is a specialized, daily-use oral hygiene product engineered to provide the fastest possible relief from the sharp, short pain of tooth sensitivity (dentinal hypersensitivity). Sensitivity occurs when the soft inner layer of the tooth, the dentin, becomes exposed, revealing microscopic tubules that lead to the nerve. This unique formula is engineered for speed, quickly creating a robust barrier over the exposed dentin and tubules. This prevents external triggers like cold, heat, or sweets from reaching the nerve. The toothpaste provides the dual benefit of rapid pain relief and continuous oral protection, including cavity prevention and gentle stain removal.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste

Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) product for daily oral hygiene.

Brush twice a day and not more than three times, or as recommended by your dentist.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical (applied to teeth and gums).
  • How to Use (Daily): Apply at least a 1-inch ribbon of toothpaste onto a soft-bristled toothbrush. Brush teeth thoroughly for at least one minute, twice a day (morning and evening).
  • How to Use (Rapid Action - Dab-on): For immediate, 60-second relief, squeeze a pea-sized amount onto a clean fingertip and gently rub it onto each sensitive area for 1 minute (maximum twice per day) before brushing.
  • Timing: Brush all sensitive areas of the teeth thoroughly.

Missed Dose Guidance

  • Not applicable, as this is a daily hygiene product. Simply resume brushing twice a day as soon as possible. Consistent use is necessary for lasting sensitivity relief.
searchable.specification: The active medicinal ingredient is Stannous Fluoride (0.454% w/w). It is supplied as a paste or gel in a tube (common sizes are 75mL and 80g). It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Oral Care/Antihypersensitivity Drug.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste

Do NOT use Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Stannous Fluoride, Sodium Fluoride, or any other ingredient in the toothpaste (e.g., Sodium Lauryl Sulfate - SLS).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Consult your dentist or doctor. Toothpastes containing fluoride are generally safe for topical use with minimal systemic absorption. Always follow professional advice.

Side Effects of Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste

Side effects are extremely rare when used as directed (spitting out after brushing).

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): In rare cases, some users may experience temporary gum irritation, a mild burning sensation, or temporary alteration of taste. Products containing Stannous Fluoride may also rarely cause temporary surface staining of the teeth, which can be removed by a dentist.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Oral/Facial Swelling: Swelling of the mouth, lips, or face (indicates a severe allergic reaction).
    • Persistent Sensitivity: If symptoms persist or worsen after 4 weeks of continuous, twice-daily use, as this may indicate a serious underlying dental problem (cavity, cracked tooth).

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If irritation of the mouth or gums occurs or persists, discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional.
  • If sensitivity persists or worsens after four weeks, stop use and see your dentist immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Sensodyne Rapid Action Toothpaste

  • Children's Use: Not for use by children under 12 years of age, unless on the advice of a dental professional or physician. Children should use a pea-sized amount and brush under adult supervision to minimize swallowing.
  • Swallowing: Minimize swallowing and spit out the toothpaste after brushing. If more than used for brushing is accidentally swallowed, get medical help immediately.
  • Staining: Note that Stannous Fluoride may cause temporary surface staining. Adequate toothbrushing is generally sufficient to prevent this.

External Use Only: This toothpaste is for dental use only.

Side effects are rare when the product is used as directed.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): None typically expected due to the low levels of natural caffeine and balanced vitamin profile.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Caffeine Sensitivity: In very sensitive individuals, the natural caffeine from Guarana or Green Tea may cause mild nervousness, restlessness, or insomnia if consumed in excess or close to bedtime.
    • Allergic Reactions: Rash, swelling, or difficulty breathing.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you experience symptoms of severe nervousness or an allergic reaction, discontinue use immediately and consult a physician.
  • Do not consume alongside other high-caffeine products.

Precautions and Warnings of Wellman Vitamin Drink

  • Dosage Limit: Do NOT exceed the recommended daily intake (typically one can per day) to avoid over-consumption of vitamins and botanicals.
  • Caffeine Monitoring: Be mindful of the small amount of natural caffeine. If you have a known sensitivity to caffeine, limit consumption.
  • Hydration: While a liquid, it is not a substitute for water. Ensure adequate daily water intake.
  • Not a Replacement: This drink is designed as a refreshing nutritional addition to, and not a replacement for, the core Wellman tablet multi-nutrient formula.

Diabetics: Contains sugars (from apple and grape juice concentrate). Diabetics must factor the sugar content into their daily intake.

searchable.name: Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops
searchable.brief_info: Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops is a unique liquid formula trusted by parents and recommended by health experts to provide a safe and balanced nutritional safeguard for babies aged 4 to 24 months, supporting their rapid growth, development, and immune system function.
searchable.description: Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops is a unique liquid formulation that provides a comprehensive range of up to 16 essential vitamins and minerals, carefully balanced for infants and young children. Designed with a baby's special needs in mind, this supplement is often recommended by health departments to safeguard intake of crucial nutrients like Vitamins A, C, and D during the first few years of life, when dietary requirements are high relative to body size. The formula includes Iron for cognitive development and Vitamin D3 for bone growth. The drops have a pleasant, natural orange flavour and include a calibrated measuring syringe for safe, accurate, and easy administration directly onto the baby's tongue or mixed with milk/juice.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops

Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) supplement.

Babies (from 4 to 24 months): Administer 0.5 ml twice daily, as marked on the syringe, or as directed by a paediatrician.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral liquid drops.
  • How to Use:
    1. Shake the bottle well before use.
    2. Insert the syringe into the bottle, then hold the bottle upside down.
    3. Draw out 0.5 ml of liquid as marked on the syringe.
    4. Carefully administer the drops onto the baby's tongue, ideally just before a feed.
    5. Rinse the syringe thoroughly with clean water and dry it after each use.
  • Timing: Administer twice daily, ensuring consistent spacing.

Missed Dose Guidance

  • If you miss a dose, simply resume the regular dosage ($0.5\text{ ml}$ twice daily) the following day. Do not take two doses at once.
searchable.specification: The active ingredients include 16 nutrients: Vitamins A, C, D3, E, B-Complex, Iron, Zinc, and Swiss Alpine Malt extract. It is supplied as an oral liquid in a 30 ml bottle with a measuring syringe. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Multivitamin Dietary Supplement for babies (4-24 months).
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops

Do NOT give Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops if the baby:

  • Is under 4 months of age (unless advised otherwise by a paediatrician).
  • Has a known allergy or hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients (including iron, vitamins, or malt extract).
  • Is already drinking 500 ml (approx. 1 pint) or more of infant formula daily, as the formula already has vitamins added.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • General: This product is for infants and children and is not intended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Side Effects of Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops

Side effects are rare when the product is used as directed.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): In rare cases, some infants may experience mild gastrointestinal discomfort (upset stomach, minor change in stool colour/consistency) due to the iron content.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Iron Overdose: CRITICAL WARNING: This product contains iron, which if taken in excess, is seriously harmful to very young children. DO NOT exceed the recommended daily dose.
    • Allergic Reactions: Persistent rash, swelling, or difficulty breathing.
    • Staining: The iron content may cause minor, temporary staining of teeth or gums, which can be minimized by administering the drops before a feed.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • For mild stomach upset, ensure the drops are given with or after a feed.
  • If you suspect an overdose (e.g., severe vomiting, drowsiness) or observe any signs of a severe allergic reaction, seek emergency medical attention immediately.
  • Wipe any spillage immediately, as the iron content can stain skin or fabric.

Precautions and Warnings of Wellbaby Multivitamin Drops

  • Dosage Limit: Do NOT exceed the recommended daily dosage ($0.5\text{ ml}$ twice daily, total $1\text{ ml}$/day) to prevent iron and Vitamin D toxicity.
  • Keep Out of Reach: Due to the risk of iron overdose, store safely out of the sight and reach of children at all times.
  • Syringe Use: Use the included measuring syringe to ensure accurate dosing ($0.5\text{ ml}$ marked). Rinse and dry the syringe immediately after use.
  • Mixing: The liquid can be mixed with the baby's milk or water, or administered directly onto the tongue just before a feed.
  • Formula Fed Infants: If the baby is drinking infant formula, consult a paediatrician before administering the drops, as formula already contains vitamins.

searchable.name: Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour
searchable.brief_info: Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour offers soothing relief for the throat and cough, utilizing a blend of natural oils to loosen phlegm while providing a refreshing, minty cherry sensation.
searchable.description: Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour are a traditional medicated throat lozenge known for their fast-acting soothing relief. The lozenges combine the strong clearing power of natural peppermint oil and menthol with the pleasant taste of cherry. This dual action is crucial: as the lozenge dissolves slowly in the mouth, it releases vapours that provide a soothing, cooling sensation to the irritated throat. Simultaneously, the natural oils act as an antiseptic and expectorant, helping to loosen and break up thick phlegm in the lungs. This makes Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour an effective choice for managing symptoms of colds, coughs, and minor throat discomfort while leaving breath minty fresh.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour

Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) medicine.

Slowly dissolve one (1) lozenge in the mouth as required, typically 3-4 times a day.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral (slow dissolution).
  • How to Use: Place one lozenge in your mouth and allow it to dissolve slowly. Do not chew or swallow the lozenge whole. Avoid drinking liquids immediately after the lozenge dissolves to maximize the soothing effect.
  • Timing: Use as needed for cough or throat discomfort.
searchable.specification: The active ingredients include Peppermint Essential Oil and Menthol, Anise Oil. It is supplied as hard lozenges, typically in small sachets or packs of 6 to 18 pieces. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Cough Suppressant/Soothing Lozenge.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour

Do NOT use Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Menthol, Peppermint Oil, Anise Oil, or any other ingredient in the lozenge.
  • Have been told by a doctor that you have an intolerance to some sugars (Sucrose/Glucose syrup).
  • Have a severe, persistent, or chronic cough, or other chronic lung conditions (e.g., severe asthma or emphysema), without consulting a doctor.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. The safety of the lozenges during pregnancy and breastfeeding has not been definitively established. Use only when advised by a healthcare professional.

Side Effects of Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour

Side effects are rare when the product is used as directed.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Temporary mild irritation, burning discomfort, or altered taste sensation in the mouth.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Hypersensitivity: Symptoms like erythematous skin rash (red rash), severe burning discomfort, or severe dizziness.
    • Overdose: Ingestion of an overdose of menthol may cause severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, or drowsiness (ataxia).

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you experience persistent severe burning, swelling, or blistering, discontinue use immediately and consult a physician.
  • If accidentally swallowed in large amounts: Seek emergency medical assistance.

Precautions and Warnings of Woods' Peppermint Lozenges Cherry Flavour

  • Not for Young Children: Not recommended for children under 6 years of age due to the risk of choking and the strength of the menthol.
  • Symptom Monitoring: If symptoms persist or worsen, reoccur, or are accompanied by a fever, rash, or persistent headache, discontinue use and consult a healthcare provider.
  • Diabetics: The lozenges contain sugar (Sucrose and Glucose Syrup). Diabetic patients should use sugar-free lozenges only, or factor the sugar content into their daily intake.
  • Do Not Chew: The lozenge should be allowed to dissolve slowly in the mouth. Do not chew or swallow whole.
  • Limit Intake: Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.

searchable.name: Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters
searchable.brief_info: Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters are a trusted choice for protecting all types of minor cuts, grazes, and scratches, offering a highly hypoallergenic material and gentle adhesion that is kind to delicate skin.
searchable.description: Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters are specially designed for people with sensitive, easily irritated, or allergy-prone skin, including children and the elderly. The plasters are made from an extra skin-friendly, hypoallergenic, and latex-free material that is soft and breathable, minimizing the risk of redness, itching, or allergic contact dermatitis often caused by standard plasters. Despite their gentle nature, Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters provide secure adhesion to ensure the plaster stays firmly in place for up to 24 hours. The non-stick wound pad protects and cushions the wound, and the gentle adhesive ensures the plaster can be removed painlessly and without leaving sticky residue.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters

Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters are an Over-the-Counter (OTC) consumable.

Use one plaster per wound, once daily, or as needed.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical application to the skin.
  • How to Use:
    1. Clean the wound with an antiseptic (e.g., Elastoplast Wound Spray) and dry the skin area thoroughly.
    2. Remove the backing from the plaster.
    3. Apply the plaster without stretching, ensuring the non-stick wound pad completely covers the cut or graze.
    4. Smooth down the plaster to ensure all edges are securely adhered to the skin.
  • Timing: Apply immediately after cleansing the wound.
searchable.specification: The plasters are made of soft, breathable, hypoallergenic material with a non-stick wound pad and skin-friendly adhesive. They are Latex-Free. They are supplied in boxes of assorted strips (e.g., 20 or 40 strips) or as cut-to-size rolls. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Medical Consumable.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters

Do NOT use Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters if:

  • The wound is deep, severely bleeding, or shows signs of infection (redness, warmth, pain, swelling, pus).
  • You are attempting to reuse the plaster (use only once).
  • You are allergic to any component of the plaster (though hypoallergenic, individual reactions are still possible).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • General: As a non-medicated external plaster, Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters are safe for use during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

Side Effects of Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters

Side effects are minimized by the hypoallergenic formulation.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): None typically expected when used correctly.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Severe Allergic Reaction: Persistent redness, itching, or swelling underneath or around the plaster (requires removal and consultation).

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If irritation or rash occurs, remove the plaster immediately, clean the skin, and consult a pharmacist or doctor.

Precautions and Warnings of Elastoplast Sensitive Plasters

  • Clean Wound First: Always clean the wound and gently dry the surrounding skin before applying the plaster to prevent infection and ensure adhesion.
  • Change Regularly: Change the plaster every 24 to 48 hours, or more often if it becomes wet, dirty, or starts to peel.
  • Not Waterproof: These plasters are breathable but not completely waterproof. If the area is likely to get wet during bathing or showering, use a dedicated waterproof plaster from the Elastoplast range.
  • Apply Without Stretching: Apply the plaster without stretching it or creating creases, as this can affect adhesion and cause skin irritation.
  • Consult Doctor: Seek medical professional help for deep cuts, animal bites, serious burns, or wounds that do not show signs of healing.

searchable.name: Elastoplast Extra Tough Plasters
searchable.brief_info: Elastoplast Extra Tough Plasters are the first heavy fabric plasters trusted to combine 100% waterproof protection with flexible, quick-drying fabric, making them the ultimate choice for securing minor wounds in demanding environments.
searchable.description: Elastoplast Extra Tough Waterproof Plasters are engineered for individuals who need maximum wound protection during activities like DIY, sports, outdoor work, or frequent hand washing. These plasters utilize the innovative Hi-DRY TEX Technology, a three-layer system designed for superior durability. The core benefits are provided by a robust, quick-drying fabric backing, a waterproof yet breathable inner membrane, and a super-strong adhesive. This combination ensures the plaster stays securely in place for longer, reliably protecting the wound from water, dirt, and bacteria without leaving sticky residues upon removal. The flexible fabric construction allows the plaster to move with the skin, making it ideal for joints and active areas.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Elastoplast Extra Tough (Waterproof) Plasters

Elastoplast Extra Tough Plasters are an Over-the-Counter (OTC) consumable.

Use one plaster per wound, once daily, or as needed.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Topical application to the skin.
  • How to Use:
    1. Clean the wound and dry the skin around the cut or graze very carefully.
    2. Remove the backing film from the adhesive side of the plaster.
    3. Apply the plaster pad side down onto the wound without stretching, ensuring the pad covers the wound completely.
    4. Press down firmly to ensure all edges are securely sealed against the skin.
  • Timing: Apply immediately after cleansing the wound.
searchable.specification: The plasters are made of durable, flexible, waterproof, and breathable fabric, utilizing Hi-DRY TEX Technology. They feature a super strong, skin-friendly adhesive and a non-stick wound pad. They are typically supplied in boxes of assorted strips (e.g., 12 or 15 assorted strips). It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Medical Consumable.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Elastoplast Extra Tough (Waterproof) Plasters

Do NOT use Elastoplast Extra Tough Plasters if:

  • The wound is deep, severely bleeding, or shows clear signs of active infection (increased redness, pus, pain, warmth).
  • You are allergic to the adhesive material or the plaster fabric.
  • You are attempting to reuse the plaster (use only once).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • General: As a non-medicated external plaster, Elastoplast Extra Tough Plasters are safe for use during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

Side Effects of Elastoplast Extra Tough (Waterproof) Plasters

Side effects are rare and typically related to skin sensitivity to the strong adhesive.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Temporary redness or mild irritation upon removal, especially if the plaster is left on for too long.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Allergic Contact Dermatitis: Persistent redness, itching, or swelling underneath or around the plaster (requires immediate removal and consultation).

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If irritation or rash occurs, remove the plaster immediately, gently clean the skin, and use an alternative sensitive-skin plaster or sterile dressing.

Precautions and Warnings of Elastoplast Extra Tough (Waterproof) Plasters

  • Clean Wound First: Always clean the wound with an antiseptic (like Elastoplast Wound Spray) and gently dry the surrounding skin before applying the plaster to ensure both hygiene and maximum adhesion.
  • Change Regularly: Change the plaster every 24 to 48 hours, or more often if the wound pad is heavily saturated or the seal has been compromised by prolonged water exposure.
  • Application Technique: Apply the plaster without stretching it or creating creases, as this can compromise the waterproof seal.
  • Latex Warning: If you have a latex allergy, double-check the packaging to ensure the product is 100% latex-free, as some older packaging may contain latex.
  • Consult Doctor: Seek medical professional help for deep cuts, animal bites, serious burns, or wounds that show no sign of healing.

These plasters are made from a strong, durable, yet highly flexible fabric material that stretches and moves with your skin without restricting movement. The plasters feature a strong adhesive that ensures they stay securely in place throughout the day, even with moisture exposure or activity. The non-stick wound pad protects and cushions the injury from bumps, and the material is breathable and water-repellent, facilitating optimal healing conditions by keeping dirt and bacteria out.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Temporary redness or slight skin irritation upon removal, particularly on sensitive or hairy skin due to the strong adhesive.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):

  • If irritation or rash occurs, remove the plaster immediately, gently clean the skin, and use an alternative sensitive-skin plaster (like the Elastoplast Sensitive line) or sterile dressing.

Precautions and Warnings of Elastoplast Fabric Plasters

  • Clean Wound First: Always clean the wound with an antiseptic (e.g., Elastoplast Wound Spray) and gently dry the surrounding skin before applying the plaster to prevent infection and ensure maximum adhesion.
  • Change Regularly: Change the plaster daily, or more often if it becomes wet or dirty, to maintain hygiene.
  • Water-Repellent vs. Waterproof: Note that the fabric plasters are water-repellent (can handle splashes and light washing) but are generally not 100% waterproof (not suitable for swimming or prolonged bathing, unless specifically labelled 'Extra Tough Waterproof').
  • Application Technique: Apply the plaster without stretching it or creating creases, as this can compromise the waterproof seal.
  • Consult Doctor: Seek medical professional help for deep cuts, animal bites, serious burns, or wounds that show no sign of healing.

searchable.name: Elastoplast Waterproof Plaster
searchable.brief_info: Elastoplast Waterproof Plasters are a trusted choice for protecting all types of minor cuts, grazes, and scratches, featuring a flexible, water-repellent backing and a strong adhesive that reliably seals the wound completely against moisture and germs.
searchable.description: Elastoplast Waterproof Plasters are engineered for individuals who need secure wound protection while swimming, showering, bathing, or doing water-based activities. This robust seal reliably protects the wound from water, dirt, and bacteria. Side effects are rare and typically related to skin sensitivity to the strong adhesive.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Temporary redness, mild irritation, or slight skin maceration (whitening/softening) if the plaster is left on for too long or if the skin is very sensitive.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):

Precautions and Warnings of Elastoplast Waterproof Plasters

  • Clean Wound First: Always clean the wound with an antiseptic (e.g., Elastoplast Wound Spray) and gently dry the surrounding skin before applying the plaster to prevent infection and ensure maximum waterproof adhesion.
  • Change Regularly: Change the plaster daily, or immediately if the seal around the wound pad is broken or the pad is saturated.
  • Ensure Full Seal: For maximum waterproof effectiveness, ensure the plaster is applied smoothly, without creases, and that the adhesive forms a complete seal around the entire perimeter of the wound pad.
  • Do Not Stretch: Apply the plaster without stretching it or creating air bubbles, which can compromise the waterproof seal.
  • Consult Doctor: Seek medical professional help for deep cuts, animal bites, serious burns, or wounds that do not show signs of healing.

searchable.name: Dioralyte Relief Raspberry
searchable.brief_info: Dioralyte Relief Raspberry is a clinically proven oral rehydration solution that not only rapidly replaces essential fluids and salts lost due to acute diarrhoea but also uses rice powder to help firm watery stools and reduce the severity of diarrhoea.
searchable.description: Dioralyte Relief Raspberry Sachets contain a unique formulation of Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) that complies with World Health Organization (WHO) standards for fluid and electrolyte replacement. The key differentiator of this "Relief" variant is the inclusion of pre-cooked rice powder (starch), which provides complex carbohydrates instead of simple glucose. The rice powder has a low osmotic capacity, which helps to prevent further fluid loss and has been clinically shown to help the watery stools return to normal consistency more rapidly. The pleasant raspberry flavour ensures better compliance, which is crucial for preventing dangerous dehydration, especially in children and the elderly. The reconstituted solution is milky in appearance.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Dioralyte Relief Raspberry Sachets

Dioralyte Relief Raspberry Sachets is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) medicine.

Adults and Children (over 1 year): One sachet after each loose motion (watery stool), up to a maximum of 5 sachets per day for 3-4 days.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral powder for solution.
  • How to Prepare:
    1. Empty the contents of one sachet into a large glass.
    2. Add 200 ml of fresh drinking water (for infants, use freshly boiled and cooled water).
    3. Stir well until the powder is fully dissolved (the drink will appear milky). Drink the entire glassful immediately.
  • Timing: Administer immediately after each episode of loose stool. If vomiting is present, give small sips every 5 minutes and gradually increase.
searchable.specification: The active ingredients are pre-cooked rice powder (6 g), Sodium Citrate (580 mg), Sodium Chloride (350 mg), and Potassium Chloride (300 mg). It is supplied as a raspberry-flavoured powder for oral solution, typically in a pack of 6 or 20 sachets. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Oral Rehydration Therapy.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Dioralyte Relief Raspberry Sachets

Do NOT take Dioralyte Relief Raspberry Sachets if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to any of the active substances (rice powder, sodium citrate, sodium chloride, potassium chloride) or excipients (e.g., Aspartame).
  • Have a condition called phenylketonuria (PKU) (due to the presence of Aspartame).
  • Have intestinal obstruction requiring surgical intervention.
  • Have severe kidney or liver disease.
  • Are infants under 3 months old.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. Dioralyte Relief Raspberry may be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding, but only on medical advice, especially considering the small amount of ethanol (alcohol) present in the flavouring and the sodium/potassium content.

Side Effects of Dioralyte Relief Raspberry Sachets

Side effects are rare when the solution is prepared correctly.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): None typically expected.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Severe Allergic Reactions: Rash, hives, swelling of the lips, face, throat, or tongue, or difficulty breathing.
    • Electrolyte Imbalance: Can occur if the solution is prepared using too little or too much water (making it too strong or too weak), potentially leading to fluid imbalance.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If symptoms persist beyond 36 hours, or if you observe signs of a severe allergic reaction, stop the medication immediately and seek emergency medical attention.
  • If vomiting occurs, give the solution in smaller, more frequent sips.

Precautions and Warnings of Dioralyte Relief Raspberry Sachets

  • Preparation is CRUCIAL: Always dissolve the contents of one sachet in exactly 200 ml of water. Using too little water makes the solution too strong (hypertonic), which can worsen dehydration or upset the balance of body salts.
  • Only Water: Do NOT dissolve the powder in milk, juice, soft drinks, or anything other than water.
  • Infants: For infants aged 3 months to 1 year, the product should only be given under medical supervision. Infants under 2 years with diarrhoea should be seen by a doctor as soon as possible.
  • Storage after Mixing: The liquid should be made up immediately before use. Any solution not used after 1 hour (or 24 hours if stored in a refrigerator) should be discarded.
  • Underlying Conditions: Consult a doctor if you are on a controlled sodium or potassium diet, or if you have severe kidney, liver, or heart problems.

searchable.name: Nutra Elderberry & Echinacea Tea
searchable.brief_info: Nutra Elderberry & Echinacea Tea is a powerful, naturally caffeine-free herbal infusion trusted to bolster the immune system, aid recovery from cold and flu symptoms, and provide a rich source of protective antioxidants.
searchable.description: Nutra Elderberry & Echinacea Tea is a premium herbal tea blend (typically 60% Elderberry and 40% Echinacea) created to naturally support the body's defence system. This infusion is 100% pure herbs, often pharmacist-formulated, and is free from artificial colours, flavours, and added sugars. It is an ideal addition to your daily routine for proactive immune support and to help speed up recovery during seasonal illnesses.
searchable.how_to_use:

Nutra Elderberry & Echinacea Tea is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Food Supplement.

Drink 1 cup per day, or up to 3 times a day for temporary immune support, or as directed by a healthcare professional.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral beverage (infusion).
  • How to Prepare: Pour 200 ml of boiling water over 1 tea bag. Squeeze the tea bag gently to release all the goodness. Allow to steep for 4-5 minutes.
  • Timing: Can be enjoyed at any time of day, as it is naturally caffeine-free.
  • Reusability: The tea bags are often designed to be reused up to three times per day with minimal impact on potency.

Missed Dose Guidance

  • Not applicable. Consistency is key for immune support.
searchable.specification: The active ingredients are Elderberry (60%) and Echinacea (40%). It is supplied as herbal tea bags (typically 20 bags per box). It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Herbal Tea/Food Supplement.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Nutra Elderberry & Echinacea Tea

Do NOT consume Nutra Elderberry & Echinacea Tea if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Elderberry, Echinacea, or plants in the Daisy/Aster family (e.g., ragweed, marigolds).

  • Are undergoing treatment with immunosuppressant medication (e.g., following an organ transplant), as Echinacea may counteract the drug's effects.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. There is limited reliable safety information regarding the high concentration of these herbs during pregnancy and lactation. It is recommended to seek advice from a healthcare professional for personalized guidance.

Side Effects of Nutra Elderberry & Echinacea Tea

Side effects are rare when the tea is consumed as directed.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): None typically expected.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Autoimmune Flare: Potential to exacerbate symptoms of autoimmune diseases.
    • Severe Allergic Reactions: Rash, hives, swelling of the face, or difficulty breathing.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you experience any persistent or severe adverse effects, or signs of an allergic reaction, discontinue use immediately and consult a physician.

Precautions and Warnings of Nutra Elderberry & Echinacea Tea

  • Dosage Limit: Do not exceed the recommended daily intake (often advised to be no more than three cups per day).

searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Nutra Lemon Grass & Ginger Tea

Do NOT consume Nutra Lemon Grass & Ginger Tea if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Lemongrass, Ginger, or plants in the Ginger or Grass family.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor. While ginger can relieve nausea, Lemongrass is sometimes cited to potentially stimulate uterine and menstrual flow in large quantities. It is advised to limit ginger intake to 1 gram per day and seek personalized medical advice before using this tea during pregnancy.
  • Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. There is insufficient reliable information on safety during breastfeeding; avoid use unless medically supervised.

Side Effects of Nutra Lemon Grass & Ginger Tea

Side effects are generally mild and related to excessive consumption or sensitivity.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Excessive intake may cause heartburn, stomach irritation, acid reflux, or mild diarrhoea/bloating.

    • Drug Interactions: Both ginger and lemongrass may interact with prescription medications, potentially enhancing or reducing their effects.
    • Severe Allergic Reactions: Rash, hives, swelling of the face, or difficulty breathing.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you experience persistent heartburn or severe digestive upset, reduce consumption to one cup daily or discontinue use and consult a physician.

Precautions and Warnings of Nutra Lemon Grass & Ginger Tea

  • Blood Thinners (Anticoagulants): Consult your doctor or pharmacist. Ginger has anti-platelet activity and may interact with blood-thinning medications (like Warfarin), potentially increasing the risk of bleeding.
  • Blood Pressure/Diabetes Medications: Both herbs may affect blood pressure (Lemongrass may lower it) or blood sugar. Monitor blood pressure and glucose levels closely if you are on prescription medication for these conditions.
  • Gallstones: People with gallstones should use ginger-containing products with caution.
  • Preparation: Use freshly boiled water and steep for the recommended time (4-5 minutes) to extract maximum therapeutic compounds.
  • Limit Intake: Avoid exceeding 3 cups per day for prolonged periods without professional advice.

searchable.name: Halls Breezers Drops

Slowly dissolve one (1) drop in the mouth as required, typically every 2-3 hours.

Timing: Use as needed for throat comfort and dryness.
searchable.specification: The active ingredient is typically Pectin (Oral Demulcent) or a low concentration of Menthol. It is supplied as hard or soft throat drops in a bag or pack (common size is 30 drops). It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Oral Demulcent/Throat Lozenge.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Halls Breezers Creamy Strawberry Drops

Do NOT consume Halls Breezers Creamy Strawberry Drops if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to any ingredient in the drops (e.g., strawberry flavouring, pectin, or colorants).
  • Have a persistent, severe, or chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm (consult a doctor first).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. While generally considered safe as a food item, individuals should consult a healthcare professional before relying on any lozenge for regular symptom relief during pregnancy or lactation.

Side Effects of Halls Breezers Creamy Strawberry Drops

Side effects are rare when the product is used as directed.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): None typically expected. Excessive consumption may cause mild digestive upset or slight diarrhoea (if high in sugar alcohols).
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Choking Hazard: Risk of choking, especially in young children if swallowed whole.
    • Allergic Reactions: Persistent rash, severe swelling of the mouth/throat, or hives.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you experience persistent sore throat symptoms for more than 7 days, or if you notice any signs of a severe allergic reaction, discontinue use and consult a physician immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Halls Breezers Creamy Strawberry Drops

  • Choking Risk: Not recommended for children under 4 years of age due to the high risk of choking. Adults should supervise young children while consuming.

searchable.brief_info: Halls Cough & Throat Relief Drops are a trusted medicated lozenge that provides fast, penetrating relief from coughs, soothes sore throats, and helps clear nasal passages with its strong cooling vapours.
