searchable.name: Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies
searchable.brief_info: Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies offer a delicious, easy-to-take way to support the immune system, provide powerful antioxidant protection, and aid in collagen formation for healthy skin.
searchable.description: Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies are a high-quality dietary supplement formulated to deliver the essential nutrient Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) in a highly palatable, chewable gummy form. Each gummy typically contains 250 mg of Vitamin C, a significant dose designed to meet daily requirements and provide an extra boost for immune health. The soft, fruit-flavored gummy makes it an excellent option for adults and adolescents who have difficulty swallowing traditional tablets or capsules. This supplement is an easy and effective way to ensure consistent daily intake of this powerful antioxidant, supporting the body's natural defenses against free radicals and environmental stress.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies

Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) dietary supplement.

Adults: Chew 1 to 2 gummies daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral (chewable gummy).
  • How to Take: Chew the gummy completely before swallowing. Do not swallow the gummy whole.
  • Timing: Can be taken at any time of day. Taking it with a meal can help minimize stomach upset.

Missed Dose Guidance

  • Not applicable. Consistency is key for immune support. Simply take the next scheduled dose as usual.
searchable.specification: The active ingredient is Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C 250mg) per gummy. It is supplied as fruit-flavored chewable gummies, typically in bottles of 150 or 200 count. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Dietary Supplement.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies

Do NOT take Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Ascorbic Acid or any other ingredients in the gummy (e.g., specific gelatin, corn syrup, or flavourings).
  • Have a history of kidney stones or are prone to them, as high doses of Vitamin C may increase the risk in susceptible individuals.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. While Vitamin C is essential, consult a physician before taking any supplement during pregnancy or lactation to ensure the dosage is appropriate and within recommended limits.

Side Effects of Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies

Side effects are rare when the product is used as directed.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Excessive consumption (significantly over the recommended dose) may cause mild gastrointestinal upset, such as diarrhoea, nausea, or heartburn.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Hypervitaminosis: Rare, but chronic, extremely high doses may increase the risk of oxalate kidney stone formation.
    • Allergic Reactions: Persistent rash, hives, swelling of the mouth/throat, or difficulty breathing.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • If you experience persistent severe gastrointestinal upset, discontinue use and consult a physician.
  • For any signs of a severe allergic reaction, seek emergency medical assistance immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Nature Made Vitamin C 250mg Gummies

  • Dosage Limit: Do NOT exceed the recommended daily dosage (typically 1-2 gummies daily for adults) to avoid gastrointestinal upset and the long-term risk of kidney stones associated with high Vitamin C intake.
  • Sugar Content: The gummies contain sugar (often corn syrup and sucrose). Diabetics or individuals on controlled-sugar diets must factor the sugar and caloric content into their daily intake.
  • Choking Hazard: The gummies should be chewed thoroughly before swallowing, especially by adolescents or younger users, to prevent choking.
  • Keep Out of Reach: The appealing taste can make children prone to accidental overdose. Store safely out of the sight and reach of children due to the potential toxicity of high-dose vitamins.
  • G6PD Deficiency: Individuals with this enzyme deficiency should consult a doctor before taking high doses of Vitamin C.

searchable.description: Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil is a high-volume aromatic liquid designed for long-lasting diffusion. Given the size and application, this product is typically a blend of a natural or nature-identical sandalwood fragrance base diluted in a carrier oil or solvent. It is formulated to consistently release the deep, rich, woody, and sweet aroma associated with Sandalwood, known for its ability to calm the mind and promote emotional balance. The large 100mL size offers exceptional value and convenience, requiring less frequent replenishment in your diffuser. Diffusion of this oil helps to create a tranquil, meditative environment, effectively reducing daily tension and promoting a sense of well-being in your home or workspace.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil

Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil 100mL is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) aromatherapy product.

Use 3 to 5 drops in an electric diffuser, per diffusion session.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Inhalation via diffusion.
  • How to Use (Electric Diffuser):
    1. Fill the diffuser reservoir with the recommended amount of clean water.
    2. Add 3 to 5 drops of Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil.
    3. Turn on the diffuser for a maximum of 60 minutes.

Timing: Diffuse during periods of stress, while meditating, or 1 hour before bedtime to promote relaxation.
searchable.specification: The active ingredient is a Sandalwood Aromatic Blend (containing Santalols). It is supplied as a concentrated aromatic liquid in a 100mL bottle. It is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) Aromatherapy/Fragrance Oil.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil

Do NOT use Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Sandalwood or any components of the oil blend.
  • Are applying it undiluted directly to the skin or mucous membranes.
  • Are using it internally (do not swallow).

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. Many essential oils are advised against during pregnancy and lactation. Use of Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil should only occur after professional medical consultation.

Side Effects of Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil

Side effects are generally rare and linked to sensitivity or improper use.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild skin irritation or redness if applied to the skin undiluted. Excessive inhalation in a small, unventilated room may cause mild headaches or nausea.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Severe Allergic Reactions: Persistent rash, hives, or difficulty breathing.
    • Systemic Toxicity: Severe symptoms (vomiting, confusion) if the concentrated oil is swallowed.

What to do if side effects occur:

  • For mild irritation, reduce the diffusion time or dilute the oil more heavily.
  • If accidentally swallowed: Seek emergency medical attention immediately. Do not induce vomiting.
  • If severe allergic symptoms occur, discontinue use and consult a physician immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Viaderma Diffuser Sandalwood Oil

  • External Use Only: This oil is for diffusion and topical application (when diluted). Do not swallow.
  • Dilution is Required for Skin: CRUCIAL WARNING: NEVER apply the oil directly to the skin, eyes, or mucous membranes without properly diluting it in a suitable carrier oil.
  • Children and Pets: Use caution in households with young children (under 6 years) and pets, as essential oils can be toxic to them. Diffuse for short periods only in well-ventilated areas, and keep the bottle safely out of reach.
  • Diffusion Duration: Do not diffuse continuously. Limit diffusion sessions to 30-60 minutes at a time, followed by a break of at least 30 minutes.

Flammability: The oil may be flammable. Keep the bottle away from heat, sparks, and open flames.

searchable.name: Elastoplast Water Resistant
searchable.brief_info: Elastoplast Water Resistant plasters offer dependable wound protection that stays put, even when exposed to moisture.
searchable.description: Elastoplast Water Resistant plasters are engineered with a powerful, skin-friendly adhesive, these plasters are specifically designed to repel water and dirt, ensuring your minor cuts, scrapes, and abrasions remain covered and protected during activities like handwashing, showering, or light contact with water. The breathable yet water-repellent backing creates an optimal hygienic healing environment by sealing out external contaminants. The non-stick wound pad protects and cushions the injury for gentle removal. Choose the trusted Elastoplast Water Resistant brand for high-quality, waterproof-like minor wound care.
searchable.how_to_use:
Proper Administration and Dosage of Elastoplast Water Resistant

Since this is an adhesive plaster (topical dressing), traditional 'dosage' instructions do not apply. Proper use ensures optimal wound protection:

  1. Cleanse: Gently clean the minor wound thoroughly with water or a mild antiseptic.
  2. Dry: Pat the wound and the surrounding skin area completely dry. The adhesive requires dry skin to stick effectively.
  3. Apply: Remove the protective paper and apply the Elastoplast Water Resistant plaster without stretching it. Ensure the wound pad fully covers the injury.
  4. Secure: Press the edges of the plaster down firmly to create a complete water-resistant seal around the wound.
searchable.specification:
Product Name: Elastoplast Water Resistant

Type: Adhesive Plaster/Bandage

Pack Size: Available in various counts including 10 strips, 20 strips, and Assorted Packs of 40 strips.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Elastoplast Water Resistant

  • Pre-existing Medical Conditions: Avoid using for severe burns, deep stab wounds, heavily bleeding injuries, or clinically infected wounds. These require immediate medical assessment.
  • Drug Allergies: Do not use if you have a known allergy to common plaster materials, such as acrylics (adhesives) or the wound pad material. Individuals with a latex allergy should confirm the specific product packaging is labelled as "latex-free."
  • Age/Pregnancy/Breastfeeding: As a non-medicated plaster, it is generally safe for use across all age groups and during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

Side Effects of Elastoplast Water Resistant

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild localized skin irritation, itching, or redness, particularly upon removal or in individuals with sensitive skin.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Allergic contact dermatitis (a persistent, itchy, blistering rash that spreads beyond the edges of the plaster) or a severe allergic reaction to latex (if present in the packaging).
  • What to do if side effects occur: If you notice severe irritation, blistering, or signs of wound infection (e.g., increased pain, swelling, discharge, fever), remove the plaster and consult a registered medical practitioner immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Elastoplast Water Resistant

  • Before starting: Always ensure the wound is clean and free from foreign objects before application.
  • During use: Monitor the wound daily. If the wound shows signs of infection or does not improve within a few days, discontinue use and seek professional medical advice.
  • Long-term Safety: This product is intended for short-term management of minor wounds. Prolonged, continuous use on the same skin area without cleaning should be avoided.

searchable.name: Nutra Joint Tea
searchable.brief_info: Nutra Joint Tea is an expertly formulated herbal blend designed to nourish your joints, maintain flexibility, and promote overall musculoskeletal well-being.
searchable.description: Nutra Joint Tea is a distinctive herbal infusion created to support and maintain the health of your joints and bones. Developed by pharmacists and nutritionists, the efficacy of this blend lies in its carefully selected 100% pure herbal ingredients, prominently featuring Curcumin (from Turmeric), Green Tea, and Piperine. Unlike many supplements, this tea offers a convenient and easily absorbed method to integrate powerful anti-inflammatory and antioxidant compounds into your daily regimen. Nutra Joint Tea is an ideal choice for anyone seeking a natural, warming, and functional beverage to promote joint flexibility and reduce stiffness.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Nutra Joint Tea

Nutra Joint Tea is an Over-the-Counter (OTC) herbal food supplement.

  • Dosage: Enjoy two to three cups daily as part of a balanced diet. Do not exceed three cups per day.

Proper Administration

  • Route: Oral (infusion).
  • How to Use: Pour approximately 200 ml of freshly boiled water over a single tea bag.
  • Steeping Time: Let the tea steep for four to five minutes to allow full release of the active ingredients.
  • Reusability: Each tea bag can be reused up to three times per day to maximise the herbal benefit.
  • Timing: Can be enjoyed anytime of the day, with or without food.
  • Missed Dose Guidance: Not applicable, as this is a daily food supplement and not a prescription medication with strict dosing times. Simply resume your normal daily use.
searchable.specification:
Product Name: Nutra Joint Tea

Type: Herbal Tea Infusion/Food Supplement

Active Ingredients: Curcumin (50%), Green Tea (30%), Piperine (20%)

Pack Size: Typically supplied as 20 enveloped tea bags.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Nutra Joint Tea

Do NOT consume Nutra Joint Tea if you:

  • Have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Curcumin, Green Tea, Piperine, or any components of the blend.
  • Are on prescribed medication with a narrow therapeutic index or blood-thinning medications (anticoagulants), as Curcumin may interfere with blood clotting. Consult a doctor first.
  • Suffer from high blood pressure or specific heart conditions, due to the caffeine content in the Green Tea component.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding Warnings

  • Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor. While herbal, the high concentration of certain ingredients requires professional medical advice before consumption during pregnancy or lactation.

Side Effects of Nutra Joint Tea

Side effects are uncommon when consumed as directed and are generally mild.

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild digestive issues such as slight stomach upset, nausea, or diarrhea, particularly if consumed on an empty stomach or in excessive quantities.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (that may require medical attention):
    • Hypersensitivity Reactions: Symptoms like a persistent rash, severe itching, or swelling of the face/throat.
    • Interaction with Medication: Increased risk of bleeding if taken alongside blood thinners without supervision.
  • What to do if side effects occur:
    • If you experience symptoms of a severe allergic reaction or persistent digestive discomfort, discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Nutra Joint Tea

  • Before starting: If you are on prescribed medication, suffer from any chronic health condition (especially liver or gallbladder issues, blood clotting disorders, or high blood pressure), or are unsure about its suitability, consult a healthcare professional.
  • Diabetics: This tea is typically sugar-free, but always verify the label if you are managing blood sugar levels.
  • Limit Intake: Do not consume more than three cups per day, as excessive intake of Curcumin or Green Tea can lead to unwanted side effects.
  • Avoid Substitution: Nutra Joint Tea is a dietary supplement/herbal beverage and should not be used as a substitute for a varied diet or prescribed medication for joint conditions.

Over The Counter (OTC): Adults and children 12 years and over:

  • Proper Administration: Drop one tablet into a glass of plain water. Wait until the tablet is fully dissolved before consuming the entire drink.
  • Best Time: Can be taken at any time of day, ideally with a meal to optimize mineral absorption.
  • Missed Dose Guidance: Take the next dose as scheduled the following day. Do not double the dose.

Do NOT take Immunity Booster Effervescent Tablet (Lignel) if you have:

  • Drug Allergies: Known hypersensitivity to Ascorbic Acid, Zinc, or any component of the effervescent tablet.

Precautions and Warnings of Immunity Booster Effervescent Tablet (Lignel)

Before Starting: Consult your doctor if you have kidney problems, are taking blood thinners, or are pregnant/breastfeeding.

searchable.name: Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant X5
searchable.brief_info: Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant gives you quick relieve from the toughest cold and flu symptoms.
searchable.description: Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant X5 is provided in convenient sachets, this maximum strength formulation delivers a comforting hot drink with a powerful combination of Paracetamol (1000mg) to target pain and fever, and Phenylephrine Hydrochloride (12.2mg) to clear nasal congestion. The soothing blackcurrant flavour makes the medicine easy to take, providing comprehensive relief to help you feel like yourself again. Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant X5 is the trusted choice for adults seeking effective symptom management.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant X5

Over The Counter (OTC): Adults and children 16 years and over:

  • One sachet every 4 to 6 hours as required.
  • Do not take more than 4 sachets in 24 hours.
  • Proper Administration: Empty the contents of one sachet into a standard mug. Fill the mug with hot water (not boiling). Stir until dissolved and drink the hot solution.
  • Best Time: Can be taken at any time, but be aware that the decongestant may interfere with sleep if taken close to bedtime.

Missed Dose Guidance: Take the next dose when symptoms return, ensuring at least 4 hours have passed since the previous dose.
searchable.specification:
• Active Ingredients: Paracetamol 1000mg, Phenylephrine HCl 12.2mg
  • Pack Size: 5 Sachets
  • Storage Temperature: Store below 25°C, protected from moisture.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant X5

Do NOT take Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant X5 if you have:

  • Severe Health Conditions: Serious heart disease, high blood pressure (hypertension), an overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism), or severe liver/kidney disease.
  • Drug Interactions: Are taking or have taken Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors (MAOIs) for depression within the last 14 days, or are taking other Paracetamol-containing products.
  • Drug Allergies: Known hypersensitivity to Paracetamol, Phenylephrine, or any other ingredient.

Side Effects of Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant X5

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Headache, nervousness, and trouble sleeping (insomnia) due to the decongestant.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Severe allergic reactions (rash, swelling), fast or irregular heartbeat, or signs of liver damage (yellowing of eyes/skin, dark urine).
  • What to do: Stop use immediately and seek medical attention if you experience severe symptoms, signs of liver damage, or a very rapid heartbeat.

Precautions and Warnings of Lemsip Max Cold & Flu Blackcurrant X5

  • Maximum Dose: NEVER exceed the recommended dosage. The Paracetamol dose (1000mg per sachet) carries a high risk of severe liver damage if the maximum daily limit is exceeded.
  • Existing Conditions: Consult a doctor before use if you have diabetes, glaucoma, or non-severe heart/liver/kidney conditions.
  • Duration Limit: Do not take for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications

  • Postpill or Postinor 2: Do NOT use if you are already confirmed pregnant, have undiagnosed abnormal vaginal bleeding, or have known allergy to Levonorgestrel. It is generally not recommended for routine use.
  • 3H Viral Check: Positive results require immediate medical confirmation.
  • Vigor Chocolate: Consult a doctor if you have severe heart conditions, high blood pressure, or are sensitive to stimulants (if contained).
  • Durex Condom/K-Y Jelly: Do not use if allergic to latex (check specific condom type) or lubricant ingredients. Avoid oil-based lubricants with latex condoms.

Side Effects

  • Postpill or Postinor 2: Common: Nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, menstrual changes. Serious: Very rarely, severe abdominal pain (could indicate ectopic pregnancy).
  • Durex Condom/K-Y Jelly: Very rarely, localized irritation or allergic reaction (itching, rash).
  • Vigor Chocolate: May cause nervousness, rapid heartbeat, or GI upset if stimulants are present and overused.
  • What to do: If vomiting occurs within 2 hours of taking Postpill, seek immediate medical advice. If the menstrual period is more than 7 days late after taking Postpill, take a pregnancy test.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Postpill or Postinor 2: Emergency Use Only. This is NOT a substitute for regular contraception. It is most effective when taken within 72 hours of unprotected sex. It does not protect against STIs.
  • 3H Viral Check: This is a screening device, not a diagnosis. A positive result requires mandatory follow-up blood tests and counseling from a healthcare provider.
  • Durex Condom: Check the expiry date and integrity of the wrapper before use. Use only water-based or silicone-based lubricants with latex condoms.
  • Vigor Chocolate: Adhere to the recommended serving size, especially if sensitive to stimulants.
  • Pregnancy Test Kit: Follow instructions precisely.

searchable.brief_info: Daravit Omega 3 Softgels are a high-quality dietary supplement providing 1000 mg of Omega-3 Fish Oil, rich in the essential long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids: Eicosapentaenoic Acid (EPA) and Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA).
searchable.description: These fatty acids are critical nutrients that the body cannot produce efficiently, making supplementation vital for optimal health. Daravit Omega 3 is a trusted choice for supporting the health of your cardiovascular system, enhancing cognitive function, and maintaining joint flexibility, providing foundational support for overall well-being.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Daravit Omega 3 Softgels

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) nutritional supplement.

  • Adults & Children over 12 years: Take two softgels daily with the main meal, or as directed by a physician.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow the softgel whole with a glass of water or a warm drink. Do not crush or chew.
  • Best Time to Take: Daravit Omega 3 should only be taken on a full stomach, preferably with a main meal (e.g., lunch or dinner). This enhances absorption of the fat-soluble components and reduces the likelihood of a "fishy aftertaste" or burps.

Missed Dose Guidance: If you miss a dose, take the next scheduled dose as usual with your meal. Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Daravit Omega 3 Softgels

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT take Daravit Omega 3 if you have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to fish, shellfish, or any of the softgel components.
  • Bleeding Disorders: Use with extreme caution if you have a known bleeding disorder or are taking anticoagulant (blood-thinning) medications, due to the anti-platelet effect of Omega-3s.

Side Effects of Daravit Omega 3 Softgels

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Fishy aftertaste (burping), mild nausea, loose stools, or other minor gastrointestinal discomfort. These often lessen with consistent use, especially when taken with food.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): Nosebleeds, easy bruising, or signs of a severe allergic reaction (rash, swelling). If these symptoms occur, stop use and seek immediate medical advice.

Precautions and Warnings of Daravit Omega 3 Softgels

  • Blood Clotting: Omega-3 fatty acids can inhibit blood clotting. Consult your physician before starting Daravit Omega 3 if you are taking medications like Warfarin or Aspirin.
  • Diabetes/Hypothyroidism: Patients with diabetes or hypothyroidism should use Daravit Omega 3 with caution, as it may affect glucose and lipid metabolism; blood sugar levels may need monitoring.
  • Liver Function: If you have known liver problems, your doctor may monitor you more closely during supplementation.

Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: While Omega-3s are beneficial, particularly DHA for infant development, pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor to ensure the appropriate dosage and source are used.

searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Daravit Joint Flex Softgels

searchable.description: Ibakwik Softgel is a fixed-dose combination antimalarial medication presented as a soft gelatin capsule. searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Ibakwik Softgel

This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM).

  • Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician. The dosage is strictly based on the patient's body weight and must be administered over three consecutive days.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow the softgel whole with water. The softgel may be crushed and mixed with water for patients (like infants and young children) unable to swallow the capsule whole. The mixture must be used immediately.
  • Best Time to Take: Ibakwik Softgel should be taken without food. Each dose should be taken at the same time each day for three consecutive days, no less than 3 hours after the last food intake. Crucially, no food should be taken within 3 hours after each dose.

Missed Dose Guidance: If a dose is missed, it should be taken as soon as realized, and the recommended regimen continued until the full three-day course of treatment has been completed.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Typically 1 x 10's (in blister pack) or similar pack sizes to accommodate the 3-day course.
  • Form: Soft Gelatin Capsule.

searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Ibakwik Softgel

  • Cardiac Conditions: Do NOT administer to patients with a family history or known cardiac disorders (e.g., congenital QT prolongation, cardiac arrhythmia, severe hypertension, congestive cardiac failure) due to the risk of QT interval prolongation.
  • Electrolyte Disturbances: Contraindicated in patients with uncorrected electrolyte disturbances, particularly low potassium (hypokalaemia), low calcium (hypocalcaemia), or low magnesium (hypomagnesaemia).
  • Known Allergies: Do NOT take if you have a known allergy to artemisinin or piperaquine or any components of the softgel.
  • Pregnancy (First Trimester): Use during the first trimester of pregnancy is generally avoided unless no other suitable or effective antimalarial is available.

Side Effects of Ibakwik Softgel

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild gastrointestinal disturbances (nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort), headache, or dizziness.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): Cardiac disorders (e.g., QT prolongation, tachycardia - fast heartbeat). Seek immediate medical attention if you experience palpitations, chest pain, or fainting.

Precautions and Warnings of Ibakwik Softgel

  • ECG Monitoring: Physicians may consider obtaining an Electrocardiogram (ECG) from all patients, especially those with underlying risk factors, before the last dose and 4–6 hours afterwards, to monitor the QT interval.
  • Drug Interactions: Inform your doctor immediately if you are taking any other medications that prolong the QT interval (e.g., antiarrhythmics, certain antibiotics like macrolides or fluoroquinolones, other antimalarials like quinine, chloroquine, or mefloquine), as combination use is strictly forbidden.
  • Hepatic/Renal Impairment: Administer with caution to patients over 60 years of age or those with impaired kidney or liver function.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Use only if the expected benefit outweighs the potential risk. Seek professional medical guidance before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Advil Tablets

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT take if you have a known allergy to Ibuprofen, Aspirin, other NSAIDs, or any other ingredients.
  • Gastrointestinal Issues: Do NOT take if you have a current or previous history of stomach or duodenal ulceration, bleeding, or perforation.
  • Severe Organ Impairment: Do NOT take if you have severe heart, kidney, or liver failure.

Side Effects of Advil Tablets

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Indigestion, nausea, heartburn, abdominal pain, or mild dizziness.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): Signs of gastrointestinal bleeding (black, tarry stools, vomiting blood), severe allergic reaction (difficulty breathing, swelling), or chest pain. Stop use immediately and seek urgent medical help if any serious symptoms occur.

Precautions and Warnings of Advil Tablets

  • Cardiovascular Risk: Use with caution if you have high blood pressure, heart problems, or stroke risk. Do NOT take before or after heart bypass surgery (CABG).
  • Stomach Bleeding: NSAIDs increase the risk of stomach bleeding, especially in older adults, those with a history of ulcers, and heavy alcohol users.
  • Medication Interactions: Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are taking blood thinners (Warfarin, Aspirin), corticosteroids, or certain blood pressure medications, as Ibuprofen can interfere with these drugs.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult a doctor. Ibuprofen must be avoided during the third trimester of pregnancy.

searchable.name: Breathe Right Nasal Strips X10
searchable.brief_info: Breathe Right Nasal Strips (10 Strips) is a small, convenient pack designed for first-time users or those needing short-term relief from nasal congestion and snoring. These strips provide an instant, non-medicated solution by mechanically lifting and opening the nasal passages.
searchable.description: Breathe Right Nasal Strips (10 Strips) are external, self-adhesive strips featuring flexible, spring-like bands. When placed across the bridge of the nose, the bands gently pull the sides of the nose outward, instantly opening the nasal passages. This simple mechanical action is proven to increase airflow by up to 31%, providing immediate relief from nasal stuffiness and reducing snoring. This pack is ideal for assessing the benefits of Breathe Right before committing to a larger supply.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Breathe Right Nasal Strips

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) device.

  • Adults and Children 5 years & over: Use one strip per application. Do not use more than one strip per day.

Proper Administration

  • Preparation: CLEAN your nose thoroughly. Wash and dry the skin completely to remove all oils and moisturisers.
  • Placement: PLACE the strip horizontally across the bridge of your nose, ensuring it is centered just above the flare of the nostrils.
  • Application: APPLY by pressing down firmly and rubbing the strip to activate the adhesive.

Removal: Remove the strip gently while washing your face with warm water or in the shower to loosen the adhesive.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 10 Strips
  • Form: Flexible Adhesive Strip (External Nasal Dilator)
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Breathe Right Nasal Strips

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT use if you have a known allergy to the adhesive or any materials in the strip.
  • Irritated Skin: Do NOT use over broken, sore, or severely irritated skin.

Side Effects of Breathe Right Nasal Strips

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Skin irritation or redness at the site of application.

Precautions and Warnings of Breathe Right Nasal Strips

  • External Use Only: This is an external device.
  • No OSA Treatment: The strips are not a treatment for Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA).

Age Restriction: Not recommended for children under 5 years of age.

searchable.name: Swift Ovulation Test Strips
searchable.brief_info: Swift Ovulation Test Strips are a simple, accurate, and cost-effective Over-The-Counter (OTC) diagnostic tool designed to help women predict their most fertile window. They work by detecting the surge in Luteinizing Hormone (LH) that precedes ovulation.
searchable.description: Swift Ovulation Test Strips are a highly sensitive and reliable diagnostic device used for in-vitro (outside the body) testing to determine the ideal time for conception. The test strips are designed to detect the spike in Luteinizing Hormone (LH) that occurs in a woman’s urine approximately 24 to 36 hours before an egg is released (ovulation). By clearly identifying the LH surge, Swift Ovulation Test Strips allow couples to time intercourse precisely, significantly increasing their chances of becoming pregnant within a given menstrual cycle.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Swift Ovulation Test Strips

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) in-vitro diagnostic device.

  • Adult Women: Use one strip daily around the predicted time of ovulation until a positive result is obtained.

Proper Administration

  • Timing: Begin testing a few days before the expected LH surge (calculated based on cycle length). Test once daily.
  • Urine Sample: Collect a urine sample in a clean, dry cup. Do NOT use first-morning urine, as LH is synthesized overnight and may not be accurately detected until later in the day. The ideal time to test is generally between 10 AM and 8 PM.
  • Testing: Dip the strip vertically into the urine up to the "MAX" line for the time specified (usually 5–10 seconds).

Reading Results: Lay the strip flat and read the result after the specified reading time (usually 5–10 minutes). A positive result (LH surge) occurs when the Test Line is as dark as or darker than the Control Line.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Varies (e.g., 5, 10 strips)
  • Form: Diagnostic Test Strip
  • Principle: Lateral flow immunoassay for LH detection.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Swift Ovulation Test Strips

  • Hormonal Medications: Results may be affected if the user is currently taking fertility drugs containing LH or hCG.
  • Existing Conditions: Results may be unreliable if the user has been diagnosed with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) or menopause, as baseline LH levels can be high.

Side Effects of Swift Ovulation Test Strips

  • None: There are no physical side effects associated with using the test strips, as they are non-invasive.

Precautions and Warnings of Swift Ovulation Test Strips

  • For External Use Only: The strips are for in-vitro diagnostic use only. Do not ingest.
  • Accuracy: Follow instructions precisely. Improper timing or fluid intake prior to testing can lead to inaccurate results.
  • Not Contraception: The strips are designed to assist with conception; they do not prevent pregnancy or protect against Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs).

searchable.name: Health Aid Haemovit Liquid Gold
searchable.brief_info: Haemovit Liquid Gold (produced by HealthAid) is a premium, multi-ingredient liquid nutritional tonic specifically formulated to support healthy blood formation, combat fatigue, and boost overall energy and vitality. It is often recommended for individuals feeling run down, those with dietary restrictions (like vegetarians), and menstruating women.
searchable.description: Haemovit Liquid Gold is a unique, great-tasting liquid supplement containing a synergistic blend of essential B-Vitamins, high-strength Iron, Zinc, Vitamin C, electrolytes, and natural botanical extracts like Ginkgo Biloba and Sarsaparilla. This complex formulation works to ensure the efficient production of red blood cells (haematinic support), enhance oxygen utilization, and boost energy metabolism. By delivering key nutrients often deficient in the diet, Haemovit Liquid Gold provides a systemic boost to health, helping to reduce tiredness and fatigue while supporting immune and nervous system function. The liquid format makes it easy to take for those who have difficulty swallowing tablets.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Haemovit Liquid Gold

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) food supplement.

  • Adults and Children over 6 years: Take 10 ml (two teaspoonfuls/one tablespoonful) daily.
  • Children 3-6 years: Take 5 ml (one teaspoonful) daily.
  • Do not exceed the recommended daily intake unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Shake the bottle well before use. Measure the dose using a medicine spoon or cup.
  • Best Time to Take: Preferably take with food (during a meal) to minimize stomach upset from the Iron content and enhance nutrient absorption.

Duration: Can be used long-term, but consult a doctor if severe fatigue or symptoms of anaemia persist.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Varies (Commonly 200 ml)
  • Form: Oral Liquid Tonic
  • Key Ingredients: Iron, Vitamins B1?, B2?, B3?, B5?, B6?, Folic Acid, B12?, Vitamin C, Zinc, Iodine, plus herbal extracts.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Haemovit Liquid Gold

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT take if you have a known allergy to any of the ingredients, including Iron, B-Vitamins, or herbal extracts (Ginkgo, Sarsaparilla, Birch).
  • Iron Overload: Do NOT use if you have conditions causing iron accumulation (e.g., Haemochromatosis).
  • Anticoagulants: Concomitant use with anticoagulants (blood thinners, e.g., Warfarin) is contraindicated due to the presence of Ginkgo Biloba, which may increase bleeding risk.

Side Effects of Haemovit Liquid Gold

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Gastrointestinal upset, constipation, or dark/black stools (due to Iron).
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): Signs of allergic reaction (rash, difficulty breathing). Stop use and consult a doctor immediately if severe symptoms occur.

Precautions and Warnings of Haemovit Liquid Gold

  • Drug Interactions: Consult your doctor or pharmacist if you are taking blood thinners, antiepileptic drugs, or any medications for high blood pressure, as herbal components or high vitamin doses may interact.
  • Diabetes: Due to the presence of honey and malt extract, individuals with diabetes should monitor their blood glucose levels closely.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult a healthcare provider before use to ensure the dosage of all vitamins and minerals is appropriate for your specific needs.

searchable.name: Health Aid Zincovit-C
searchable.brief_info: Zincovit-C Tablets/Lozenges are a specialized dietary supplement designed to provide comprehensive support for the immune system, particularly during periods of increased vulnerability like the cold and flu season. The lozenge format is specifically chosen to provide a soothing effect on the throat while delivering key nutrients.
searchable.description: Zincovit-C is a unique, pleasant-tasting lozenge (or chewable tablet) that combines three powerful ingredients: Vitamin C, Zinc, and Propolis Extract. The formulation is specifically targeted for optimal immune support and to help soothe the mucous lining of the throat, making it ideal for those suffering from the initial symptoms of a cold or flu, such as a sore throat. By delivering these immune-supporting and antioxidant agents in a lozenge format, Zincovit-C ensures that the active components provide local relief in the throat before being absorbed systemically to boost the body's natural defenses.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Zincovit-C Tablets/Lozenges

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) food supplement.

  • Children over 3 years of age: Suck or chew one tablet daily.
  • Children over 9 years: Can increase to two tablets daily.
  • Adults: Can have up to four tablets daily, but generally for limited periods (e.g., during the acute phase of a cold).
  • Do not exceed recommended daily intake unless advised by a healthcare professional.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Suck or chew the lozenge/tablet slowly to allow the active ingredients (especially Zinc and Propolis) to dissolve and release into the throat and mouth, maximizing the local soothing and immune-supporting effect.
  • Best Time to Take: Can be taken at any time of day, regardless of meals.

Duration: Use as needed to support immunity, but if taking high doses (e.g., 4 tablets daily), limit the duration to avoid excessive intake.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Varies (Commonly 60 lozenges/tablets)
  • Form: Chewable Lozenge / Tablet
  • Key Ingredients: Vitamin C, Zinc, and Propolis Extract
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Zincovit-C Tablets/Lozenges

  • Allergy to Bee Products: Do NOT use if you are allergic to Propolis, bees, or other bee products.
  • Known Allergies: Do NOT use if you have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to Zinc, Vitamin C, or any other ingredients.

Side Effects of Zincovit-C Tablets/Lozenges

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Expected): Mild gastrointestinal upset (nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea) or stomach discomfort, usually temporary.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (That May Require Medical Attention): Severe allergic reaction (swelling, difficulty breathing, rash). Stop use and consult a doctor immediately if severe symptoms occur.

Precautions and Warnings of Zincovit-C Tablets/Lozenges

  • High-Dose Zinc: While the dose is generally safe, excessive, prolonged intake of Zinc can lead to copper deficiency. Adhere to the recommended maximum daily dose.
  • Children: Only suitable for children aged 3 years and over.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult a healthcare provider before use to ensure the dosage is appropriate.
  • Underlying Conditions: If you have an underlying medical condition or are taking prescription medications, consult a doctor before use.

searchable.name: Nature's Field Daily Probiotics
searchable.brief_info: Nature's Field Daily Probiotics is a dietary supplement formulated to support digestive balance, gut health, and immune function. It typically contains a blend of beneficial bacteria strains designed to colonize the intestinal tract.
searchable.description: Nature's Field Daily Probiotics provides a carefully selected blend of beneficial live microorganisms (probiotics), measured in Colony Forming Units (CFUs). These "good bacteria" are essential for maintaining a healthy intestinal ecosystem. The supplement is formulated to replenish the natural gut flora that can be depleted by stress, poor diet, illness, or antibiotic use. By restoring this balance, Nature's Field Daily Probiotics supports proper digestion, nutrient absorption, and contributes significantly to the body's immune defense, as a large part of the immune system resides in the gut.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Nature's Field Daily Probiotics Capsules

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) food supplement.

  • Adults: Take one (1) capsule daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow the capsule whole with water.
  • Best Time to Take: The best time is typically in the morning, with or just after a meal, to buffer the bacteria against stomach acid. Alternatively, some brands recommend taking it at night before bed. Follow the specific instruction on the Nature's Field label.
  • During Antibiotics: If taking antibiotics, take the probiotic dose at least 2 to 3 hours before or after the antibiotic dose to prevent the antibiotic from killing the beneficial bacteria.

Consistency: Take consistently every day for optimal gut colonization and maintenance.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Varies (e.g., 30 or 60 capsules)
  • Form: Oral Capsule
  • Active Ingredients: Multi-Strain Probiotic Blend (measured in CFUs)
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Nature's Field Daily Probiotics Capsules

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT use if you have a known allergy or hypersensitivity to any ingredients (e.g., potential traces of dairy or soy, depending on the culture media used).

Side Effects of Nature's Field Daily Probiotics Capsules

  • Common Side Effects (Mild and Temporary): Initial mild digestive discomfort, such as temporary bloating or gas. This usually resolves within a few days as the body adjusts to the new bacteria.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Signs of a severe allergic reaction.

Precautions and Warnings of Nature's Field Daily Probiotics Capsules

  • Immunocompromised Individuals: Individuals who are severely immunocompromised (e.g., those undergoing chemotherapy or with central venous catheters) should consult a doctor before taking probiotics, due to a theoretical risk of infection.
  • Severe Illness: If you have severe, acute diarrhea, consult a doctor to rule out infectious causes before starting probiotics.
  • Medical Consult: If gas, bloating, or diarrhea persists for more than two weeks, consult a physician.

searchable.name: Gas Relief
searchable.brief_info: Certified Plus Gas Relief is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) medication used for the rapid and effective relief of gas symptoms. It is formulated as a softgel containing the antiflatulent agent Simethicone in a concentrated strength.
searchable.description: Certified Plus Gas Relief softgels contain Simethicone (80 mg), an active ingredient specifically designed to treat symptoms caused by excessive gas (flatulence) in the stomach and intestines. Simethicone works by a unique mechanical action: it decreases the surface tension of gas bubbles in the digestive tract. This causes the small gas bubbles to combine into larger ones, which can then be passed more easily by the body through burping or flatulence, leading to rapid relief from pressure and bloating.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Certified Plus Gas Relief Softgels

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) medicine.

  • Adults: Swallow 1 to 2 chewable tablets (80 mg to 160 mg) as needed, typically after meals and at bedtime.
  • Maximum Daily Dose: Do not exceed 6 tablets (480 mg) in any 24-hour period unless directed by a physician.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow the tablet whole with water. Do not chew or crush (unless specifically labeled as chewable).
  • Best Time to Take: Take after meals and at bedtime when you experience gas symptoms.
  • Frequency: Use only as needed for symptoms. Do not take your medication more often than directed.

Duration: Consult a doctor if symptoms worsen or persist for more than a few days.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Certified Plus Gas Relief Tablets

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT take if you are allergic to Simethicone (Dimethicone) or any of the inactive ingredients (e.g., gelatin, dyes).

Side Effects of Certified Plus Gas Relief Tablets

  • Common Side Effects (Rare and Mild): When taken as directed, side effects are very rare, but may include mild nausea or diarrhea.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Signs of an allergic reaction (rash, itching, hives, swelling of the face/throat). If this occurs, stop use and seek medical advice immediately.

Precautions and Warnings of Certified Plus Gas Relief Tablets

  • Symptoms Worsening: If your symptoms worsen, or if you experience severe abdominal pain, severe diarrhea, or blood in your stool, stop use and consult your healthcare provider immediately, as these could be signs of a more serious underlying condition.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult a health professional before use if pregnant or breast-feeding.

Thyroid Treatment: If you are undergoing treatment for a thyroid problem, consult your doctor, as Simethicone has been reported to interfere with some thyroid medication absorption, though this is rare.

searchable.name: Health Aid Relaxing Massage Oil
searchable.brief_info: Health Aid Relaxing Massage Oil is a premium topical product formulated with a blend of natural carrier oils and essential oils. It is designed to facilitate massage, nourish the skin, and provide aromatic relaxation, often featuring lavender and other calming botanicals.
searchable.description: Health Aid Relaxing Massage Oil is a carefully crafted blend of high-quality vegetable carrier oils (such as sweet almond oil, apricot kernel oil, or sunflower oil) combined with therapeutic essential oils. The oil's primary function is twofold: to provide a smooth, nourishing base for massage, reducing friction and leaving the skin soft and supple, and to deliver the aromatic benefits of the essential oil blend. Typically featuring calming scents like Lavender, Chamomile, or Ylang-Ylang, the oil aids in relaxation, eases muscle tension, and promotes a sense of well-being, making it ideal for relieving stress after a long day.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage and Administration

This is an external topical product.

  • Adults: Pour a small amount into the palm of the hand. Rub hands together to warm the oil before applying directly to the skin.

Proper Administration

  • Application: Apply directly to clean skin. For a full-body massage, focus on areas of tension (shoulders, neck, back, legs).
  • Timing: Can be used at any time. For relaxation, it is best applied in the evening or after a shower/bath when the skin is warm and receptive.
  • Warming: Always warm the oil in your hands before application; cold oil can cause muscles to tense up.
  • Patch Test: If you have sensitive skin, perform a patch test on a small area (e.g., inner forearm) before full use.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Varies (e.g., 100 ml, 250 ml bottle)
  • Form: Liquid Oil
  • Key Ingredients: Carrier Oils (e.g., Almond, Olive) and Essential Oils (e.g., Lavender, Chamomile).
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT use if you have a known allergy or sensitivity to any of the carrier or essential oils (e.g., nut allergies, if almond oil is used).
  • Broken Skin: Avoid applying to broken, severely inflamed, or irritated skin.

Side Effects

  • Common Side Effects (Local): Mild skin redness or transient irritation (especially if skin is very sensitive).
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Allergic contact dermatitis (rash) in individuals sensitive to a specific essential oil (e.g., strong reaction to a lavender component).

Precautions and Warnings

  • Essential Oil Potency: Essential oils are highly potent. Do not ingest the oil.
  • Photosensitivity: Certain essential oils (especially some citrus oils) can increase sensitivity to sunlight. Check the specific formula; if citrus oils are present, avoid sun exposure on treated skin.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Essential oil use during pregnancy and lactation can be restricted. Consult a healthcare provider before use if pregnant or breastfeeding.

searchable.description: Health Aid Revitalising Massage Oil is a specially blended oil that combines nourishing vegetable carrier oils (such as sweet almond or sunflower oil) with therapeutic essential oils chosen for their stimulating and invigorating properties. The oil provides excellent glide for massage, helps warm up stiff muscles, and delivers a brisk, uplifting scent—often featuring Eucalyptus, Rosemary, or Citrus notes—to boost mental focus and physical vitality.

Dosage and Administration

Proper Administration

Contraindications

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT use if you have a known allergy or sensitivity to any of the carrier or essential oils.

Side Effects

  • Common Side Effects (Local): Mild skin redness, warmth, or transient irritation, particularly from potent oils like Eucalyptus or Cinnamon (if present).
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Allergic contact dermatitis (rash) or severe irritation. Stop use immediately if a severe reaction occurs.

Precautions and Warnings
