searchable.name: Advil Junior Chew Grape Tablets
searchable.brief_info: Advil Junior Chewable Tablets (Grape flavor) are an Over-The-Counter (OTC) medication specifically formulated for children aged 2 to 11 years. They contain Ibuprofen, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), which provides fast and effective relief from pain and fever in a convenient, pleasant-tasting chewable format.
searchable.description: Advil Junior Chewable Tablets deliver Ibuprofen in a measured dose appropriate for children. The appealing grape flavour and chewable format make it easier for children who may struggle to swallow liquid suspensions or whole tablets. Ibuprofen is known for its strong anti-inflammatory properties, providing triple-action relief: reducing pain, lowering fever, and easing inflammation. This product is a trusted choice for parents seeking symptomatic relief for common childhood illnesses and injuries.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Advil Junior Chewable Tablets

The dosage is based on the child's weight or age. Always consult the product packaging or your doctor/pharmacist, especially if dosing by weight.

Dosage Instructions (Based on typical 100 mg tablet strength):

  • Ages 2 - 3 years (Approx. 10.9-15.9\kg): Take 1 tablet.
  • Ages 4 - 5 years (Approx. 16.0-21.7\kg): Take 1 or 2 tablets.
  • Ages 6 - 8 years (Approx. 21.8-27.2\kg): Take 2 tablets.
  • Ages 9 - 10 years (Approx. 27.3-32.6\kg): Take 2 or 3 tablets.
  • Ages 11 years (Approx. 32.7-43.2\kg): Take 3 tablets.

Frequency and Limits:

  • Repeat the dose every 6 to 8 hours as needed.
  • Do not exceed 4 doses (400 mg) in 24 hours for children aged 2-3 years.
  • Do not exceed 6 doses (600 mg) in 24 hours for children aged 4-11 years (based on maximum tablets per dose).
  • Do not exceed 40 mg/kg of body weight in 24 hours.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Ensure the child chews the tablet thoroughly before swallowing. Do not swallow whole.
  • Food: Can be taken with or without food. Taking it with food may help reduce the chance of stomach upset.
  • Duration: Do not use for more than 3 days for fever or 5 days for pain without consulting a doctor.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Varies (e.g., 24 or 36 tablets)
  • Form: Chewable Tablet
  • Active Ingredient: Ibuprofen 100 mg per tablet
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Advil Junior

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT give if the child is allergic to Ibuprofen, Aspirin, or other NSAIDs.
  • Stomach Issues: Do NOT give if the child has active stomach ulceration or gastrointestinal bleeding.
  • Severe Organ Impairment: Do NOT give if the child has severe heart, liver, or kidney problems.
  • Dehydration: Avoid use in severely dehydrated children (e.g., from severe vomiting or diarrhea).

Side Effects of Advil Junior

  • Common Side Effects (Mild): Nausea, vomiting, indigestion, or abdominal pain.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (Seek Immediate Attention): Signs of stomach bleeding (black, tarry stools), severe allergic reaction (hives, difficulty breathing), or worsening of asthma. Overdose of Ibuprofen can be very harmful; seek urgent medical help if too many tablets are taken.

Precautions and Warnings of Advil Junior

  • Asthma: Consult a doctor before giving if the child has asthma, as NSAIDs can sometimes trigger an attack.
  • Fluid Intake: Encourage plenty of fluids, especially if the child is unwell.
  • Medication Interactions: Consult a doctor if the child is taking any other medication, especially blood thinners or steroids.

searchable.name: Valu Health Allergy Tablets
searchable.brief_info: Valu Health Allergy Tablets contain Diphenhydramine Hydrochloride, a classic H1? antihistamine used to treat various allergy symptoms, motion sickness, and as a sleep aid due to its pronounced sedative effects.
searchable.description: Valu Health Allergy Tablets are a quick-acting antihistamine that works by blocking the effects of histamine, a chemical released by the body during an allergic reaction. This action provides effective, temporary relief from common allergy symptoms. Because Diphenhydramine crosses the blood-brain barrier easily, it causes significant drowsiness, which is a common side effect but also makes the product useful as a nighttime sleep aid (though it is not labeled specifically for this purpose unless indicated on the packaging).
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Valu Health Allergy Tablets

This is an Over-The-Counter (OTC) medicine.

  • Adults and Children 12 years and over: Take 1 or 2 tablets (25 mg or 50 mg) every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
  • Children 6 to 11 years: Take 1 tablet (25 mg) every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
  • Maximum Daily Dose: Do not exceed 12 tablets (300 mg) in any 24-hour period unless directed by a physician.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow the tablet whole with water.
  • Timing: Take as needed for symptoms. Be mindful that the effect lasts several hours and will cause drowsiness.

Duration: Use only for temporary symptomatic relief. If symptoms persist for more than 7 days, consult a doctor.
searchable.specification:
• Form: Oral Tablet (often film coated)
  • Active Ingredient: Diphenhydramine Hydrochloride 25 mg
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Valu Health Allergy Tablets

  • Children's Sleep: Do NOT use this product to try and make a child sleepy.
  • Known Allergies: Do NOT take if you have a known allergy to Diphenhydramine or any of the inactive ingredients.
  • Specific Health Issues: Consult a doctor before use if you have glaucoma, trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland, or a breathing problem (such as asthma, emphysema, or chronic bronchitis).

Side Effects of Valu Health Allergy Tablets

  • Common Side Effects (Expected): Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, nose, and throat, blurred vision, and difficulty urinating.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects (Medical Attention Needed): Nervousness, agitation, confusion (especially in the elderly), or signs of a severe allergic reaction.

Precautions and Warnings of Valu Health Allergy Tablets

  • Sedation Risk: Be aware that the sedative effects can last into the next morning, potentially impairing judgment and coordination.
  • Elderly Patients: Use caution in the elderly, as they are more likely to experience side effects like dizziness, sedation, and confusion.

Drug Interactions: Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are taking sedatives, tranquilizers, or any other medications that cause drowsiness, as the combination can amplify the effects.

searchable.name: 2FA Lite
searchable.brief_info: This OneHealth 2FA Lite Kit provides the ultimate dual-protection strategy for sexual health. It combines Levofem (Combined Oral Contraceptive - COC) for highly effective pregnancy prevention with Fiesta Ribbed Condoms (a barrier method) for robust protection against Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs) and added assurance against pregnancy (in case of missed pills or contraceptive failure). This kit represents the most responsible approach to sexual health, ensuring both maximal efficacy and maximum safety.
searchable.description:
This kit addresses dual protection needs:

  • Levofem (Combined Oral Contraceptive):
    • Contraception: Highly effective prevention against unintended pregnancy through hormonal suppression of ovulation.
    • Cycle Regulation: Helps achieve regular, often lighter, and more predictable menstrual periods.
  • Fiesta Ribbed Condoms:
    • STI Protection: Acts as a physical barrier against STIs, including HIV, Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, and Herpes.
    • Contraceptive Backup: Provides secondary pregnancy protection, covering risks associated with a missed pill, vomiting, or drug interactions.

Enhanced Sensation: The ribbed texture is designed to increase pleasure and stimulation for both partners.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Components

  • Levofem Tablets: Take one tablet daily at the same time each day. Do not miss a dose.
  • Fiesta Ribbed Condoms: Use one new condom for every single act of intercourse. Maximum use is one time per condom.

Proper Administration

  • Levofem: Follow the arrows on the pack. If you miss a dose, use a backup method (condom) for 7 days. If you vomit within 3 hours of taking a pill, treat it as a missed pill.
  • Fiesta Condoms: Apply to the erect penis before any sexual contact. Pinch the reservoir tip. After ejaculation, hold the rim and withdraw while the penis is still erect.
searchable.specification:
• Levofem X28 Tablets - 1 pack 
  • Fiesta Condom X3 - 1 pack
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications

  • Levofem: Do NOT use if you have a history of blood clots (DVT/PE), uncontrolled high blood pressure, history of stroke, certain cancers (especially breast cancer), or severe liver disease.
  • Fiesta Ribbed Condoms: Do NOT use if you or your partner has a known allergy to natural rubber latex.

Side Effects

  • Levofem (Hormonal): Common side effects include nausea, headache, breast tenderness, weight changes, and spotting or breakthrough bleeding (in the first few months).
  • Fiesta Condoms (Barrier): Mild local irritation or warmth from the lubricant.
  • Serious Side Effects (Levofem): Increased risk of blood clots, heart attack, and stroke.
  • What to do: Stop Levofem immediately and seek emergency medical care if you experience sharp chest pain, sudden breathlessness, severe calf pain, or sudden severe headache (potential signs of a blood clot).

Precautions and Warnings

  • Levofem Drug Interactions: Consult a doctor if taking certain medications (especially some antibiotics or anti-epileptics), as they can reduce Levofem's effectiveness. Use condoms for the full duration of the interaction.
  • Levofem Smoking Risk: Smoking while using COCs significantly increases the risk of serious cardiovascular side effects (especially over age 35).
  • Condom Lubricant: Only use water-based or silicone-based lubricants with latex condoms. Oil-based lubricants must be avoided as they degrade the latex barrier, leading to breakage.
  • STI Protection: The pill does NOT protect against STIs. The condom is the only element in this kit offering STI protection.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding (Levofem): Use is restricted or altered. Consult a doctor before starting or continuing use during these periods.

searchable.name: Youtheory Ashwagandha
searchable.brief_info: Youtheory Ashwagandha is a premium dietary supplement designed to help the body adapt to the mental and physical rigors of modern life.
searchable.description: Youtheory Ashwagandha is a full-spectrum adaptogenic formula containing organic Ashwagandha root extract (KSM-66®) and whole root powder. This supplement is designed to help the body maintain homeostasis (internal balance) when faced with physical or emotional stress. By supporting the endocrine system, it helps regulate energy levels and promotes a sense of well-being. Its reputation as a trusted choice stems from its use of clinically backed ingredients that ensure high potency and bioavailability.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Youtheory Ashwagandha Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician. The standard recommended adult dosage is two (2) capsules daily, taken together or in divided doses.

Proper Administration

  • Method: Swallow capsules whole with a full glass of water.
  • Timing: Can be taken at any time of day. Many users prefer evening use to support relaxation, while others take it in the morning for sustained stress support.
  • Food Interaction: May be taken with or without food; however, taking it with a light meal may prevent mild stomach upset in sensitive individuals.
  • Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is nearly time for your next dose, skip the missed one. Do not double the dose.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 180 Capsules
  • Form: Vegetable Capsules
  • Strength: 1,000 mg Ashwagandha blend per serving
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Youtheory Ashwagandha

  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Do NOT use; Ashwagandha is linked to potential uterine contractions and has not been cleared for breastfeeding safety.
  • Allergies: Avoid if you are allergic to nightshades (Solanaceae family), such as eggplant or peppers.

CAge Restrictions: Not intended for use by persons under the age of 18.

Side Effects of Youtheory Ashwagandha

  • Common: Mild drowsiness, nausea, or loose stools.
  • Serious but Rare: Signs of liver distress (yellowing of eyes/skin) or severe allergic reactions (difficulty breathing).
  • Action: If gastrointestinal upset persists, try taking the supplement with food. If a severe reaction occurs, seek medical attention immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Autoimmune Conditions: Consult a doctor if you have Lupus, MS, or Rheumatoid Arthritis, as Ashwagandha may stimulate the immune system.
  • Surgery: Stop taking at least 2 weeks before a scheduled surgery as it may affect the central nervous system when combined with anesthesia.
  • Drug Interactions: Use caution if taking immunosuppressants, sedatives (e.g., benzodiazepines), or thyroid medications.

searchable.name: Amber Moisturising Hand Cream (Beauty Formulas)
searchable.brief_info: Amber Moisturising Hand Cream is a travel-friendly, intensive treatment designed to hydrate and soothe dry, overworked hands. It blends a rich, warm amber fragrance with nourishing ingredients to restore softness and maintain the skin’s natural moisture barrier.
searchable.description: This moisturising hand cream is part of Beauty Formulas' targeted hand care range. It features a non-greasy, lightweight formula that absorbs quickly into the skin, providing immediate relief from dryness without leaving a slippery residue. The "Amber" variant is distinguished by its warm, sophisticated scent and its focus on deep nourishment.
searchable.how_to_use:
Application Method

  • Step 1: Ensure hands are clean and dry before application.
  • Step 2: Squeeze a small, pea-sized amount onto the back of your hand.
  • Step 3: Massage the cream into the backs of both hands, then work it through your fingers, knuckles, and especially the cuticles.
  • Step 4: Continue rubbing until the cream is fully absorbed and the skin feels soft.

Proper Administration

  • Frequency: Apply as needed throughout the day. It is highly recommended to reapply after every handwash to replace lost natural oils.
  • Overnight Treatment: For more intensive repair, apply a slightly thicker layer before bed and allow it to nourish your skin while you sleep.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 30ml Travel-Friendly Tube
  • Form: Topical Cream
  • Fragrance: Warm Amber
  • Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types, particularly dry and combination skin.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT use if you have a known sensitivity to any listed fragrance components (e.g., Benzyl Salicylate, Linalool, or Limonene).
  • Broken Skin: Do not apply to skin that is severely irritated, bleeding, or inflamed.

Side Effects

  • Sensitivities: While rare, some users may experience mild redness or itching if they have an allergy to specific perfume components. If irritation occurs, discontinue use immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • External Use Only: Not for ingestion. Keep away from children and pets.
  • Avoid Eyes: In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of clean water.

Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and excessive heat to prevent the formula from separating or the fragrance from fading.

searchable.name: Cranberry Moisturising Hand Cream (Beauty Formulas)
searchable.brief_info: Cranberry Moisturising Hand Cream is a revitalizing treatment formulated to provide deep hydration while protecting the skin with the natural power of fruit extracts. It combines a vibrant, fruity scent with a fast-absorbing formula to leave hands feeling refreshed and silky smooth.
searchable.description: This moisturising hand cream is designed for those who need effective hydration with the added benefit of antioxidants. The cranberry-infused formula helps to neutralize environmental stressors that can age the skin on the hands. Its lightweight texture is specifically engineered to absorb rapidly, making it ideal for frequent use throughout the day.
searchable.how_to_use:
Application Method

  • Step 1: Start with clean, dry hands.
  • Step 2: Dispense a small amount of cream onto the back of your hand.
  • Step 3: Massage the cream into the skin, focusing on the driest areas such as the knuckles and the skin surrounding the fingernails.
  • Step 4: Rub until the cream is fully absorbed and the refreshing fruity scent is released.

Proper Administration

  • Frequency: Use as often as desired. For the best results, apply immediately after washing your hands to seal in the moisture while the skin is still slightly hydrated.
  • Travel Use: The compact tube is designed for portability; keep it in your bag or car for hydration on the go.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 30ml Travel Tube
  • Form: Topical Cream
  • Fragrance: Fresh Cranberry
  • Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types, especially those looking for an antioxidant boost.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications

  • Known Allergies: Do NOT use if you have a known allergy to cranberries or any of the synthetic fragrance components.
  • Severe Dermatitis: If you have broken or weeping skin, consult a pharmacist before applying scented hand creams.

Side Effects

  • Minor Irritation: Users with extremely sensitive skin may experience a slight tingling due to the fruit acid/extract content. If redness or a rash develops, stop use.

Precautions and Warnings

  • External Use Only: Avoid contact with the mouth and internal membranes.
  • Avoid Eyes: If the cream enters the eyes, rinse thoroughly with cool water.
  • Storage: Store below 25°C in a dry place. Keep the cap tightly closed when not in use to prevent the cream from drying out.

searchable.name: Neurozan Plus
searchable.brief_info: Neurozan Plus is an advanced dual-pack supplement designed to provide comprehensive nutritional support for the "most complex machine ever built"—the human brain. It combines high-potency micronutrient tablets with high-purity Omega-3 DHA capsules. This expert formula helps safeguard the intake of nutrients essential for maintaining normal brain function, cognitive performance, and mental vitality.
searchable.description: Neurozan Plus is a premium, research-based supplement that goes beyond standard multivitamins. Each pack contains two distinct components: a specialized micronutrient tablet and a high-purity Omega-3 capsule providing 300mg of DHA. Together, they deliver a synergistic blend of vitamins, minerals, and specialist nutrients like Ginkgo Biloba, 5-HTP, and Phosphatidylserine. It is the ideal choice for individuals seeking to support their memory, concentration, and long-term neurological health.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Neurozan Plus Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician. The standard adult dosage is one (1) micronutrient tablet (purple blister) AND one (1) Omega-3 capsule (pink blister) per day.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow each with water or a cold drink. Do not chew.
  • Best Time: Take during or immediately after your main meal.
  • Food Interaction: Must be taken on a full stomach to ensure maximum absorption of fat-soluble vitamins and to prevent stomach upset.
  • Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember with food. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed one.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 56 units (28 Tablets + 28 Capsules)
  • Form: Dual-pack (Solid Tablet and Softgel Capsule)
  • Key Components: 300mg DHA, Ginkgo Biloba, 5-HTP, 1000 IU Vitamin D3
searchable.famasi_advice:
Contraindications of Neurozan Plus

  • Allergies: Contains fish oil and soya. Do not use if you are allergic to fish, soya, or any of the listed ingredients.
  • Age Restrictions: Not suitable for children under 12 years of age.
  • Medical Conditions: Not recommended for individuals with a history of epilepsy without medical consultation.

Side Effects of Neurozan Plus

  • Common Side Effects: Mild stomach upset, headache, or a metallic taste in the mouth.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Signs of an allergic reaction (rash, swelling) or interference with blood clotting.
  • Action: If you experience persistent gastrointestinal discomfort, ensure you are taking it with a large meal. If a rash develops, discontinue use immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Blood Thinners: Contains Ginkgo Biloba and Omega-3, which may have a mild blood-thinning effect. Consult your doctor if you are taking anticoagulants (e.g., Warfarin or Aspirin).
  • Iron Content: This product contains iron, which can be harmful to very young children if ingested in large quantities.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor or pharmacist before use. While generally safe, higher doses of certain nutrients should be monitored during pregnancy.

searchable.name: cypmal eyedrop 10ml
searchable.brief_info: Cypmal Eye Drops is a sterile, dual-action ophthalmic solution formulated to treat inflammatory conditions of the eye where a bacterial infection is either present or likely to occur. By combining a potent corticosteroid with a broad-spectrum antibiotic, it provides rapid relief from redness and swelling while simultaneously eliminating harmful bacteria.
searchable.description: Cypmal Eye Drops contain a combination of Betamethasone, a fast-acting corticosteroid, and Neomycin, a powerful aminoglycoside antibiotic. This medication is designed for short-term use to manage the "red eye" symptoms associated with allergies or injury, while the antibiotic component ensures that susceptible bacteria, such as Staphylococcus aureus, are neutralized. This prevents simple irritations from escalating into severe ocular infections.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Cypmal Eye Drops This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM). Take exactly as directed by your physician or pharmacist.

  • Typical Dose: One or two drops instilled into the affected eye(s) every 1 to 2 hours until the condition improves, then reduced to 3 or 4 times daily.

Proper Administration

  • Preparation: Wash your hands thoroughly. Tilt your head back and look upward.
  • Instillation: Gently pull down the lower eyelid to create a pocket. Hold the dropper above the eye without touching the eye, eyelid, or any other surface. Squeeze one drop into the pocket.
  • Aftercare: Close your eye for 1–2 minutes and apply gentle pressure to the tear duct (the corner of the eye near the nose) to keep the medicine in the eye.
  • Contact Lenses: Remove contact lenses before use. Wait at least 15 minutes before reinserting them, as preservatives in the drops can damage soft lenses.

How to Store and Dispose of Cypmal Eye Drops

  • Storage: Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place. Keep the bottle tightly closed and protect it from light.
  • Shelf Life: Discard the bottle 28 days after opening, even if solution remains, to avoid bacterial contamination.
  • Disposal: Return unused or expired drops to your local pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Cypmal Eye Drops

  • Avoid Contamination: Never touch the dropper tip to your eye or any surface.
  • Vision Safety: Do not drive or operate machinery immediately after use, as the drops may cause temporary blurring.
  • Short Term Only: Use for the shortest duration possible (usually less than 7 days) to minimize the risk of increased eye pressure.
  • Separate Medications: If using other eye drops, wait at least 5–10 minutes between applications.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 10ml Dropper Bottle.
  • Form: Sterile Ophthalmic Solution.
  • Active Ingredients: Betamethasone Sodium Phosphate and Neomycin Sulphate.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Cypmal Eye Drops
  • Undiagnosed Red Eye: Do NOT use if the cause of the red eye is unknown; steroids can worsen viral (Herpes) or fungal infections.
  • Viral/Fungal Diseases: Contraindicated in viral diseases of the cornea and conjunctiva (e.g., chickenpox).
  • Glaucoma: Avoid use if you have a history of high intraocular pressure or glaucoma.

Side Effects of Cypmal Eye Drops
  • Common Side Effects: Mild stinging or burning immediately after instillation.
  • Serious but Rare Side Effects: Increased eye pressure, cataract formation, or thinning of the cornea (with prolonged use).
  • Action: If you experience severe eye pain, headache, or sudden changes in vision, stop use and see an eye specialist immediately.

Precautions and Warnings
  • Medical Supervision: Prolonged use requires regular monitoring of intraocular pressure by an optometrist or ophthalmologist.
  • Antibiotic Resistance: Do not use longer than prescribed to prevent the development of resistant bacteria.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor before use; it should only be used if the potential benefit justifies the risk.

searchable.name: Dorbaxin (Methocarbamol) 500mg
searchable.brief_info: Dorbaxin is a skeletal muscle relaxant containing 500mg of Methocarbamol. It is specifically formulated to relieve the discomfort and pain associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions. By acting on the central nervous system, Dorbaxin helps reduce muscle spasms, allowing for improved mobility and a faster return to daily activities when combined with rest and physical therapy.
searchable.description: Dorbaxin (Methocarbamol 500mg) is a trusted choice for managing acute muscle strain and injury. Unlike medications that act directly on the muscle fibers, Dorbaxin works by modulating nerve impulses in the brain and spinal cord to dampen pain signals and reduce localized spasms. It is commonly prescribed to help patients recover from back pain, neck stiffness, and other muscle-related injuries that limit movement.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Dorbaxin This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM). Take as directed by your pharmacist or physician.

  • Adults: The typical starting dose is 1500mg (3 tablets) four times daily for the first 48 to 72 hours.
  • Maintenance: The dose is usually reduced to 1000mg (2 tablets) four times daily once acute symptoms improve.

Proper Administration

  • Method: Swallow the tablets whole with a full glass of water.
  • Food Interaction: May be taken with or without food. If you experience stomach upset, taking it with a meal is recommended.
  • Missed Dose: Take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for the next dose, skip the missed one. Never double the dose to make up for a missed one.

How to Store and Dispose of Dorbaxin

  • Storage: Store at room temperature (20°C to 25°C). Keep the container tightly closed and protect it from moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired medication to your local pharmacy for safe disposal to prevent accidental ingestion or environmental harm.

Quick Tips for Dorbaxin

  • Combine with Rest: Dorbaxin works best when supported by adequate rest and light stretching as advised by a professional.
  • Avoid Alcohol: Alcohol significantly increases the sedative effects of this medicine and should be avoided.
  • Be Careful with Machines: This drug may cause drowsiness or dizziness; do not drive or operate heavy machinery until you know how it affects you.
  • Monitor Progress: Most acute conditions resolve within a few weeks; consult your doctor if pain persists beyond the prescribed course.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Available in various sizes (e.g., 30 or 100 tablets).
  • Form: Oral Tablet.

Active Ingredient: Methocarbamol 500mg.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Dorbaxin

  • Kidney Disease: Should not be used in patients with impaired renal function (especially if injectable forms were previously used).
  • Known Allergy: Do NOT use if you are allergic to Methocarbamol or any inactive ingredients in the tablet.
  • Hypersensitivity: Avoid if you have a history of hypersensitivity to similar muscle relaxants.

Side Effects of Dorbaxin

  • Common: Drowsiness, dizziness, lightheadedness, nausea, or a "metallic" taste in the mouth.
  • Serious but Rare: Blurred vision, fainting, slow heartbeat (bradycardia), or jaundice (yellowing of eyes/skin).
  • Action: If you experience an allergic reaction (rash, itching, swelling) or severe confusion, seek medical attention immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • CNS Depressants: Caution should be used if taking other CNS depressants, such as anti-anxiety meds or opioids.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor; the safety of methocarbamol during pregnancy or lactation has not been fully established.
  • Urine Color: Be aware that Dorbaxin may cause your urine to turn brown, black, or green; this is harmless.

searchable.name: Ginsomin: Korean Panax Ginseng with Multivitamins and Minerals
searchable.brief_info: Ginsomin is a premium daily energy and health supplement that combines the potent revitalizing properties of high-quality Korean Panax Ginseng extract with a comprehensive range of 19 essential vitamins and minerals. It is designed to help the body combat fatigue, manage daily stress, and maintain peak physical and mental performance in a demanding modern lifestyle.
searchable.description: Ginsomin is an advanced formula specifically crafted to address the "tiredness and run-down" feeling associated with physical and mental over-exertion. The core of its effectiveness lies in the standardized Korean Panax Ginseng, an ancient adaptogen renowned for its ability to balance the body's systems. This botanical power is supported by a robust blend of antioxidants, B-vitamins, and minerals that work together to nourish cells and optimize metabolic energy production.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of GinsominTake as directed by the pharmacist or physician.

  • Typical Adult Dose: One capsule daily, preferably with breakfast.

Proper Administration

  • Administration: Swallow the capsule whole with a full glass of water. Do not chew or break the capsule.
  • Best Time: Taking it in the morning is recommended due to its energy-boosting properties; taking it late in the evening may interfere with sleep in sensitive individuals.
  • Food Interaction: Always take with food (preferably a substantial breakfast) to enhance the absorption of fat-soluble vitamins and prevent stomach upset.
  • Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is nearly time for your next dose, skip the missed one.

How to Store and Dispose of Ginsomin

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Protect from direct heat and moisture. Keep the blister pack in its original box.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of any unused medication by returning it to your local pharmacy.

Quick Tips for Ginsomin

  • Cycle Your Use: Many experts recommend taking Ginseng for 2–3 months followed by a 1–2 week "rest" period to maintain its effectiveness.
  • Morning Routine: Pair your daily Ginsomin with a healthy breakfast for sustained energy throughout the day.
  • Avoid Other Multivitamins: Ginsomin is comprehensive; taking other multivitamins alongside it may lead to an excessive intake of certain minerals like Iron or Zinc.
  • Be Patient: While B-vitamins work quickly, the adaptogenic benefits of Ginseng often peak after 2–4 weeks of consistent use.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 30 Capsules (Blister strips).
  • Form: Softgel Capsule.
  • Key Ingredients: Panax Ginseng Extract, 11 Vitamins, and 9 Minerals.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Ginsomin

  • Medical Conditions: Do NOT use if you have high blood pressure (hypertension) that is not well-controlled, heart rhythm disorders, or acute infections.
  • Known Allergies: Do NOT use if you are allergic to ginseng or any of the vitamins/minerals listed in the formula.
  • Hormone-Sensitive Conditions: Consult a doctor before use if you have conditions like endometriosis or uterine fibroids.

Side Effects of Ginsomin

  • Common: Mild insomnia, nervousness, or gastrointestinal upset (if taken on an empty stomach).
  • Serious but Rare: Skin rash, rapid heartbeat (palpitations), or a significant rise in blood pressure.
  • Action: If you experience severe headaches or chest pain, stop use and seek medical attention.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Caffeine: Limit caffeine intake (coffee/tea) while taking Ginsomin, as the combination may lead to increased jitteriness or palpitations.
  • Diabetes: Ginseng may lower blood sugar levels; monitor your glucose levels closely if you are on diabetic medication.
  • Blood Thinners: Consult your doctor if you are taking anticoagulants (like Warfarin or Aspirin), as Ginseng can interfere with blood clotting.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Not recommended for use during pregnancy or lactation unless specifically advised by a doctor.

searchable.name: NAT B Capsules
searchable.brief_info: NAT B is a high-potency Vitamin B-Complex supplement specifically formulated to provide therapeutic levels of all essential B vitamins. It is designed to support the nervous system, boost energy metabolism, and help the body cope with the physical and mental demands of a high-stress lifestyle. By replenishing vital nutrients that are easily depleted by stress and poor diet, NAT B helps restore vitality and mental clarity.
searchable.description: NAT B provides a "mega-dose" of B-complex vitamins, which are water-soluble nutrients that the body cannot store in large amounts. These vitamins act as essential co-factors in hundreds of chemical reactions within the body. NAT B is particularly effective for individuals who experience frequent fatigue, work in high-pressure environments, or suffer from nerve-related discomforts such as tingling or numbness.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of NAT B Take as directed by the pharmacist or physician.

  • Adults: The typical dose is one capsule daily.

Proper Administration

  • Method: Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water.
  • Best Time: Take your capsule in the morning with breakfast. Taking B vitamins at night may cause vivid dreams or interfere with sleep in some individuals due to the energy boost.
  • Food Interaction: Taking it with a meal reduces the risk of stomach upset and improves the absorption of certain B vitamins.
  • Missed Dose: Take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed one.

How to Store and Dispose of NAT B

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep the bottle tightly closed and protect from direct sunlight and moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired capsules to a pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for NAT B

  • Bright Urine: Do not be alarmed if your urine turns a bright, neon-yellow color. This is a harmless side effect of Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) being processed by your body.
  • Consistency: For nerve-related issues, it may take 2–4 weeks of consistent use to notice a significant improvement.
  • Avoid Over-supplementation: Because NAT B is high-potency, you usually do not need to take another multivitamin unless specifically advised.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 30 or 100 Capsules.
  • Form: Softgel Capsule.
  • Category: Therapeutic Vitamin B-Complex.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of NAT B

  • Hypersensitivity: Do NOT use if you are allergic to any of the B-group vitamins.
  • Specific Conditions: Consult your doctor if you have Leber’s disease (a rare eye condition) before taking B12.

Side Effects of NAT B

  • Common: Mild stomach upset, nausea, or a slight "vitamin" aftertaste.
  • Rare: Skin rash, itching, or dizziness.
  • Action: If you experience any signs of an allergic reaction (swelling or difficulty breathing), seek medical attention immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Medication Interaction: Vitamin B6 can interfere with the effectiveness of certain medications like Levodopa (for Parkinson's disease). Consult your doctor if you are on long-term medication.
  • Kidney/Liver Health: If you have severe kidney or liver impairment, consult a healthcare provider for appropriate dosing.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Generally safe, but consult your doctor to ensure the high-potency levels are appropriate for your specific needs.

searchable.name: Cafergot 1mg/100mg
searchable.brief_info: Cafergot is a specialized prescription medication containing a combination of Ergotamine Tartrate and Caffeine. It is specifically designed to abort or prevent vascular headaches, such as migraines and cluster headaches, when they occur. By narrowing widened blood vessels in the brain and enhancing the absorption of the active ingredients, Cafergot helps stop the throbbing pain and associated symptoms of a migraine attack.
searchable.description: Cafergot is an "abortive" therapy, meaning it is intended to be taken at the first sign of a migraine to stop the attack in its tracks. It is not a general pain reliever and should not be used for common tension headaches. The synergy between Ergotamine and Caffeine allows for faster action and higher efficacy in reducing the intensity of severe vascular headaches that do not respond to standard over-the-counter painkillers.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Cafergot This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM). Take exactly as directed by your physician. It works best when taken at the very first sign of an attack (the "aura" or initial pain).

  • Initial Dose: Take 2 tablets at the start of the attack.
  • Follow-up: If the headache persists, take 1 tablet every 30 minutes.
  • Maximum Dose: Do NOT exceed 6 tablets per attack and do NOT exceed 10 tablets in any one week.

Proper Administration

  • Timing: Do not wait until the pain is severe; the earlier you take it, the more effective it is.
  • Method: Swallow the tablets with a glass of water.
  • Rest: After taking the medication, it is highly recommended to lie down in a quiet, dark room to help the medicine work.
  • Missed Dose: This is an "as-needed" medication. If you miss a dose during an attack, take it only if symptoms persist, following the maximum dose guidelines.

How to Store and Dispose of Cafergot

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from light and moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired medication to a pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Cafergot

  • First Sign: Keep your Cafergot tablets accessible so you can take them immediately when you feel a migraine starting.
  • Track Your Doses: Use a headache diary to record how many tablets you take to ensure you stay within the weekly safety limit.
  • Nausea: If your migraines cause severe vomiting, talk to your doctor about the suppository form of this medication.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Usually 10 or 20 tablets per pack.
  • Form: Oral Tablet.
  • Active Ingredients: Ergotamine Tartrate 1mg, Caffeine 100mg.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Cafergot
  • Circulatory Issues: Do NOT use if you have peripheral vascular disease, coronary heart disease, or severe hypertension (high blood pressure).
  • Organ Health: Avoid if you have severe liver or kidney impairment.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED. Ergotamine can cause uterine contractions and harm the fetus. It also passes into breast milk.
  • Infections: Do NOT use if you have sepsis (blood infection).

Side Effects of Cafergot
  • Common: Nausea, vomiting, dizziness, or a "tingling" sensation in the fingers and toes.
  • Serious: Muscle pain in the extremities, weakness in the legs, or chest pain.
  • Ergotism: Excessive use can lead to "ergotism" (intense vasoconstriction), causing coldness or numbness in the limbs.
  • Action: If you feel numbness, tingling, or blue coloration in your fingers or toes, stop use and see a doctor immediately.

Precautions and Warnings
  • Drug Interactions: Do NOT take with certain antibiotics (e.g., Erythromycin), antifungals, or other migraine meds like "triptans" (Sumatriptan), as this can cause dangerously high blood pressure or severe vessel narrowing.
  • Smoking: Avoid smoking while using this medicine, as nicotine increases the risk of dangerous vasoconstriction.
  • Caffeine Sensitivity: Be mindful of other sources of caffeine (coffee, tea, soda) to avoid jitters or rapid heartbeat.

searchable.name: Voltaren Retard
searchable.brief_info: Voltaren Retard is a high-potency, modified-release anti-inflammatory medication containing 100mg of Diclofenac Sodium. It is specifically designed to provide prolonged relief from pain and inflammation over a 24-hour period. By using a "retard" (sustained-release) delivery system, it ensures a steady level of medication in the bloodstream, making it a preferred choice for managing chronic joint pain, stiffness, and inflammatory conditions with just one dose per day.
searchable.description: Voltaren Retard belongs to a group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs). The "Retard" formulation is engineered to release the active ingredient slowly throughout the day. This is particularly beneficial for patients suffering from chronic conditions where consistent pain control is needed to maintain mobility and quality of life. It effectively reduces the production of chemicals in the body that cause pain, fever, and swelling.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Voltaren RetardThis is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM). Take exactly as directed by your physician.

  • Adults: The typical dose is one 100mg tablet daily.
  • Maximum Dose: Do not exceed 150mg per day (usually achieved by adding a standard 50mg tablet if prescribed, rather than a second Retard tablet).

Proper Administration

  • Do Not Crush: The tablet must be swallowed whole with a glass of water. Do not chew, break, or crush it, as this will destroy the sustained-release mechanism and cause the entire dose to be released at once, increasing the risk of side effects.
  • With Food: It is highly recommended to take the tablet with or immediately after a meal to minimize the risk of stomach irritation.
  • Timing: Take it at the same time each day (usually in the evening) to ensure consistent 24-hour pain coverage.

How to Store and Dispose of Voltaren Retard

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C in the original moisture-proof pack.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired medication to a pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Voltaren Retard

  • Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to support kidney function while taking NSAIDs.
  • Shortest Duration: Always use the lowest effective dose for the shortest time possible to manage your symptoms.
  • Alcohol: Limit alcohol consumption, as it can increase the risk of stomach bleeding when taken with Diclofenac.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 10, 30, or 100 tablets per pack.
  • Form: Modified-release (Retard) Oral Tablet.

Active Ingredient: Diclofenac Sodium 100mg.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Voltaren Retard

  • Stomach Ulcers: Do NOT use if you have an active stomach or intestinal ulcer, or a history of gastrointestinal bleeding.
  • Heart Health: Contraindicated in patients with established heart disease (congestive heart failure), peripheral arterial disease, or cerebrovascular disease.
  • Allergies: Do NOT use if you have ever had an allergic reaction (asthma, skin rash, or runny nose) after taking Aspirin or other NSAIDs.
  • Kidney/Liver: Avoid in cases of severe liver or kidney failure.

Side Effects of Voltaren Retard

  • Common: Nausea, heartburn, stomach pain, diarrhea, or dizziness.
  • Serious but Rare: Stomach bleeding (indicated by black/tarry stools), chest pain, shortness of breath, or yellowing of the skin/eyes (jaundice).
  • Action: If you experience severe upper stomach pain or notice blood in your stools, stop taking the medication and seek medical help immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Asthma: Use with caution if you have a history of asthma, as NSAIDs can trigger a flare-up.
  • Blood Pressure: Diclofenac can cause salt and water retention; monitor your blood pressure regularly if you have hypertension.
  • Pregnancy: Avoid use during the last trimester of pregnancy as it can harm the unborn baby or cause complications during delivery.

searchable.name: Safi tonic blood purifier
searchable.brief_info: Safi is a time-tested, herbal Unani medicine renowned for its ability to naturally detoxify the body. By acting as a comprehensive blood purifier, it addresses the root cause of skin problems from within. Formulated with a blend of 28 essential herbal extracts, Safi helps clear the blood of toxins, leading to glowing skin, improved digestion, and better overall health.
searchable.description: Safi is more than just a skin treatment; it is a holistic detoxifier. It works by supporting the body's natural elimination organs—the liver, kidneys, and skin. By ensuring that toxins are effectively filtered and removed from the bloodstream, Safi prevents the "breakouts" and dullness associated with internal impurities. It is particularly famous for its bitter taste, which is a hallmark of its potent, blood-cleansing herbal ingredients.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Safi For Adults and Adolescents:

  • Typical Dose: 10ml (two teaspoonfuls) once daily.
  • Duration: For chronic acne, it is usually taken for at least 21 days to see a visible difference.

Proper Administration

  • With Water: Mix the 10ml dose in a full glass of water (approx. 250ml) and drink.
  • Timing: For best results, take it in the morning on an empty stomach or before bedtime.
  • Consistency: Take it at the same time every day to allow the herbs to work consistently in your system.

How to Store and Dispose of Safi

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep the bottle tightly closed after every use.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of the empty bottle according to local recycling guidelines.

Quick Tips for Safi

  • The "Bitter" Truth: The taste is quite bitter. Mixing it with a little more water or a small amount of honey can make it easier to consume.
  • Hydration: Drink at least 8–10 glasses of water daily while on Safi to help your kidneys flush out the toxins the medicine is releasing.
  • Diet Matters: While taking Safi, avoid excessive oily, spicy, and high-sugar foods, as these contribute to the toxin load in your blood.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 100ml, 200ml, or 500ml Bottle.
  • Form: Liquid Tonic (Syrup).
  • Category: Unani/Herbal Medicine.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Safi

  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Not recommended for use during pregnancy or lactation without medical advice.
  • Diarrhea: Avoid use if you have severe diarrhea or abdominal pain, as the Senna content has a laxative effect.
  • Children: Not usually recommended for very young children unless prescribed by a physician.

Side Effects of Safi

  • Common: Increased frequency of bowel movements (due to its laxative nature) and a temporary "purge" where skin may break out slightly before clearing up.
  • Rare: Stomach cramps or mild nausea.
  • Action: If you experience severe abdominal pain or allergic reactions, discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Diabetes: Some formulations of Safi contain a syrup base with sugar. Diabetic patients should look for the sugar-free version or consult their doctor.
  • Pre-existing Conditions: If you have chronic kidney or liver disease, consult your doctor before starting a detoxification regimen.
  • Weight Loss: Do not use Safi solely as a weight-loss product; it should be part of a balanced lifestyle.

searchable.name: Ruzu Black Syrup for Men
searchable.brief_info: Ruzu Black Syrup for Men is a specially formulated, 100% natural herbal supplement designed to enhance male vitality, stamina, and overall physiological health. Building on the legendary "Ruzu" detoxifying foundation, this "Black" variant is enriched with specific phyto-nutrients that target male-specific wellness needs. It works by combining deep internal cleansing with potent energy-boosting herbs to restore peak performance and reproductive health.
searchable.description: Ruzu Black Syrup is a concentrated herbal bitters blend that addresses the root causes of male health challenges. It functions as a "system restorer," purging the body of oxidative stress and toxins that can impede blood flow and hormonal balance. Unlike chemical stimulants, it provides a holistic approach to wellness, improving everything from digestion and blood sugar levels to libido and physical endurance.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Ruzu Black Shake well before use.

  • Adult Men: Take 2 to 4 tablespoonfuls (approx. 30ml - 60ml) daily.
  • Timing: For best results, take it twice daily—once in the morning (before breakfast) and once at night (before bed).

Proper Administration

  • Method: Drink the syrup directly or mix it with a small amount of warm water if you find the bitter taste too intense.
  • Consistency: Use consistently for at least 2 to 4 weeks to experience the full systemic benefits.
  • Hydration: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to help your body flush out the toxins released by the syrup.

How to Store and Dispose of Ruzu Black

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Ensure the cap is tightly closed to maintain the potency of the herbal extracts.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of the empty bottle according to local recycling guidelines.

Quick Tips for Ruzu Black

  • The "Healing Crisis": During the first few days, you may experience frequent bowel movements. This is a normal part of the detoxification process.
  • Avoid Excessive Sugar: To maximize the effects of Ruzu Black on your stamina and blood sugar, try to reduce your intake of sugary drinks and processed foods.
  • Lifestyle Pairing: Combine use with light exercise to further improve blood circulation and vitality.
searchable.specification:

  • Form: Liquid Herbal Syrup.
  • Category: Herbal Supplement / Alternative Medicine.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Ruzu Black

  • Children: This specific "Black" formulation is strictly for adult men.
  • Severe Illness: Consult your doctor if you have severe kidney or liver disease before starting a detoxification regimen.
  • Allergies: Do NOT use if you have a known hypersensitivity to any of the herbal ingredients.

Side Effects of Ruzu Black

  • Common: Increased frequency of urination and bowel movements (laxative effect).
  • Rare: Mild stomach cramps or slight nausea if taken on an empty stomach.
  • Action: If you experience severe abdominal pain or persistent dizziness, reduce the dosage or consult a healthcare professional.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Not a "Quick Fix": While some notice immediate energy shifts, Ruzu Black is a curative herbal supplement intended for long-term health restoration rather than an instant stimulant.
  • Medication Interaction: If you are on prescribed medications for hypertension or diabetes, monitor your levels closely and consult your doctor to ensure compatibility.
  • Alcohol: Limit alcohol intake while using the syrup, as alcohol can neutralize some of the beneficial herbal properties.

searchable.name: Biopentin 300mg
searchable.brief_info: Biopentin 300mg is a specialized neurological medication containing Gabapentin. It is primarily used to manage various types of nerve pain (neuropathic pain) and as an add-on therapy for certain forms of epilepsy. By stabilizing electrical activity in the brain and modulating pain signals in the nervous system, Biopentin helps improve quality of life for those suffering from chronic discomfort or seizure disorders.
searchable.description: Biopentin belongs to a class of medicines known as anticonvulsants or antiepileptics. Despite its name, Gabapentin does not act directly on GABA receptors; instead, it binds to specific subunits of voltage-gated calcium channels in the central nervous system. This action reduces the release of excitatory neurotransmitters that cause nerves to overfire, effectively "calming" the nerves that send pain signals to the brain.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Biopentin 300mgThis is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM).

Take exactly as directed by your physician. Dosage is usually started low and increased gradually ("titrated") to minimize side effects.

  • Typical Starting Dose: One 300mg tablet once on the first day, twice on the second day, and three times on the third day.
  • Maintenance: Usually 900mg to 1800mg daily, divided into three doses.

Proper Administration

  • Timing: To maintain consistent levels, doses should be spaced evenly. If taken three times a day, the interval between doses should not exceed 12 hours.
  • Method: Swallow the tablet whole with a full glass of water. It can be taken with or without food.
  • Missed Dose: Take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed one. Never double the dose.

How to Store and Dispose of Biopentin 300mg

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep the tablets in their original blister pack to protect from moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return any unused or expired medication to a pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Biopentin 300mg

  • Consistency is Key: Do not stop taking Biopentin suddenly, even if you feel better. Abruptly stopping can trigger "rebound" seizures or intense withdrawal symptoms.
  • Antacid Interaction: If you take antacids containing aluminum or magnesium (like Gaviscon or Maalox), wait at least 2 hours before taking your Biopentin dose.
  • Drowsiness: This medication may cause significant dizziness or sleepiness during the first few weeks. Avoid driving until you know how it affects you.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Usually 30 or 50 tablets per pack.
  • Form: Oral Tablet.
  • Active Ingredient: Gabapentin 300mg.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Biopentin 300mg

  • Known Allergy: Do NOT use if you are allergic to Gabapentin or any other ingredients in the tablet.
  • Pancreatitis: Use with caution if you have a history of acute pancreatitis.

Side Effects of Biopentin 300mg

  • Common: Dizziness, drowsiness, fatigue, and "ataxia" (feeling uncoordinated or shaky).
  • Less Common: Viral infections, fever, nausea, or swelling of the legs (edema).
  • Serious: Mood changes, unusual bruising, or severe skin rashes.
  • Action: If you notice new or worsening depression, suicidal thoughts, or an allergic reaction (swelling of the face/tongue), seek medical help immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Kidney Health: Because Gabapentin is cleared by the kidneys, dose adjustments are mandatory for patients with renal impairment.
  • Alcohol: Avoid alcohol while taking Biopentin, as it can dangerously increase the sedative and dizzying effects.
  • Elderly Patients: Older adults may be more sensitive to the side effects, particularly confusion and loss of balance.

searchable.name: Zedex Cold Capsule
searchable.brief_info: Zedex Cold Capsule is a comprehensive multi-ingredient formula designed to provide fast and effective relief from the symptoms of the common cold, hay fever, and other upper respiratory allergies. By combining a pain reliever, a nasal decongestant, and an antihistamine, Zedex targets the most bothersome aspects of a cold—including nasal congestion, runny nose, and body aches—helping you return to your daily activities with greater comfort.
searchable.description: Zedex Cold is a "combination therapy" medication. Instead of taking multiple separate pills for different symptoms, this capsule provides a coordinated approach to cold relief. It is formulated to dry up nasal secretions, shrink swollen nasal passages, and lower the fever or pain that often accompanies a viral infection.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Zedex Cold For Adults and Children over 12 years:

  • Typical Dose: One capsule every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
  • Maximum Dose: Do NOT exceed 4 capsules in any 24-hour period.
  • Duration: Should not be used for more than 5 consecutive days without consulting a doctor.

Proper Administration

  • Method: Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water.
  • Timing: Can be taken with or without food. However, taking it with food may reduce the chance of stomach upset.
  • Consistency: Take only when symptoms are present. If symptoms persist or worsen, seek medical advice.
  • Avoid "Double-Dosing": Do not take this with any other products containing Paracetamol or decongestants.

How to Store and Dispose of Zedex Cold

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from direct sunlight and moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired capsules to a pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Zedex Cold

  • Check the Label: Many over-the-counter "Night" or "Day" cold medicines contain the same ingredients. Always check labels to ensure you aren't exceeding daily safety limits.
  • Hydration: Drink plenty of fluids (water, broth, or tea) to help thin the mucus in your sinuses while taking this medication.
  • Drowsiness: The antihistamine in this formula may cause drowsiness. Use caution when driving or operating machinery.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 10 capsules per pack.
  • Form: Oral Capsule.
  • Key Ingredients: Paracetamol, Phenylephrine HCl, Chlorpheniramine Maleate.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Zedex Cold

  • High Blood Pressure: Do NOT use if you have severe hypertension or uncontrolled coronary artery disease (due to the decongestant).
  • MAOIs: Do NOT use if you are currently taking or have taken a Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor (antidepressant) in the last 14 days.
  • Allergies: Do NOT use if you are allergic to Paracetamol, Chlorpheniramine, or Phenylephrine.

Side Effects of Zedex Cold

  • Common: Drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness, or mild nervousness/insomnia.
  • Less Common: Blurred vision, nausea, or a rapid heartbeat.
  • Action: If you experience difficulty urinating, a severe skin rash, or a very fast/irregular heartbeat, stop use and see a doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Alcohol: Avoid alcohol while taking Zedex, as it can significantly increase the sedative (drowsy) effect and the risk of liver damage from Paracetamol.
  • Underlying Conditions: Consult a doctor before use if you have glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, diabetes, or thyroid disease.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult your healthcare provider before use; decongestants are generally used with caution during pregnancy.

searchable.name: Uniplex Cough Syrup
searchable.brief_info: Uniplex Cough Syrup is a versatile, multi-action formulation designed to provide rapid relief from symptoms associated with the common cold, hay fever, and upper respiratory tract infections. By combining an antihistamine, a decongestant, and an expectorant, Uniplex addresses both the irritating "tickle" of a cough and the congestion that makes breathing difficult, helping to clear your airways and soothe your throat.
searchable.description: Uniplex is an integrated liquid medication that simplifies the treatment of cold symptoms. It works by thinning and loosening mucus in the chest, shrinking swollen nasal membranes, and stopping the allergic triggers that cause sneezing and a runny nose. The syrup format is particularly effective at coating the throat, providing an immediate soothing sensation to irritated tissues.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Uniplex Always use the provided measuring cup for an accurate dose.

  • Adults and Children over 12 years: 10ml to 20ml every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
  • Children (6–12 years): 5ml to 10ml every 4 to 6 hours.
  • Maximum Dose: Do NOT exceed 4 doses in any 24-hour period.
  • Consult a doctor before giving to children under 6 years.

Proper Administration

  • Timing: Can be taken with or without food.
  • Method: Swallow the syrup directly.
  • Hydration: For the expectorant (Guaifenesin) to work effectively, drink a full glass of water with each dose. Staying well-hydrated helps thin the mucus further.
  • Duration: Do not use for more than 7 days. If the cough persists or is accompanied by a persistent fever, consult a physician.

How to Store and Dispose of Uniplex

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from direct sunlight. Ensure the cap is tightly closed after every use.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired syrup to a pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Uniplex

  • Shake Well: Always shake the bottle before use to ensure the active ingredients are evenly distributed.
  • Nighttime Use: Because of the antihistamine content, some people find this syrup helps them sleep better during a cold, but be aware of potential daytime drowsiness.
  • Identify Your Cough: This is best for "wet" or "chesty" coughs. For a purely dry, hacking cough without mucus, a suppressant-only syrup may be preferred.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 100ml or 200ml Bottle.
  • Form: Oral Syrup.
  • Key Ingredients: Guaifenesin, Phenylephrine HCl, Chlorpheniramine Maleate.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Uniplex

  • MAOIs: Do NOT take if you are currently taking, or have taken in the last 14 days, a Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor (antidepressant).
  • High Blood Pressure: Use with caution if you have severe hypertension or heart disease due to the decongestant.
  • Narrow-Angle Glaucoma: Antihistamines can increase pressure within the eye.

Side Effects of Uniplex

  • Common: Drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, or mild stomach upset.
  • Less Common: Restlessness (especially in children) or a slight increase in heart rate.
  • Action: If you experience difficulty urinating, confusion, or a severe skin rash, stop use and contact a doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Drowsiness: This medication can cause significant sleepiness. Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you know how it affects you.
  • Alcohol: Avoid alcohol, as it can dangerously increase the sedative effects of the antihistamine.
  • Underlying Conditions: Consult a doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid disease, or an enlarged prostate before use.

searchable.name: Rulox Tablet
searchable.brief_info: Rulox Tablet is a trusted antacid formulation designed to provide rapid relief from the discomfort of excess stomach acid. Containing a balanced combination of Magnesium Trisilicate and Aluminium Hydroxide, it works by neutralizing acid on contact. These chewable tablets are a convenient solution for managing the burning sensation of heartburn and the "heavy" feeling of indigestion, especially after spicy or heavy meals.
searchable.description: Rulox is a non-systemic antacid, meaning it works locally in the stomach to neutralize acid without being absorbed into the bloodstream. The combination of magnesium and aluminium salts is intentional: aluminium can sometimes cause constipation, while magnesium can have a mild laxative effect. By combining them, Rulox provides effective relief while maintaining normal bowel regularity.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Rulox TabletsFor Adults and Children over 12 years:

  • Typical Dose: 1 to 2 tablets to be chewed as needed.
  • Frequency: Can be taken up to 4 times a day, usually after meals and at bedtime.
  • Maximum Dose: Do not exceed the recommended daily limit stated on the pack.

Proper Administration

  • Chew Thoroughly: Do not swallow these tablets whole. For the antacid to work effectively, the tablets must be chewed thoroughly before swallowing. This increases the surface area for the medicine to neutralize stomach acid.
  • Timing: For best results, take Rulox 1 hour after meals and before going to bed, as this is when acid production is typically highest.
  • Follow with Water: You may drink a small sip of water after chewing to help wash the medicine down.

How to Store and Dispose of Rulox Tablets

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from moisture and light. Keep the tablets in their original blister pack.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired tablets to your pharmacist.

Quick Tips for Rulox Tablets

  • Lifestyle Check: If you find yourself needing Rulox every day for more than two weeks, consult your doctor to rule out more serious conditions like GERD.
  • Trigger Foods: Identify and avoid foods that trigger your acid (e.g., caffeine, chocolate, fatty foods, or citrus).
  • Late Night Eating: Try to finish your last meal at least 3 hours before lying down to prevent nighttime heartburn.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 16 Tablets (2 x 8 blister strips).
  • Manufacturer: SKG Pharma.
  • Form: Chewable Tablet.
  • Key Ingredients: Aluminium Hydroxide, Magnesium Trisilicate.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Rulox Tablets

  • Kidney Disease: Use with extreme caution if you have kidney impairment, as magnesium and aluminium can accumulate in the body.
  • Phosphate Levels: Do not use if you have low phosphate levels (hypophosphatemia), as aluminium can further lower these levels.
  • Allergies: Do not use if you are allergic to any of the ingredients.

Side Effects of Rulox Tablets

  • Common: Chalky taste in the mouth or mild change in bowel movements.
  • Rare: Stomach cramps or nausea.
  • Action: If you experience persistent constipation or diarrhea, stop use and consult a pharmacist.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Drug Interactions: Antacids can stop your body from absorbing other medicines. Wait at least 2 hours between taking Rulox and other medications (especially antibiotics like Ciprofloxacin or Tetracycline, and heart medicines).
  • Sodium Content: If you are on a salt-restricted diet, check the label or ask your pharmacist about the sodium content.
  • Pregnancy: Generally considered safe for occasional use, but always consult your doctor first.

searchable.name: Tothema
searchable.brief_info: Tothema is a highly effective hematinic (blood-building) oral solution containing a synergistic blend of Iron, Manganese, and Copper. Presented in convenient drinkable glass ampoules, it is designed to rapidly replenish iron stores and treat iron-deficiency anemia. Its liquid formulation ensures superior absorption compared to traditional iron tablets, making it an ideal choice for pregnant women, recovering patients, and those with chronic iron deficiency.
searchable.description: Tothema is an oral iron therapy that focuses on high bioavailability. Unlike many iron supplements that can be hard on the digestive system, Tothema combines iron with essential mineral co-factors (Copper and Manganese) that assist in the transport and incorporation of iron into hemoglobin. The liquid form allows the active ingredients to be absorbed more readily in the upper gastrointestinal tract.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Tothema Dosage is usually based on the severity of the deficiency.

  • For Treatment (Adults): 2 to 4 ampoules (100–200mg of iron) daily, in divided doses.
  • For Prevention (Pregnant Women): 1 ampoule (50mg of iron) daily during the last two trimesters.
  • For Children: Dosage is based on weight (usually 3–6mg of iron per kg per day).

Proper Administration

  • Preparation: Shake the ampoule well. Break both tips of the ampoule (using a paper tissue) and pour the contents into a glass.
  • Dilution: Dilute the liquid in a glass of water or a non-alcoholic beverage (like fruit juice).
  • Timing: For maximum absorption, take Tothema on an empty stomach (usually 1 hour before meals). If stomach irritation occurs, it can be taken with or after food.
  • Avoid Tea/Coffee: Do not take Tothema within 2 hours of drinking tea, coffee, or eating dairy, as these significantly block iron absorption.

How to Store and Dispose of Tothema

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep the ampoules in the original carton to protect them from light.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of empty glass ampoules carefully in a sharps container or wrapped safely to prevent injury.

Quick Tips for Tothema

  • Vitamin C Boost: Drink your Tothema with a glass of orange juice. Vitamin C significantly enhances the absorption of iron.
  • Stool Color: Do not be alarmed if your stools turn black or dark green. This is a normal and harmless side effect of iron supplements.
  • Teeth Protection: To avoid temporary staining of the teeth, dilute the solution well and sip it through a straw, then rinse your mouth with water afterward.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 20 Ampoules of 10ml each.
  • Form: Oral Solution (Drinkable Ampoule).
  • Key Ingredients: Iron, Copper, Manganese Gluconates.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Tothema

  • Iron Overload: Do NOT use if you have conditions like hemochromatosis or hemosiderosis.
  • Non-Iron Anemias: Not for use in anemias not caused by iron deficiency (e.g., hemolytic anemia).
  • Active Ulcers: Use with caution if you have active peptic ulcers or inflammatory bowel disease.

Side Effects of Tothema

  • Common: Nausea, heartburn, constipation, or diarrhea.
  • Less Common: Temporary staining of tooth enamel (if not diluted).
  • Action: If you experience severe abdominal pain or persistent vomiting, consult your doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Diabetes: Each ampoule contains 3g of sucrose. Diabetic patients should account for this in their daily sugar management.
  • Regular Monitoring: Your doctor should perform periodic blood tests (PCV/Hemoglobin/Ferritin) to ensure the iron levels are returning to normal.
  • Drug Interactions: Iron can reduce the absorption of antibiotics (Tetracyclines/Quinolones). Take them at least 2 hours apart.

searchable.name: Ketesse 25mg
searchable.brief_info: Ketesse 25mg is a fast-acting pain reliever containing Dexketoprofen. It belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs). By focusing on the active "isomer" of ketoprofen, Ketesse provides powerful analgesic effects at a lower dose, making it highly effective for the management of mild to moderate acute pain with a rapid onset of action.
searchable.description: Ketesse is designed for the short-term symptomatic treatment of acute pain. Its unique formulation allows for quicker absorption into the bloodstream compared to many other oral NSAIDs. It works by blocking the production of chemicals in the body that signal pain and cause inflammation, providing a "calming" effect on irritated nerves and tissues.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Ketesse 25mg This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM). Always follow the dosage prescribed by your doctor.

  • Adults: Usually 1 tablet (25mg) every 8 hours.
  • Maximum Daily Dose: Do NOT exceed 75mg (3 tablets) in a 24-hour period.
  • Elderly/Renal Patients: A lower starting dose (totaling no more than 50mg daily) is often recommended.

Proper Administration

  • For Fast Relief: Take the tablet at least 30 minutes before meals on an empty stomach to ensure the fastest absorption.
  • For General Use: If you have a sensitive stomach, you may take it with food to reduce the risk of irritation, though this may slightly delay the pain-relieving effect.
  • Method: Swallow the tablet whole with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew.
  • Duration: This medication is intended for short-term use only (usually not more than 3 to 5 days).

How to Store and Dispose of Ketesse 25mg

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from light and moisture. Keep tablets in their original blister packaging.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused or expired tablets to a pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Ketesse 25mg

  • The "Short-Term" Rule: Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest time necessary to control your symptoms.
  • Hydration: Ensure you drink plenty of water throughout the day to support kidney function while taking any NSAID.
  • Avoid Alcohol: Alcohol can increase the risk of stomach bleeding when combined with Dexketoprofen.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Usually 10, 20, or 30 tablets.
  • Form: Film-coated Oral Tablet.
  • Active Ingredient: Dexketoprofen 25mg.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Ketesse 25mg

  • Stomach Issues: Do NOT use if you have an active peptic ulcer, a history of stomach bleeding, or chronic digestive problems (Crohn’s or Ulcerative Colitis).
  • Asthma: Do NOT use if you have "Aspirin Asthma" (allergic reactions like wheezing or skin rash after taking Aspirin or other NSAIDs).
  • Heart/Kidney/Liver: Contraindicated in cases of severe heart failure, moderate-to-severe kidney disease, or severe liver impairment.
  • Pregnancy: Do NOT use during the third trimester of pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

Side Effects of Ketesse 25mg

  • Common: Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, or dizziness.
  • Less Common: Heartburn, flatulence, headache, or sleepiness.
  • Serious: Black, tarry stools, vomiting blood, or severe allergic reactions (swelling of the face/throat).
  • Action: If you notice signs of stomach bleeding or a severe skin rash, stop taking the medication and seek emergency medical care immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Blood Thinners: Use with extreme caution if you are taking anticoagulants (like Warfarin), as the risk of bleeding increases.
  • Elderly Patients: Older adults are more prone to side effects; close monitoring by a doctor is advised.
  • Interactions: Inform your pharmacist if you are taking diuretics, ACE inhibitors, or lithium.

searchable.name: Hidrasec 100mg
searchable.brief_info: Hidrasec 100mg is a specialized anti-diarrheal medication containing Racecadotril. Manufactured by Abbott, it is designed for the symptomatic treatment of acute diarrhea in adults. Unlike traditional anti-motility drugs that "stop" the gut by paralyzing muscle movement, Hidrasec works by reducing the excess secretion of water and electrolytes into the intestines. This allows for a more natural recovery while rapidly decreasing fluid loss.
searchable.description: Hidrasec is a "pure intestinal anti-secretory" agent. During a bout of diarrhea, the intestines often produce too much fluid, leading to watery stools and dehydration. Hidrasec targets the specific enzymes responsible for this over-secretion. Because it does not slow down the natural transit time of the gut, it allows the body to continue flushing out harmful bacteria or toxins while preventing dangerous dehydration.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Hidrasec 100mg This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM).

  • Adults: One 100mg capsule taken three times daily.
  • Initial Dose: One 100mg capsule immediately, regardless of the time of day, followed by three doses per day thereafter.
  • Duration: Treatment should be continued until two normal stools are recorded. Treatment should not exceed 7 consecutive days.

Proper Administration

  • Method: Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water.
  • Timing: Preferably taken before the main meals.
  • Rehydration: Crucial: Always use Hidrasec in conjunction with Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS). While Hidrasec stops the fluid loss, ORS replaces what has already been lost.

How to Store and Dispose of Hidrasec 100mg

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused capsules to a pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Hidrasec 100mg

  • Diet: While recovering, stick to a "BRAT" diet (Bananas, Rice, Applesauce, Toast) and avoid spicy, fatty, or dairy-heavy foods until the diarrhea stops.
  • The "Safety" Advantage: Since it doesn't cause constipation (a common side effect of other anti-diarrheals), it is often better tolerated for routine acute cases.
  • Watch for Warning Signs: If your diarrhea is accompanied by high fever or blood/pus in the stool, consult a doctor immediately, as this may indicate a bacterial infection requiring antibiotics.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 20 Capsules.
  • Manufacturer: Abbott.
  • Form: Oral Capsule.
  • Active Ingredient: Racecadotril 100mg.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Hidrasec 100mg

  • Renal/Hepatic Impairment: Due to limited data, use is not recommended in patients with severe kidney or liver disease.
  • Chronic Diarrhea: Not intended for use in chronic or antibiotic-associated diarrhea.
  • Allergy: Do NOT use if you are allergic to Racecadotril or any of the inactive ingredients.

Side Effects of Hidrasec 100mg

  • Common: Headache.
  • Rare: Skin rash, redness (erythema), or itching.
  • Action: If you experience swelling of the face, tongue, or lips (angioedema), stop use and seek immediate medical help.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Lactose Sensitivity: This product contains lactose. If you have a severe intolerance to certain sugars, consult your doctor before use.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Due to a lack of clinical studies, Hidrasec is not recommended for use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
  • Blood in Stool: If your stool is bloody or black, do not use Hidrasec without a medical diagnosis.

searchable.name: NeoCell Grass-Fed
searchable.brief_info: NeoCell Super Collagen Type 1 & 3 is a high-potency nutritional supplement designed to replenish your body’s natural collagen stores. Formulated with 6,000mg (6g) of hydrolyzed bovine collagen per serving, these tablets support the structural integrity of your skin, hair, and nails while promoting joint comfort. Sourced from 100% grass-fed, pasture-raised cattle, NeoCell provides the essential amino acids needed to maintain a youthful appearance and active lifestyle.
searchable.description: Collagen is the most abundant protein in the human body, acting as the "glue" that holds everything together. As we age, collagen production naturally declines, leading to wrinkles, brittle nails, and thinning hair. NeoCell Super Collagen uses an advanced enzymatic hydrolyzation process to break down large collagen molecules into small peptides that are highly bioavailable and easily absorbed by the body to stimulate new collagen synthesis.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of NeoCell Collagen

  • Standard Serving: Take 6 tablets daily.
  • Total Count: This 360-tablet bottle provides a full 60-day supply.

Proper Administration

  • Empty Stomach: For maximum absorption, take the tablets at least 30 minutes before a meal.
  • Hydration: Swallow with a full glass of water or fruit juice (Vitamin C in juice further aids absorption).
  • Consistency: Collagen is a structural protein; it takes time to build up in the system. Consistent daily use for at least 3 to 6 months is recommended to see visible results in skin and hair.

How to Store and Dispose of NeoCell Collagen
