  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep the lid tightly closed after each use to prevent moisture from affecting the tablets.
  • Disposal: Recycle the plastic bottle according to local guidelines. Keep out of reach of children.

Quick Tips for NeoCell Collagen

  • The Vitamin C Connection: While NeoCell includes Vitamin C, eating a diet rich in citrus fruits, berries, and leafy greens will further support your body's ability to utilize the collagen.
  • Do Not Combine: For best results, do not take collagen at the same time as other protein supplements (like whey shakes), as the different amino acid profiles can compete for absorption.
  • Nighttime Routine: Many users prefer taking their dose before bed, as the body’s repair and regeneration processes are most active during sleep.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 360 Tablets.
  • Source: 100% Grass-Fed Bovine.
  • Certifications: Gluten-Free, Non-GMO, IGEN Third-Party Tested.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of NeoCell Collagen

  • Allergies: This product is derived from bovine (cow) sources. Do not use if you have a known allergy to beef or bovine gelatin.
  • Vegan/Vegetarian: This is an animal-based product and is not suitable for vegans or vegetarians.

Side Effects of NeoCell Collagen

  • Common: Mild digestive heaviness or a lingering "protein" aftertaste.
  • Rare: Mild bloating or changes in bowel habits.
  • Action: If you experience any allergic reactions like itching or swelling, discontinue use and consult a healthcare provider.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: As with any supplement, consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant or nursing.
  • Kidney Health: Individuals with existing kidney disease should consult a physician before significantly increasing their daily protein/collagen intake.
  • Not a Meal Replacement: Collagen is a specialized protein for connective tissue; it is not a complete protein and should not be used as a substitute for dietary protein.

searchable.name: Oxy 10 Maximum Strength
searchable.brief_info: Oxy 10 is a high-potency topical medication containing 10% Benzoyl Peroxide. It is specifically formulated to treat the most persistent and stubborn acne that has not responded to milder treatments. By delivering a concentrated dose of oxygen deep into the pores, Oxy 10 kills acne-causing bacteria on contact, dries up excess oil, and helps clear even the most difficult pimples and blackheads.
searchable.description: Oxy 10 is a "Vanishing Gel" that disappears as it is rubbed into the skin. Its active formula works in three ways: it kills 99% of acne bacteria (P. acnes), it acts as a keratolytic to peel away dead skin cells that clog pores, and it absorbs excess sebum (oil). Because this is a Maximum Strength formula, it is intended for use on tougher skin areas like the back or for moderate-to-severe facial acne.
searchable.how_to_use:
Proper Administration

  1. Cleanse: Wash the affected area with a mild cleanser and pat dry gently.
  2. Test: If you are using this for the first time, apply a tiny amount to a small restricted area for three days to test for sensitivity.
  3. Apply: If no reaction occurs, apply a thin layer of Oxy 10 to the affected areas.
  4. Frequency: Start with one application daily. If no bothersome dryness or peeling occurs, you may gradually increase to two or three times daily if needed or as directed by a doctor.
  5. Moisturize: Because 10% is very strong, it is highly recommended to follow up with a non-comedogenic (oil-free) moisturizer to prevent excessive peeling.

How to Store and Dispose of Oxy 10

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep the tube tightly closed.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of the tube according to local household waste regulations.

Quick Tips for Oxy 10

  • Watch Your Fabrics: Warning: Benzoyl Peroxide is a bleaching agent. It will bleach hair and dyed fabrics (towels, pillowcases, and clothing). Use white towels and bedsheets while using this product.
  • Sun Protection: This medication can make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Always wear a broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day.
  • Less is More: You do not need a thick layer. A thin, even film is sufficient for the active ingredient to penetrate the pores.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 10g or 25g Tube.
  • Form: Vanishing Cream/Gel.
  • Active Ingredient: Benzoyl Peroxide 10%.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Oxy 10

  • Sensitive Skin: Avoid use if you have very sensitive skin or are prone to eczema.
  • Allergy: Do NOT use if you have a known allergy to Benzoyl Peroxide.

Side Effects of Oxy 10

  • Common: Mild stinging, redness, and peeling of the skin are expected during the first few days.
  • Less Common: Severe burning, blistering, or swelling.
  • Action: If excessive redness or painful irritation occurs, reduce the frequency of use. If a severe allergic reaction (swelling of the face/hives) occurs, stop use immediately and see a doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • External Use Only: Keep away from eyes, lips, and the sensitive lining of the nose. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water.
  • Combination Therapy: Avoid using other harsh skin treatments (like Retinoids or high-strength Salicylic Acid) at the same time unless advised by a dermatologist, as this will cause extreme irritation.
  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor before use; while topical absorption is low, it is best to seek medical guidance.

searchable.name: Lofnac Gel
searchable.brief_info: Lofnac Gel is a powerful topical anti-inflammatory and analgesic preparation containing Diclofenac Diethylamine. Designed for direct application to the skin, it provides localized relief from pain, inflammation, and swelling. By penetrating deep into the affected tissues, Lofnac Gel delivers the active medicine exactly where it is needed, minimizing systemic side effects and providing a cooling, soothing sensation upon application.
searchable.description: Lofnac Gel belongs to the class of Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs). Unlike oral tablets that must travel through the digestive system, this gel is absorbed through the skin (transdermally) to reach the underlying muscles, tendons, and joints. The diethylamine salt of diclofenac is specifically chosen for its superior ability to penetrate the skin barrier, ensuring rapid relief from musculoskeletal discomfort.
searchable.how_to_use:
Proper Administration

  • Clean the Area: Wash and dry the affected area before application.
  • Amount: Depending on the size of the painful area, apply a small amount (about the size of a cherry or walnut) to the skin.
  • Application: Gently rub the gel into the skin until it is fully absorbed.
  • Frequency: Usually applied 3 to 4 times daily.
  • Hand Hygiene: Wash your hands thoroughly after application, unless your hands are the area being treated.

Duration of Treatment

  • Short-Term Use: For muscle and soft tissue injuries, do not use for more than 7–14 days unless directed by a doctor.
  • Arthritis Pain: For osteoarthritis pain, it may be used for up to 21 days. If symptoms do not improve or if they worsen, consult a healthcare professional.

How to Store and Dispose of Lofnac Gel

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Do not freeze. Keep the tube tightly capped when not in use.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of the empty tube according to local household waste guidelines.

Quick Tips for Lofnac Gel

  • Do Not Cover: Avoid covering the treated area with airtight (occlusive) dressings or bandages, as this can increase absorption to unsafe levels.
  • Avoid Broken Skin: Never apply the gel to open wounds, cuts, rashes, or infected skin.
  • Avoid Heat: Do not use heating pads or lamps on the area where the gel has been applied.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 20g, 30g, or 50g Tube.
  • Form: Topical Gel.
  • Active Ingredient: Diclofenac Diethylamine.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Lofnac Gel

  • Allergy: Do NOT use if you are allergic to Diclofenac, Aspirin, or other NSAIDs (e.g., Ibuprofen).
  • Aspirin Asthma: Do NOT use if you have ever experienced an asthma attack or hives after taking oral pain relievers.
  • Pregnancy: Avoid use during the last trimester (3 months) of pregnancy, as it can affect the baby.

Side Effects of Lofnac Gel

  • Common: Mild skin irritation, redness, or itching at the site of application.
  • Less Common: Increased sensitivity to sunlight (photosensitivity).
  • Serious: Widespread skin rash or difficulty breathing (very rare with topical use).
  • Action: If you develop a severe skin rash or blistering, stop use immediately and wash the area.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Sun Exposure: Avoid exposing the treated area to direct sunlight or tanning beds, as the gel may increase your risk of sunburn.
  • Eyes and Mouth: Avoid contact with eyes or mucous membranes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water.
  • Oral NSAIDs: Consult your doctor if you are already taking oral NSAID tablets (like Diclofenac or Ibuprofen) to avoid "stacking" the dose.

searchable.name: Polygel Antacid Dual 200ml
searchable.brief_info: Polygel Antacid Dual is an advanced oral suspension designed for superior management of gastroesophageal reflux (GERD) and severe indigestion. Unlike standard antacids, the "Dual" formula provides both a chemical neutralizer and a physical barrier. By combining Sodium Alginate with high-quality antacids, it creates a protective "raft" that prevents stomach acid from rising into the esophagus, providing rapid and long-lasting comfort.
searchable.description: Polygel Dual is specifically formulated for patients whose main symptom is acid reflux (heartburn). While the antacid components neutralize existing acid, the Sodium Alginate reacts with stomach acid to form a thick, buoyant gel layer (the raft). This raft sits on top of the stomach contents, physically blocking acid from splashing back up into the throat, which is especially helpful after heavy meals or when lying down.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Polygel Dual

  • Adults and Children 12 years and over: 10ml to 20ml (two to four 5ml spoonfuls).
  • Frequency: Taken after meals and at bedtime (up to four times a day).
  • Children under 12 years: Should only be taken on medical advice.

Proper Administration

  • Shake Well: Vigorously shake the bottle before use to ensure the alginate is properly distributed.
  • Timing is Key: For the best results, take Polygel Dual after you have finished your meal. This allows the "raft" to sit on top of the food you just ate.
  • Undiluted: Do not mix with water or juice, as this can weaken the strength of the protective raft.

How to Store and Dispose of Polygel Dual

  • Storage: Store below 30°C. Do not refrigerate or freeze (cold temperatures can change the consistency of the gel).
  • Shelf Life: Check the expiry date on the bottle. Use within 6 months of opening.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children.

Quick Tips for Polygel Dual

  • Nighttime Reflux: If you suffer from "silent reflux" or coughing at night, take your final dose right before getting into bed.
  • Gravity Helps: Even with Polygel Dual, try to wait 2–3 hours after eating before lying completely flat.
  • The "Raft" Duration: The protective layer can last for several hours, providing longer relief than tablets alone.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 200ml Bottle.
  • Form: Oral Suspension.
  • Key Ingredients: Sodium Alginate, Sodium Bicarbonate, Calcium Carbonate.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Polygel Dual

  • Severe Renal Impairment: Due to the calcium and sodium content, use with caution if you have kidney disease.
  • Sodium-Restricted Diets: This product contains significant sodium; consult your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet (e.g., for hypertension or heart failure).
  • Hypercalcemia: Avoid if you have high calcium levels in the blood.

Side Effects of Polygel Dual

  • Common: Very rarely, mild bloating or flatulence as the "raft" forms.
  • Less Common: Constipation (due to calcium carbonate).
  • Action: If you experience an unusual skin rash or difficulty breathing, you may be allergic to one of the ingredients; stop use immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Drug Interactions: The "raft" can trap other medicines or prevent them from being absorbed. Wait at least 2 hours between taking Polygel Dual and other medications (especially antibiotics like Ciprofloxacin or heart medicines like Digoxin).
  • Persistent Symptoms: If symptoms do not improve after 7 days, see a doctor to ensure there is no underlying damage to the esophagus.

searchable.name: Black Seed Oil 60ml
searchable.brief_info: Black Seed Oil (also known as Nigella Sativa or Kalonji oil) is a potent, nutrient-dense botanical extract celebrated for its diverse healing properties. This compact 60ml bottle is perfect for those seeking a high-quality, cold-pressed oil for targeted therapeutic use or for those trying this "miracle herb" for the first time. Known as the "seed of blessing," it contains high levels of antioxidants that support the immune system, improve respiratory function, and promote radiant skin and hair.
searchable.description: Extracted from the seeds of the Nigella Sativa plant, this 100% pure oil is cold-pressed to ensure that the vital bioactive compounds—especially Thymoquinone—remain intact. The 60ml size is ideal for travel or for use as a concentrated topical treatment for skin and scalp issues. It features a characteristically sharp, peppery aroma and taste, which is a hallmark of its purity and strength.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage and Administration

  • Internal (Adults): Take ½ to 1 teaspoon (approx. 2.5ml to 5ml) once daily. It is often mixed with honey or juice to balance its strong flavor.
  • Internal (Children): Consult a healthcare provider; typically a few drops up to ¼ teaspoon for children over age 5.
  • Topical: Apply a few drops directly to the skin or scalp and massage gently.

Proper Administration

  • The "Carrier" Method: If you have sensitive skin, dilute the Black Seed Oil with a carrier oil like Jojoba or Sweet Almond oil.
  • Best Time to Take: Many users prefer taking it in the morning on an empty stomach for maximum absorption.
  • Avoid Cooking: High temperatures destroy the medicinal Thymoquinone. Always use the oil cold.

How to Store and Dispose of Black Seed Oil

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep the bottle tightly capped and away from sunlight. Refrigeration is recommended after opening to prevent the oil from becoming rancid.
  • Disposal: Dispose of the bottle in a recycling bin once finished.

Quick Tips for Black Seed Oil

  • Glowing Skin: Mix a drop into your daily moisturizer to boost its antioxidant power.
  • Soothe a Cough: Mix 1 teaspoon of oil with 1 tablespoon of honey for a natural cough suppressant.
  • Be Consistent: Like most natural supplements, the benefits of Black Seed Oil are cumulative and best seen after 2–4 weeks of daily use.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 60ml Bottle.
  • Form: Pure Cold-Pressed Oil.
  • Ingredient: 100% Nigella Sativa Oil.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Black Seed Oil

  • Pregnancy: Avoid internal use in large doses as it may influence uterine contractions.
  • Surgery: Discontinue use at least 2 weeks before any surgery as it may slightly slow blood clotting.
  • Blood Pressure: Use with caution if you already have very low blood pressure.

Side Effects of Black Seed Oil

  • Common: Mild digestive upset or "peppery" burps.
  • Topical: Allergic contact dermatitis may occur in some individuals. Perform a patch test on your inner wrist before widespread use.
  • Action: If you experience swelling of the tongue or throat, or difficulty breathing, seek medical help immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Diabetes: Black Seed Oil can lower blood sugar levels. Monitor your glucose closely if you are on diabetic medication.
  • Blood Thinners: Consult your doctor if you are taking anticoagulants like Warfarin or Aspirin.

searchable.name: Embassy 2-Way Inhaler (Pack of 6)
searchable.brief_info: The Embassy 2-Way Inhaler is a versatile, pocket-sized medicinal device designed to provide rapid relief from nasal congestion and upper respiratory discomfort. Known for its "2-way" action, it can be used for direct nasal inhalation or applied topically to soothe the chest and throat. This pack of 6 ensures you have consistent relief available at home, in the office, in your car, or while traveling, making it a staple for managing cold and allergy seasons.
searchable.description: The Embassy Inhaler utilizes a concentrated blend of aromatic essential oils that act as natural decongestants. When inhaled, the vapors quickly shrink swollen membranes in the nasal passages, allowing for easier breathing. Its compact, "lipstick-style" design makes it discreet and easy to use anywhere, providing a cooling sensation that cuts through the "stuffiness" of a cold or hay fever.
searchable.how_to_use:
Administration Techniques

  • Method 1 (Nasal Inhalation):
    1. Remove the cap.
    2. Place the inhaler tip near one nostril while closing the other with your finger.
    3. Inhale deeply.
    4. Repeat for the other nostril.
  • Method 2 (Topical/Vapor): Many "2-way" designs allow you to unscrew the bottom base to access a small reservoir of medicated oil. This can be dabbed onto a handkerchief or lightly applied to the chest or temples (avoiding the eyes).

Proper Usage Frequency

  • Adults and Children over 12: Use as often as needed, typically every 2 to 3 hours.
  • Children 6 to 12 years: Should use under adult supervision.
  • Under 6 years: Not recommended unless advised by a healthcare professional.

How to Store and Dispose of Embassy Inhalers

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Always replace the cap tightly after use to prevent the aromatic oils from evaporating.
  • Disposal: Dispose of the plastic casing in accordance with local recycling guidelines once the scent has faded.

Quick Tips for Best Results

  • Keep it Personal: To prevent the spread of infection, do not share your inhaler with others.
  • The Handkerchief Trick: If your nose is too sore to place the inhaler near it, apply a few drops from the oil reservoir to a tissue and breathe in the vapors.
  • Deep Breaths: For maximum effect, hold the vapor in your lungs for a few seconds before exhaling.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 6 individual inhalers.
  • Form: Portable Nasal Inhaler with Oil Reservoir.
  • Key Ingredients: Menthol, Camphor, Eucalyptus.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Sensitivity: Do not use if you are allergic to menthol, camphor, or eucalyptus oil.
  • Damaged Skin: Do not apply the oil reservoir directly to broken or severely irritated skin.
  • Medical Conditions: Consult a doctor if you have chronic respiratory conditions like asthma before using strong aromatic inhalers.

Side Effects of Embassy Inhaler

  • Common: Temporary stinging in the nose or watery eyes if inhaled too sharply.
  • Less Common: Skin irritation at the site of topical application.
  • Action: If you experience a persistent rash, skin burning, or increased difficulty breathing, stop use immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • External Use Only: The oil reservoir is for inhalation or topical application; never swallow the liquid.
  • Eye Contact: Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with cool water.
  • Pregnancy: Generally safe for external use, but consult your midwife or doctor if you are sensitive to strong smells during pregnancy.

searchable.name: Spex Inhaler
searchable.brief_info: The Spex Inhaler is a compact, portable nasal decongestant designed to provide immediate relief from "stuffy" noses and upper respiratory discomfort. Utilizing a potent blend of essential aromatic oils, it offers a refreshing, cooling sensation that helps clear the nasal passages during colds, hay fever, or sinusitis. Its lightweight, pocket-sized design makes it an ideal companion for quick relief at home, work, or while traveling.
searchable.description: The Spex Inhaler works through the power of inhalation aromatherapy. When you breathe in through the device, the medicated vapors travel through the nasal cavity, providing an instant feeling of openness. It is a non-drowsy, non-medicated alternative to oral decongestants, focusing on clearing the airway through the soothing properties of menthol and camphor.
searchable.how_to_use:
Proper Administration

  1. Open: Unscrew the outer protective cover.
  2. Position: Place the inhaler tip close to one nostril.
  3. Occlude: Close the other nostril by pressing it with your finger.
  4. Inhale: Breathe in deeply and slowly through the nostril with the inhaler.
  5. Repeat: Switch nostrils and repeat the process.
  6. Close: Secure the cap tightly immediately after use to prevent the oils from evaporating.

Usage Frequency

  • Adults and Children over 6 years: Use as often as needed, but typically 1–2 inhalations per nostril every 2 hours is sufficient.
  • Children under 6: Consult a healthcare professional before use.

How to Store and Dispose of Spex Inhaler

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Ensure the cap is always tight. Exposure to high heat can cause the aromatic oils to lose their potency.
  • Disposal: Once the scent has faded completely, the inhaler can be disposed of in regular household waste (check local plastic recycling rules).

Quick Tips for Spex Inhaler

  • Don't Share: Nasal inhalers should be used by one person only to avoid the spread of germs.
  • Breathe Slowly: Sharp, aggressive sniffing can cause the vapors to sting; a slow, deep breath is more effective and comfortable.
  • Check the Cap: If the inhaler feels "weak," ensure the cap wasn't left loose, as the active vapors are highly volatile.
searchable.specification:
• Product Type: Nasal Stick Inhaler.
  • Aroma: Strong Menthol/Camphor.
  • Form: Portable Plastic Inhaler.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Hypersensitivity: Do not use if you are allergic to menthol, camphor, or essential oils.
  • Asthma: If you have a history of severe asthma, use cautiously, as strong aromatic vapors can occasionally trigger a cough reflex.

Side Effects of Spex Inhaler

  • Common: A temporary stinging or "burning" sensation in the nose if inhaled too deeply.
  • Rare: Sneezing or watery eyes immediately after use.
  • Action: If you develop a persistent skin rash around the nose or experience increased difficulty breathing, stop use and consult a doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • External Use Only: Do not attempt to take the inhaler apart or ingest the contents.
  • Eye Safety: Keep the inhaler tip away from your eyes. If vapors cause eye irritation, rinse with cool water.
  • Pregnancy: Generally considered safe for external use, but consult your doctor if you are particularly sensitive to strong scents during pregnancy.

searchable.name: Medica Lozenges
searchable.brief_info: Medica Lozenges are a specialized dual-action oral treatment designed to provide rapid relief from the pain and irritation associated with throat and mouth conditions. By combining a powerful local anesthetic with a broad-spectrum antiseptic, Medica doesn't just "numb" the throat—it also targets the bacteria and viruses responsible for the infection. Its soothing formula is ideal for managing the discomfort of a cold, flu, or minor oral procedures.
searchable.description: Medica Lozenges work through a "two-pronged" approach to oral health. First, the anesthetic component provides almost immediate numbing of the painful area, making it easier to swallow and speak. Second, the antiseptic component works to reduce the microbial load in the mouth and throat, helping to prevent the infection from worsening. The slow-dissolving nature of the lozenge ensures that the active ingredients remain in contact with the affected tissue for an extended period.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Medica

  • Adults and Children over 12 years: Usually 1 lozenge every 2 to 3 hours. Do not exceed 10 lozenges in 24 hours.
  • Children 6 to 12 years: 1 lozenge every 3 to 4 hours. Do not exceed 5 lozenges in 24 hours.
  • Under 6 years: Not recommended due to the risk of choking and the high concentration of lidocaine.

Proper Administration

  • Method: Place one lozenge in the mouth and allow it to dissolve slowly. Do not chew or swallow the lozenge whole, as this reduces its effectiveness.
  • Timing: For best results, avoid eating or drinking for at least 30 minutes after the lozenge has dissolved to allow the medicine to coat the throat.
  • Smoking: Avoid smoking immediately after use, as it can further irritate the newly numbed throat tissue.

How to Store and Dispose of Medica

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep the blisters in the original carton to protect them from light and moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of empty blister packs in regular household waste.

Quick Tips for Medica

  • The "Numb" Warning: Because lidocaine numbs the throat, your swallowing reflex may be slightly altered. Be careful when consuming hot foods or drinks immediately after a lozenge to avoid burns.
  • Sugar-Free: Many Medica variants are sugar-free, making them suitable for diabetics and better for dental health during an infection.
  • Hydration: Supplement the use of lozenges with warm (not hot) salt-water gargles for enhanced antiseptic action.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Typically 20 or 36 lozenges per pack.
  • Form: Hard Lozenge.
  • Active Ingredients: Chlorhexidine HCl, Lidocaine HCl.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Medica

  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to lidocaine, chlorhexidine, or other "caine-type" anesthetics.
  • Severe Wounds: Avoid use if you have large, open wounds or severe sloughing of the oral mucosa.
  • PABA Sensitivity: Some individuals may have cross-sensitivity issues.

Side Effects of Medica

  • Common: Temporary numbness of the tongue or mouth (intended effect), or a slight change in taste perception.
  • Less Common: Temporary brown staining of the teeth or tongue (common with long-term chlorhexidine use), which can usually be removed by brushing.
  • Action: If you experience swelling of the face, a skin rash, or difficulty breathing, stop use immediately and seek medical care.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Duration: Do not use for more than 3 to 4 consecutive days. If your sore throat is accompanied by a high fever, headache, or nausea, consult a doctor, as it may be a bacterial infection requiring antibiotics.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor before use. While generally safe in small amounts, lidocaine should be used with caution.
  • Choking Hazard: Ensure children are sitting still while dissolving the lozenge to prevent accidental inhalation.

searchable.name: Jobelyn 100 Capsules (Health Forever)
searchable.brief_info: Jobelyn is a scientifically researched, multi-functional herbal supplement containing a 100% natural extract of Sorghum bicolor. Produced by Health Forever Product Limited, it is internationally recognized for its exceptionally high antioxidant capacity (ORAC value). Jobelyn is primarily used as a powerful blood builder and immune system booster, helping to revitalize the body during recovery from illness, manage chronic conditions, and maintain overall vitality.
searchable.description: Jobelyn is derived from a unique variety of Sorghum bicolor leaf sheaths. It contains a dense concentration of polyphenols and anthocyanins—natural compounds that protect cells from oxidative stress. Its rapid action in increasing packed cell volume (PCV) and hemoglobin levels makes it a trusted natural alternative for blood enrichment and immune support.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Jobelyn

  • For General Wellness: 1 capsule two times daily (Morning and Night).
  • For Blood Building/Anemia: 2 capsules three times daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional.
  • For Children (under 12): Consult a pediatrician. Often, the capsule is opened and half the powder is mixed with food or honey.

Proper Administration

  • Timing: Can be taken with or without food. However, taking it with a glass of water after a meal is often best for absorption.
  • Consistency: For chronic conditions or blood building, it is important to take Jobelyn consistently for at least 30 days to see significant results in blood tests.

How to Store and Dispose of Jobelyn

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Ensure the bottle is tightly closed after use to protect the capsules from moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of the empty bottle in accordance with local plastic recycling guidelines.

Quick Tips for Jobelyn

  • The "Color" Note: Because of the high concentration of natural pigments, you may notice your stool becomes darker while taking Jobelyn. This is normal and expected.
  • Hydration: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to help your body process the antioxidants efficiently.
  • Monitor Progress: If taking Jobelyn for anemia, schedule a follow-up PCV or Full Blood Count (FBC) test after 2 weeks to monitor your improvement.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 100 Capsules per bottle.
  • Manufacturer: Health Forever Product Ltd.
  • Form: Herbal Capsule.
  • Active Ingredient: Sorghum bicolor extract.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Allergy: Do not use if you have a known hypersensitivity to Sorghum bicolor or any of the ingredients.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: While Jobelyn is a natural food-based supplement, always consult your doctor or midwife before starting any new supplement during pregnancy.

Side Effects of Jobelyn

  • Common: Jobelyn is generally very well-tolerated. Some individuals may experience mild stomach changes as the body adjusts to the high antioxidant load.
  • Action: If you experience an unusual skin rash or persistent diarrhea, discontinue use and consult your pharmacist.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Do Not Replace Medical Treatment: While Jobelyn is an excellent supportive therapy for conditions like Sickle Cell or Cancer, it should not replace prescribed medications (like hydroxyurea or chemotherapy) without a doctor's supervision.
  • Surgery: Inform your doctor that you are taking a high-antioxidant supplement if you have a scheduled surgery.

searchable.name: Jobelyn Suspension for Children
searchable.brief_info: Jobelyn Suspension is a scientifically formulated, 100% natural herbal supplement specifically designed for pediatric use. Containing the powerful extract of Sorghum bicolor, this liquid version of the world-renowned Jobelyn provides children with a palatable and easy-to-swallow way to boost their blood levels and strengthen their natural defenses. It is particularly valued in pediatric care for its ability to rapidly improve Packed Cell Volume (PCV) and hemoglobin levels during recovery from malaria, surgery, or in the management of chronic conditions.
searchable.description: Jobelyn Suspension harnesses the high antioxidant capacity (ORAC) of Sorghum bicolor in a child-friendly liquid format. Rich in polyphenols and anthocyanins, it works as a powerful "biological response modifier," meaning it helps the child's body adapt to stress and fight off infections more effectively. Its deep red color is entirely natural, derived from the high concentration of antioxidants within the plant sheath.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Jobelyn Suspension

  • Children 1 – 5 years: 5ml (one teaspoonful) twice daily.
  • Children 6 – 12 years: 10ml (two teaspoonfuls) twice daily.
  • Under 1 year: Only as directed by a pediatrician.
  • Note: For severe cases of anemia, a doctor may recommend increasing the frequency to three times daily for a short period.

Proper Administration

  • Shake Well: Always shake the bottle vigorously before each dose, as the natural herbal particles may settle at the bottom.
  • Measurement: Use the measuring cup or spoon provided with the bottle to ensure an accurate dose.
  • Consistency: For best results in blood building, maintain the schedule for at least 2 to 4 weeks.
  • Mixing: If the child finds the taste too strong, the dose can be mixed into a small amount of fruit juice or honey.

How to Store and Dispose of Jobelyn Suspension

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from direct sunlight. Once opened, ensure the cap is tightly closed.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of the empty bottle responsibly in a plastic recycling bin.

Quick Tips for Jobelyn

  • Natural Staining: The suspension is a deep red color. Be careful during administration, as it may stain clothes.
  • Stool Color: Do not be alarmed if your child’s stool appears darker; this is a normal result of the natural pigments in the Sorghum bicolor.
  • Hydration: Ensure the child drinks plenty of water to help the body utilize the high antioxidant content effectively.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Usually 100ml or 200ml Bottle.
  • Manufacturer: Health Forever Product Ltd.
  • Form: Oral Suspension.
  • Active Ingredient: Sorghum bicolor extract.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Allergy: Do not give to children with a known hypersensitivity to Sorghum bicolor.
  • Medical Consult: If your child is on other chronic medications, inform your pharmacist or pediatrician before starting Jobelyn.

Side Effects of Jobelyn Suspension

  • Common: Jobelyn is exceptionally safe and well-tolerated. Occasionally, a child may experience a mild change in bowel habits as their system adjusts.
  • Action: If the child develops a skin rash or persistent diarrhea, stop the supplement and consult your healthcare provider.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Not a Substitute for Malaria Treatment: While Jobelyn is excellent for building blood after malaria, it does not kill the malaria parasite. Always complete the prescribed antimalarial course first.
  • Monitor Blood Levels: For children with chronic anemia, regular PCV checks are recommended to track progress.

searchable.name: Cofex cough syrup
searchable.brief_info: Cofex Cough Syrup is a potent, multi-action liquid medication designed to provide rapid relief from irritating coughs and associated respiratory symptoms. By combining an effective antitussive (cough suppressant) with a powerful antihistamine, Cofex targets both the urge to cough and the underlying allergic triggers or nasal secretions that often cause "tickly" throats. It is a trusted solution for managing symptoms of the common cold, upper respiratory allergies, and minor throat irritations.
searchable.description: Cofex is formulated to address the discomfort of unproductive (dry) coughs. Its liquid base provides an immediate soothing coating for the inflamed tissues of the throat, while its active ingredients work systemically to suppress the cough reflex in the brain and dry up excess secretions in the nasal and throat passages.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Cofex

  • Adults and Children over 12 years: Usually 5ml to 10ml (1 to 2 teaspoonfuls) every 4 to 6 hours.
  • Children 6 to 12 years: 2.5ml to 5ml (½ to 1 teaspoonful) every 6 hours.
  • Maximum Dose: Do not exceed 4 doses in a 24-hour period.
  • Note: Not recommended for children under 6 years unless specifically directed by a pediatrician.

Proper Administration

  • Measurement: Always use the measuring cup or spoon provided with the bottle to ensure an accurate dose. Do not use a standard kitchen spoon.
  • Method: Take the syrup undiluted. For a soothing effect on the throat, avoid drinking water immediately after taking the dose.
  • Timing: If the cough interferes with sleep, take the final dose of the day about 30 minutes before bedtime.

How to Store and Dispose of Cofex

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from direct sunlight. Ensure the cap is tightly closed to maintain the syrup's integrity.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return any expired or unused syrup to your local pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Cofex

  • Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water throughout the day. While Cofex suppresses the cough, hydration helps thin any existing mucus.
  • Honey and Lemon: You can supplement Cofex with warm honey and lemon water for additional throat-soothing benefits.
  • Monitor Symptoms: If a cough persists for more than 7 days, or is accompanied by a high fever or rash, consult a doctor.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 100ml Bottle.
  • Form: Oral Syrup.
  • Active Ingredients: Dextromethorphan HBr, Chlorpheniramine Maleate.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • MAOIs: Do NOT use if you have taken a Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor (antidepressant) in the last 14 days.
  • Asthma/COPD: Use with caution if you have chronic respiratory conditions; cough suppressants are generally avoided if the cough is "productive" (bringing up a lot of mucus).
  • Narrow-Angle Glaucoma: Antihistamines may increase intraocular pressure.

Side Effects of Cofex

  • Common: Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, or blurred vision.
  • Less Common: Mild stomach upset or constipation.
  • Action: If you experience severe tremors, confusion, or difficulty urinating, stop use and contact your pharmacist.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Alertness: Because Cofex causes drowsiness, do not drive, operate heavy machinery, or engage in hazardous activities after taking a dose.
  • Alcohol: Avoid alcohol while taking Cofex, as it can significantly increase the sedative effects of the antihistamine.
  • Drug Interactions: Inform your doctor if you are taking other sedatives, tranquilizers, or medications for blood pressure.

searchable.name: Kacham Tablets/Caplets
searchable.brief_info: Kacham is a high-potency, multi-action analgesic and muscle relaxant designed to manage severe pain associated with musculoskeletal disorders. By combining a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), a skeletal muscle relaxant, and a common pain reliever, Kacham targets pain from three different angles. It is particularly effective for conditions where pain is exacerbated by muscle stiffness or spasms, providing comprehensive relief for both the injury and the resulting tension.
searchable.description: Kacham (often available as caplets or tablets) is formulated for patients suffering from acute painful musculoskeletal conditions. While standard painkillers only mask the sensation of pain, Kacham addresses the physical muscle tension (spasm) and the underlying inflammation that often causes the pain to persist. It acts centrally on the nervous system to relax muscles and peripherally to block pain signals.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Kacham This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM).

  • Adults (15 years and above): Typically 1 to 2 tablets, two to three times daily.
  • Children (5 to 15 years): Usually 1 tablet, two to three times daily, only as directed by a physician.
  • Duration: Should be used for the shortest duration possible to manage symptoms.

Proper Administration

  • With Food: Crucial: Always take Kacham after a meal or with milk. Taking it on an empty stomach significantly increases the risk of gastric irritation or ulcers.
  • Swallow Whole: Do not crush or chew the caplets, as this can affect the absorption of the Diclofenac component.
  • Hydration: Drink a full glass of water with each dose.

How to Store and Dispose of Kacham

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C, away from direct sunlight and moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused medication to your pharmacist.

Quick Tips for Kacham

  • Avoid Alcohol: Alcohol can increase the sedative effects of Chlorzoxazone and the risk of stomach bleeding from Diclofenac.
  • Watch for Drowsiness: Because it contains a muscle relaxant, Kacham can make you feel sleepy or dizzy. Avoid driving until you know how it affects you.
  • The "NSAID" Rule: Do not take Kacham with other NSAIDs (like Ibuprofen or Aspirin) as this increases the risk of side effects.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Typically 10 or 20 tablets per pack.
  • Manufacturer: Kunimed Pharmachem Ltd.
  • Form: Oral Caplet/Tablet.
  • Active Ingredients: Chlorzoxazone, Diclofenac Sodium, Paracetamol.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications of Kacham

  • Peptic Ulcers: Do not use if you have active stomach ulcers or a history of gastrointestinal bleeding.
  • Asthma: Avoid if you have "Aspirin-sensitive asthma" or have experienced rashes/wheezing after taking NSAIDs.
  • Kidney/Liver Disease: Use with extreme caution in patients with impaired organ function.
  • Heart Surgery: Do not use immediately before or after heart bypass surgery (CABG).

Side Effects of Kacham

  • Common: Drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, or heartburn.
  • Less Common: Discoloration of urine (Chlorzoxazone can sometimes turn urine orange or purplish-red; this is harmless).
  • Serious: Black/tarry stools (sign of stomach bleeding), yellowing of eyes (jaundice), or severe skin rashes.
  • Action: If you experience severe abdominal pain or difficulty breathing, stop use immediately and seek medical attention.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Cardiovascular Risk: NSAIDs like Diclofenac may increase the risk of heart attack or stroke, especially with long-term use.
  • Pregnancy: Not recommended, especially during the last three months of pregnancy, as it may harm the unborn baby.

searchable.name: Getzome Insta Powder 20mg
searchable.brief_info: Getzome Insta is an innovative, fast-acting oral suspension containing Omeprazole (20mg).1 Unlike traditional delayed-release capsules, the "Insta" powder formulation is designed for rapid absorption, providing quicker relief from the symptoms of excess stomach acid.2 It belongs to a group of medicines called Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPIs), which work by reducing the amount of acid produced by the stomach, allowing the esophagus and stomach lining to heal.3
searchable.description: Getzome Insta is a sugar-free, mint-flavored powder that, when mixed with water, creates an immediate-release oral suspension. This formulation is particularly beneficial for patients who have difficulty swallowing capsules or those who require faster onset of action for nighttime heartburn and acid-related discomfort.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Getzome Insta

  • Adults: Usually one sachet (20mg) daily.
  • Duration: For simple heartburn, it may be used for 14 days. For ulcers or GERD, your doctor may prescribe a longer course (4–8 weeks).9
  • Note: This medication is most effective when taken for several consecutive days rather than just "as needed."

Proper Administration

  • Preparation: Empty the contents of one sachet into a small cup containing 1 to 2 tablespoons of water.
  • Method: Stir well and drink immediately. If any powder remains, add a little more water, stir, and drink again. Do not use other liquids like milk or soda to mix the powder.10
  • Timing: For best results, take Getzome Insta on an empty stomach, at least 30 to 60 minutes before your first meal (usually breakfast). Taking it before a meal ensures the medicine is present when the stomach's acid pumps are most active.11

How to Store and Dispose of Getzome Insta

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect the sachets from moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of empty sachets in regular household waste.

Quick Tips for Acid Relief

  • Wait to Lie Down: Avoid lying down for 2–3 hours after eating to prevent acid from rising into the throat.
  • Elevate the Head: If you suffer from nighttime heartburn, use an extra pillow to keep your head elevated while sleeping.
  • Identify Triggers: Keep track of foods (like spicy dishes, citrus, or caffeine) that trigger your reflux and try to avoid them while your stomach heals.
searchable.specification:
• Strength: 20mg per sachet.
  • Form: Oral Powder for Suspension.
  • Flavor: Mint.
  • Manufacturer: Getz Pharma.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to Omeprazole or other PPIs (like Esomeprazole or Lansoprazole).
  • Nelfinavir: Do not take Getzome if you are taking nelfinavir (used for HIV infection).

Side Effects of Getzome Insta

  • Common: Headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or flatulence (gas).13
  • Less Common: Dizziness or a mild skin rash.
  • Action: If you experience severe diarrhea (which may be a sign of a bacterial infection) or unexplained weight loss, consult your doctor immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Bone Health: Long-term use of PPIs (more than a year) may slightly increase the risk of hip or wrist fractures.14 Ensure you have adequate Vitamin D and Calcium intake.
  • Magnesium Levels: Long-term use may lower magnesium levels in the blood.15 Your doctor may perform occasional blood tests.
  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor before use; it should only be used if the benefit outweighs the potential risk.

searchable.name: Boska Pain Reliever 500mg/30mg Tablets)
searchable.brief_info: Boska is a highly effective, dual-action analgesic and antipyretic medication. By combining a trusted pain reliever with a mild stimulant, Boska is designed to provide rapid relief from various types of pain while helping to combat the fatigue often associated with physical discomfort. It is one of the most recognized over-the-counter solutions for the management of headaches, body aches, and feverish conditions.
searchable.description: Boska tablets utilize a synergistic formulation where the two active ingredients work together to enhance the overall pain-relieving effect. The inclusion of caffeine helps the body absorb the paracetamol more quickly and efficiently, leading to faster onset of relief compared to plain paracetamol tablets.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Boska

  • Adults and Children over 12 years: 1 to 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
  • Maximum Dose: Do not exceed 8 tablets in a 24-hour period.
  • Children (6 to 12 years): Half to one tablet (250mg–500mg) every 4 to 6 hours. Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours.
  • Note: Not recommended for children under 6 years of age.

Proper Administration

  • Method: Swallow the tablets with a glass of water or a cold drink.
  • Timing: Can be taken with or without food. However, taking it after a meal may be gentler on the stomach.
  • Avoid Overlap: IMPORTANT: Do not take Boska with any other products containing paracetamol (acetaminophen), as this can lead to a dangerous overdose.

How to Store and Dispose of Boska

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from direct sunlight.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return expired or unused tablets to your local pharmacy.

Quick Tips for Boska

  • Watch Your Caffeine Intake: Since Boska contains caffeine, limit your intake of coffee, tea, and caffeinated sodas while taking this medicine to avoid jitters or sleeplessness.
  • Stay Hydrated: Drinking plenty of water helps your body manage fever and recover faster from illness.
  • The "3-Day" Rule: If your fever lasts more than 3 days, or your pain lasts more than 5 days, consult a doctor to determine the underlying cause.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: Often available in sachets of 2 tablets or packs of 10/20.
  • Strength: 500mg Paracetamol / 30mg Caffeine.
  • Manufacturer: Dexa Medica.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Liver Disease: People with severe liver impairment or chronic alcoholism should avoid Boska due to the risk of paracetamol toxicity.
  • Hypersensitivity: Do not use if you are allergic to paracetamol, caffeine, or any of the inactive ingredients.

Side Effects of Boska

  • Common: Boska is generally very well-tolerated. Some people may experience mild restlessness or insomnia due to the caffeine.
  • Serious (Rare): Skin rashes, swelling of the face, or difficulty breathing.
  • Action: If you notice any yellowing of the skin/eyes or experience a severe allergic reaction, stop use immediately and seek emergency medical help.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Alcohol: Avoid drinking large amounts of alcohol while using Boska, as this increases the risk of liver damage.
  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor before use. While generally considered safe at low doses, the caffeine component should be monitored.
  • Stomach Health: If you have a history of stomach ulcers, consult a pharmacist before frequent use.

searchable.name: Emprofen 200mg (Ibuprofen) X 10 Tablets
searchable.brief_info: Emprofen is a reliable Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drug (NSAID) containing Ibuprofen (200mg). It is designed to provide fast and effective relief from mild to moderate pain while simultaneously reducing inflammation and swelling. Whether you are dealing with a nagging headache, muscular aches, or a fever, Emprofen works at the site of the problem to provide comfort and restore your daily mobility.
searchable.description: Emprofen is a versatile analgesic that acts by blocking the chemicals in the body that signal pain. Unlike plain paracetamol, ibuprofen has strong anti-inflammatory properties, making it particularly effective for pains that involve swelling, such as sports injuries, dental issues, or menstrual cramps.1 This 10-tablet pack is a convenient size for a first-aid kit or travel bag.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Emprofen

  • Adults and Children over 12 years: 1 to 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
  • Maximum Dose: Do not exceed 6 tablets (1200mg) in a 24-hour period.6
  • Children (under 12 years): Use only as directed by a pediatrician (pediatric suspensions are usually preferred for younger children).

Proper Administration

  • With Food: IMPORTANT: Always take Emprofen with or immediately after a meal or with a glass of milk. This helps protect the stomach lining from irritation.
  • Method: Swallow the tablet whole with a full glass of water. Do not lie down for at least 15–30 minutes after taking the dose to prevent throat irritation.
  • Duration: Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration necessary to relieve symptoms.7

How to Store and Dispose of Emprofen

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C. Protect from moisture and direct sunlight.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return any expired medication to your local pharmacy for safe disposal.

Quick Tips for Emprofen

  • Hydration: Drink plenty of fluids, especially if you are taking Emprofen for a fever.
  • Identify the Pain: If your pain involves swelling (like a sprained ankle), Emprofen is often a better choice than paracetamol because it treats the inflammation.8
  • Avoid "Doubling Up": Do not take Emprofen with other NSAIDs (like Aspirin, Diclofenac, or Naproxen) as this increases the risk of side effects.9
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Stomach Ulcers: Do not use if you have an active stomach ulcer or a history of gastrointestinal bleeding.
  • Asthma: Use with caution; some people with asthma may experience "aspirin-sensitive" bronchospasm with NSAIDs.10
  • Kidney/Heart Issues: Consult your doctor if you have severe heart failure, kidney disease, or high blood pressure.
  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to Ibuprofen or Aspirin.

Side Effects of Emprofen

  • Common: Indigestion, heartburn, or nausea (minimized when taken with food).
  • Serious (Rare): Black or tarry stools (sign of stomach bleeding), skin rash, or shortness of breath.
  • Action: If you notice any unusual bruising, swelling of the face, or severe stomach pain, stop use and consult a doctor immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Pregnancy: Avoid use during the last 3 months of pregnancy unless directed by a doctor, as it may affect the baby’s circulation.
  • Alcohol: Limit alcohol intake while taking Emprofen to reduce the risk of stomach irritation.
  • Elderly Patients: Should use with caution due to an increased risk of kidney and stomach-related side effects.

searchable.name: Mecure Cimetidine 400mg (X 20 Tablets)
searchable.brief_info: Mecure Cimetidine is an effective Histamine $H_{2}$-receptor antagonist designed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid. By reducing the production of gastric acid, it helps relieve the painful symptoms of heartburn and promotes the healing of the stomach and intestinal lining.1 This 20-tablet pack provides a reliable solution for those suffering from acid-related gastrointestinal discomfort and ulcers.
searchable.description: Mecure Cimetidine works by blocking the action of histamine on the parietal cells in the stomach.2 Unlike antacids that merely neutralize existing acid, Cimetidine stops the acid from being produced in the first place. It is a well-established treatment for both short-term relief and the long-term management of chronic acid conditions.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage of Mecure Cimetidine

This is a Prescription-Only Medicine (POM).

  • For Active Ulcers: Usually 400mg twice daily (morning and bedtime) or 800mg once daily at bedtime for 4–8 weeks.
  • For Heartburn/Indigestion: Typically one 400mg tablet when symptoms occur, or as directed by your doctor.
  • Maintenance: A lower dose (400mg at bedtime) may be prescribed to prevent ulcers from returning.

Proper Administration

  • With Meals: Cimetidine can be taken with food or on an empty stomach.12 Taking it with meals may help prolong its effect.
  • Consistency: If prescribed a course, finish the entire duration even if you start to feel better after a few days.
  • Avoid Antacid Overlap: Do not take an antacid within 1 hour of taking Cimetidine, as it can reduce the absorption of the medicine.

How to Store and Dispose of Mecure Cimetidine

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C, away from direct sunlight.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return any unused or expired tablets to your local pharmacist.

Quick Tips for Acid Relief

  • Smoking Cessation: Smoking increases stomach acid production and can interfere with the healing of ulcers.13
  • Dietary Choices: Avoid "trigger" foods like caffeine, chocolate, spicy dishes, and alcohol while your stomach is healing.
  • Late Night Snacks: Avoid eating within 3 hours of going to bed to reduce nighttime acid production.14
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 20 Tablets (2 x 10 Blisters).
  • Strength: 400mg per tablet.
  • Manufacturer: Mecure Industries Ltd.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to Cimetidine or other $H_{2}$ blockers (like Famotidine).
  • Kidney/Liver Issues: Dosage may need adjustment if you have significant kidney or liver impairment.15

Side Effects of Mecure Cimetidine

  • Common: Headache, dizziness, diarrhea, or mild muscle pain.16
  • Rare (with high doses): Confusion (especially in the elderly) or reversible breast enlargement in men (gynecomastia).
  • Action: If you experience a persistent rash or unusual bruising, stop use and consult your doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Drug Interactions: IMPORTANT: Cimetidine can interact with many other drugs (like Warfarin, Phenytoin, and Theophylline).17 Always inform your pharmacist of all medications you are currently taking.
  • Pregnancy: Consult your doctor before use; it should only be used if clearly needed.
  • Masking Symptoms: If you have unintended weight loss or difficulty swallowing, see a doctor immediately, as Cimetidine can mask the symptoms of more serious conditions.

searchable.name: Microgynon 30 (3 Cycles)
searchable.brief_info: Microgynon 30 is one of the most widely used combined oral contraceptive (COC) pills. It contains two types of female sex hormones: an estrogen and a progestogen. When taken correctly, it is over 99% effective at preventing pregnancy. This 3-cycle pack provides three months (63 tablets) of consistent hormonal protection, helping to regulate your menstrual cycle and reduce the symptoms of painful periods.
searchable.description: Microgynon 30 is a "monophasic" pill, meaning every active tablet in the pack contains the same fixed dose of hormones. It works primarily by preventing the release of an egg (ovulation) each month. Additionally, it thickens the cervical mucus, making it harder for sperm to reach an egg, and thins the lining of the womb to prevent a fertilized egg from implanting.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage and Administration

  • The Routine: Take one (1) tablet daily at the same time for 21 consecutive days.
  • The Break: After 21 days, you have a 7-day pill-free interval. During this week, you will usually experience a "withdrawal bleed" (like a period).
  • Restarting: Start the next 21-day strip exactly on the 8th day, even if you are still bleeding.

Proper Usage Tips

  • Start Day: It is best to take your first pill on Day 1 of your period. This provides immediate protection against pregnancy.
  • Time Management: Choose a time you won't forget (e.g., when brushing your teeth at night). Accuracy is vital for effectiveness.
  • Vomiting/Diarrhea: If you vomit within 2 hours of taking a pill, or have severe diarrhea, your body may not absorb the hormones. Treat this as a "missed pill."

What to do if you miss a pill?

  • If you are less than 12 hours late: Take it as soon as you remember. Your protection should not be affected.
  • If you are more than 12 hours late: Take the most recent missed pill immediately (even if it means taking two in one day). Use a barrier method (like a condom) for the next 7 days.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 3 Cycles (3 strips of 21 tablets).
  • Form: Oral Tablet.
  • Manufacturer: Bayer.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Blood Clots: Do not use if you have (or have ever had) a blood clot in the legs (DVT), lungs, or elsewhere.
  • Smoking & Age: Combined pills are generally not recommended for women over 35 who smoke, due to increased cardiovascular risks.
  • Migraines: Do not use if you suffer from migraines with "aura" (visual disturbances).
  • Breast Cancer: Not suitable if you have or have had breast or liver cancer.

Side Effects of Microgynon

  • Common: Mild nausea, breast tenderness, mood swings, or "spotting" (breakthrough bleeding) between periods during the first few months.
  • Action: Most side effects settle after 3 months. If you experience sudden chest pain, severe leg swelling, or a sudden severe headache, seek emergency medical help immediately.

Precautions and Warnings

  • No STI Protection: The pill does not protect against HIV/AIDS or other sexually transmitted infections. Use condoms for STI protection.
  • Blood Pressure: Your pharmacist or doctor should check your blood pressure regularly while you are on Microgynon.
  • Drug Interactions: Some medications (like certain antibiotics, anti-seizure meds, or St. John’s Wort) can make the pill less effective.

searchable.name: Renerve Plus Softgel Capsules
searchable.brief_info: Renerve Plus is a high-potency nutritional supplement specifically formulated to support nerve health and enhance cellular metabolism. Combining the powerful neuro-protective properties of Methylcobalamin with essential antioxidants and minerals, these softgel capsules are designed to repair damaged nerves, improve blood flow, and combat oxidative stress. It is a preferred choice for managing various neuropathies and maintaining the overall integrity of the nervous system.
searchable.description: Renerve Plus is more than just a Vitamin B supplement; it is a "neuro-antioxidant" complex. It provides a synergistic blend of ingredients that work together to regenerate nerve fibers and improve nerve conduction. The softgel form ensures superior absorption and bioavailability, making it highly effective for those with chronic nerve conditions or nutritional deficiencies.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage and Administration

  • Adults: Take one (1) softgel capsule daily.
  • Method: Swallow the capsule whole with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew the softgel.
  • Timing: It is best taken after a meal (like breakfast or lunch) to maximize the absorption of the nutrients and prevent any minor stomach upset.

Proper Usage Tips

  • Be Patient: Nerve repair is a gradual process. While some may feel an energy boost quickly, it often takes 2 to 4 weeks of consistent use to notice an improvement in numbness or nerve pain.
  • Consistency: Take your capsule at the same time each day to maintain a steady level of nutrients in your system.
  • Avoid Alcohol: Excessive alcohol consumption can interfere with the absorption of B-vitamins and can further damage nerves.

How to Store and Dispose of Renerve Plus

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep away from direct sunlight and heat, as softgels can melt or stick together in hot environments.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of empty blister packs in regular household waste.
searchable.specification:
• Pack Size: 10 Softgel Capsules per strip.
  • Form: Soft Gelatin Capsule.
  • Strength: High-potency Neurotropic blend.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to Methylcobalamin, Alpha Lipoic Acid, or any other ingredients in the formula.
  • Diabetes Medication: If you are taking medication for diabetes, monitor your blood sugar closely, as Alpha Lipoic Acid can enhance the effect of insulin or oral drugs.

Side Effects of Renerve Plus

  • Common: Mild nausea, diarrhea, or a harmless yellowing of the urine.
  • Rare: Skin rash or itching.
  • Action: If you experience any severe allergic reactions like swelling of the face or difficulty breathing, stop use immediately and seek medical help.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Pregnancy & Breastfeeding: Consult your doctor before use; while these nutrients are essential, high-dose supplements should be medically supervised.
  • Kidney Health: If you have severe kidney disease, consult a healthcare professional before starting this supplement.

searchable.name: Nurofen 400mg (Maximum Strength) X 12 Tablets
searchable.brief_info: Nurofen 400mg is a high-strength formulation of the trusted anti-inflammatory painkiller, Ibuprofen. Designed for those who need more powerful relief than standard 200mg doses, it targets the source of pain to provide up to 8 hours of comfort. Whether you are managing intense muscular pain, a severe headache, or a stubborn fever, Nurofen 400mg works efficiently to reduce inflammation and get you back on your feet.
searchable.description: Nurofen 400mg belongs to a group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs). It is particularly effective for pain that is associated with swelling or redness. By providing a 400mg dose in a single tablet, it offers a convenient way to manage significant discomfort without the need to take multiple pills at once.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage and Administration

  • Adults and Children over 12 years: Take one (1) tablet with water.
  • Frequency: If needed, take one tablet every 4 to 6 hours.
  • Maximum Dose: Do not exceed 3 tablets (1200mg) in any 24-hour period.
  • Note: This product is for short-term use only. If symptoms persist for more than 3 days (fever) or 10 days (pain), consult your doctor.

Proper Usage Tips

  • Take with Food: IMPORTANT: To minimize the risk of stomach irritation, always take Nurofen 400mg with or immediately after a meal, or with a glass of milk.
  • Swallow Whole: Do not chew or crush the tablets.
  • Lowest Effective Dose: Always use the lowest dose necessary to relieve your symptoms to reduce the risk of side effects.

How to Store and Dispose of Nurofen

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Return unused tablets to your local pharmacy for safe disposal.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Stomach Health: Do not use if you have an active stomach ulcer, a history of gastrointestinal bleeding, or perforation.
  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to Ibuprofen, Aspirin, or other NSAIDs.
  • Heart/Kidney Disease: Consult your doctor if you have severe heart, kidney, or liver failure.

Side Effects of Nurofen 400mg

  • Common: Heartburn, indigestion, or nausea (less likely if taken with food).
  • Serious (Rare): Signs of stomach bleeding (black stools), skin rash, or sudden wheezing.
  • Action: If you experience any signs of an allergic reaction or severe abdominal pain, stop taking the medicine immediately and seek medical help.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Asthma: Some people with asthma may find that NSAIDs trigger a "flare-up." Use with caution.
  • Pregnancy: Do not take Nurofen during the last 3 months of pregnancy. Consult your doctor if you are in the first 6 months or breastfeeding.
  • Avoid Interactions: Do not take this with other NSAIDs (like Naproxen or Diclofenac) or low-dose Aspirin unless specifically told to do so by a doctor.

searchable.name: Maxi Tears Eye Drops (10ml)
searchable.brief_info: Maxi Tears is a high-quality lubricant eye drop solution designed to provide immediate and long-lasting relief from "Dry Eye" symptoms. Formulated to mimic the natural properties of human tears, it helps to restore moisture, soothe irritation, and protect the surface of the eye from environmental stressors. Whether your discomfort is caused by prolonged screen use, air conditioning, or wind, Maxi Tears provides the hydration needed for clear, comfortable vision.
searchable.description: Maxi Tears is an isotonic, buffered solution that acts as an artificial tear. It works by stabilizing the tear film—the thin layer of fluid that coats the eye—ensuring that the eye remains lubricated even in dry or dusty conditions. Its gentle formula is designed to be well-tolerated, making it suitable for frequent use throughout the day.
searchable.how_to_use:
Application Instructions

  1. Wash Hands: Always wash your hands thoroughly before touching your eyes or the dropper bottle.
  2. Prepare: Tilt your head back and gently pull down your lower eyelid with one finger to create a small "pocket."
  3. Apply: Hold the dropper above the eye and squeeze 1 or 2 drops into the pocket. Do not let the tip of the dropper touch your eye, eyelashes, or any other surface to prevent contamination.
  4. Close & Circulate: Close your eye gently for 1–2 minutes and roll your eyeball to spread the fluid evenly. Do not rub your eyes.
  5. Repeat: If using in both eyes, repeat the process for the other eye.

Proper Usage Tips

  • Frequency: Use as often as needed. For most people, 3 to 4 times daily is sufficient, but it can be used more frequently if the dryness is severe.
  • Contact Lenses: If you wear soft contact lenses, it is generally recommended to remove them before application and wait 15 minutes before putting them back in, unless the label specifically states it is "lens-friendly."
  • Avoid Mixing: If you are using other eye medications (like antibiotic drops), wait at least 5 to 10 minutes between using the different products.

How to Store and Dispose of Maxi Tears

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep the bottle tightly closed.
  • Expiration: IMPORTANT: Most eye drops must be discarded 28 days after opening, even if there is liquid left. This is to prevent the risk of bacterial infection. Mark the date of opening on the bottle.
searchable.specification:
• Volume: 10ml Dropper Bottle.
  • Form: Sterile Ophthalmic Solution.
  • Type: Artificial Tears / Lubricant.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to any of the ingredients (such as the preservatives or lubricating agents).
  • Infection: If your eye is producing thick yellow or green discharge, or is extremely painful and red, you may have an infection and should see an optometrist before using lubricants.

Side Effects of Maxi Tears

  • Common: Temporary blurred vision immediately after application (this usually clears after a few blinks).
  • Rare: Mild stinging or redness.
  • Action: If you experience persistent eye pain, changes in vision, or continued redness and irritation, stop use and consult an eye specialist.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Contamination: To keep the drops sterile, never touch the tip of the bottle to any surface, including the eye itself.
  • Driving: Do not drive or operate machinery until your vision is perfectly clear after using the drops.
  • Pregnancy/Breastfeeding: These drops are topical and generally considered safe, but always inform your doctor if you are pregnant.

searchable.name: OvaBoost for Women (120 Capsules)
searchable.brief_info: OvaBoost is a scientifically formulated dietary supplement by Fairhaven Health, specifically designed to support female reproductive health and enhance egg quality. By combining a powerful blend of antioxidants, vitamins, and specialized nutrients, OvaBoost helps protect egg cells from the damaging effects of oxidative stress and supports healthy ovarian function. This 120-capsule bottle provides a full 30-day supply for women who are actively trying to conceive or preparing for fertility treatments like IVF.
searchable.description: The quality of a woman's eggs is a critical factor in fertility and the health of a pregnancy. As women age, egg quality naturally declines due to oxidative damage. OvaBoost features a "trio" of ingredients—Myo-Inositol, Folate, and Melatonin—which have been clinically studied for their ability to improve egg health and insulin sensitivity. This formula is particularly popular among women with PCOS or those over the age of 30.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage and Administration

  • Dosage: Take four (4) capsules daily.
  • Method: Swallow capsules with water. You can take all four at once or divide them (e.g., 2 in the morning and 2 in the evening).
  • Timing: For best results, take with a meal. This improves the absorption of fat-soluble ingredients like Co-Q10 and Vitamin E and reduces the chance of stomach upset.

Proper Usage Tips

  • Start Early: It takes approximately 90 days for an egg to mature before ovulation. For maximum benefit, start taking OvaBoost at least 3 months before you plan to conceive.
  • Consistency: Take it every day at the same time to maintain steady nutrient levels in your system.
  • Combine with Prenatals: OvaBoost is designed to be taken alongside a comprehensive prenatal vitamin like PeaPod Prenatal.

How to Store and Dispose of OvaBoost

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep the bottle tightly closed to protect the capsules from moisture.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Dispose of the empty plastic bottle in your local recycling bin.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Pregnancy: Once a pregnancy is confirmed by a blood or urine test, you should discontinue OvaBoost and switch to a standard prenatal vitamin.
  • Pre-existing Conditions: If you are taking medication for depression or anxiety, or if you have a known medical condition, consult your doctor before use.

Side Effects of OvaBoost

  • Common: Some women may experience mild stomach upset or a change in sleep patterns (due to the Melatonin).
  • Action: If sleepiness occurs, try taking the full dose in the evening before bed. If you experience a persistent headache, reduce the dose and consult your doctor.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Hormonal Interaction: Because OvaBoost supports hormonal balance, it may slightly shift your ovulation date. It is recommended to use ovulation predictor kits (OPKs) to track your cycle.
  • Not a Cure: This is a nutritional supplement and is not intended to diagnose or cure infertility. It should be used as part of a healthy lifestyle.

searchable.name: Motility Boost for Men (60 Capsules)
searchable.brief_info: MotilityBoost is a premium dietary supplement by Fairhaven Health, specifically designed for men who have been diagnosed with low sperm motility (the ability of sperm to swim properly). Sperm motility is a critical factor in male fertility, as sperm must travel a significant distance to reach and fertilize the egg. MotilityBoost provides a targeted blend of antioxidants, vitamins, and amino acids that have been scientifically shown to improve sperm energy and swimming speed.
searchable.description: Even with a high sperm count, conception can be difficult if the sperm cannot move effectively. MotilityBoost is not a standalone multivitamin but a specialized "add-on" supplement. It targets the mitochondria (the powerhouses) of the sperm cells, providing them with the cellular fuel needed for better forward progression and velocity.
searchable.how_to_use:
Dosage and Administration

  • Dosage: Take two (2) capsules daily.
  • Method: Swallow with water. You can take them both at once or split the dose (one in the morning and one in the evening).
  • Timing: For best results, take with a meal to enhance the absorption of the antioxidants.

Proper Usage Tips

  • The 3-Month Rule: Because it takes approximately 74–90 days for new sperm to be produced and mature, you should take MotilityBoost consistently for at least 3 months to see a measurable improvement in sperm parameters.
  • The Fertility Foundation: This product is designed to be taken alongside FertilAid for Men. FertilAid provides the baseline minerals (like Zinc and Selenium), while MotilityBoost provides the extra push for movement.
  • Healthy Habits: Avoid excessive heat (tight underwear, saunas), reduce stress, and eliminate smoking to provide the best environment for your sperm to improve.

How to Store and Dispose of MotilityBoost

  • Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep the bottle tightly closed.
  • Disposal: Keep out of reach of children. Recycle the empty bottle according to local guidelines.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Medical Conditions: If you are taking medication for high blood pressure or have a history of heart conditions, consult your doctor before use.
  • Not for Women: This product is formulated exclusively for male reproductive health.

Side Effects of MotilityBoost

  • Common: Generally very well tolerated with no significant side effects. Some users may experience mild digestive upset if taken on an empty stomach.
  • Action: If you notice any signs of an allergic reaction (rash or itching), stop use and consult a healthcare provider.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Professional Diagnosis: It is recommended to have a semen analysis performed by a doctor to confirm that motility is the specific area requiring support.
  • Consistency is Key: Skipping doses frequently may reduce the effectiveness of the supplement.

searchable.name: Nevan Eye Drops (5ml)
searchable.brief_info: Nevan is a specialized ophthalmic suspension containing Nepafenac (0.1%), a potent non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID). Unlike standard eye drops, Nevan is a "prodrug," meaning it is specifically designed to penetrate the cornea and be converted into its active form inside the eye. It is primarily used to prevent and treat pain and inflammation associated with cataract surgery, ensuring a smoother and more comfortable recovery.
searchable.description: Nevan is formulated to target inflammation at its source within the eye tissue. By inhibiting the production of prostaglandins—the chemicals responsible for swelling, redness, and pain—it helps protect the delicate structures of the eye during the critical healing period following surgery. Its unique penetration ability makes it highly effective for deep-tissue ocular inflammation.
searchable.how_to_use:
Application Instructions

  1. Shake Well: IMPORTANT: Nevan is a suspension. You must shake the bottle well before each use to ensure the medicine is evenly mixed.
  2. Wash Hands: Thoroughly wash your hands before application.
  3. Prepare: Tilt your head back and pull down your lower eyelid to create a small pocket.
  4. Apply: Place one (1) drop into the pocket. Do not let the dropper tip touch your eye, eyelid, or any other surface.
  5. Press: Close your eye and gently press the corner of your eye (near the nose) for 1 minute to prevent the liquid from draining away.
  6. Repeat: If prescribed for both eyes, repeat the steps for the other eye.

Proper Usage Tips

  • Frequency: Usually applied three (3) times daily, or as strictly directed by your ophthalmic surgeon.
  • Schedule: Start using the drops exactly when your doctor instructs—often beginning one day before surgery and continuing for several weeks after.
  • Contact Lenses: Avoid wearing contact lenses during treatment with Nevan unless specifically authorized by your doctor, as the preservative (Benzalkonium chloride) can discolor soft lenses and the eye may be too sensitive after surgery.

How to Store and Dispose of Nevan

  • Storage: Store at room temperature (below 30°C). Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use.
  • Expiration: Discard the bottle 4 weeks (28 days) after opening to ensure sterility and prevent infection.
searchable.famasi_advice:
Safety and Precautions

Contraindications and Restrictions

  • Allergy: Do not use if you are allergic to Nepafenac, Aspirin, or any other NSAIDs (which may cause asthma or hives).
  • Bleeding Tendencies: Inform your doctor if you have a history of bleeding disorders or are taking blood thinners (like Warfarin), as topical NSAIDs may increase bleeding time in eye tissues.

Side Effects of Nevan

  • Common: Mild stinging or grittiness immediately after application, or temporary blurred vision.
  • Rare but Serious: Eye pain, increased redness, or changes in vision.
  • Action: If you experience "cloudy" vision or severe pain, contact your eye surgeon immediately, as NSAIDs can occasionally affect corneal thickness.

Precautions and Warnings

  • Slow Healing: Topical NSAIDs may slow down the healing process of the eye.
  • Sun Sensitivity: Some patients may experience increased sensitivity to light (photophobia); wearing sunglasses can help.
  • Avoid Mixing: Wait at least 5 minutes between using Nevan and any other eye drops.

searchable.name: Deep Relief Heat Rub
searchable.brief_info: Deep Relief Heat Rub is a powerful topical analgesic designed to provide fast, soothing relief from deep-seated muscular aches and pains. Manufactured by Embassy, this cream uses a specialized warming formula that penetrates deep into the tissues to stimulate blood flow and relax tight muscles. It is an ideal choice for athletes, individuals with chronic joint stiffness, or anyone recovering from physical overexertion.
